info.jobDescription:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

About the role

In this role, you will manage day-to-day global live-streaming operations for Netflix. As a Live Broadcast Operations Engineer, you will mainly coordinate and execute live-focused initiatives based on collaboration with the Live Streaming Pipeline Engineering Team, Live On-Site Technical Managers, Production teams, and our Reliability Engineering teams.

You will impact multiple areas of the live event lifecycle, from the pitch & planning phase to testing and event launch days. You will lead innovation initiatives that bridge the gap between production, hardware, broadcast engineering, and our software engineering teams.

Responsibilities

  • Coordination and partnership across multiple stakeholders and clients for the smooth execution of live-streaming events

  • Collaborate with contractors and in-house engineers for transmission planning.

  • Establish and maintain partnerships with satellite and IP transmission vendors. 

  • Establish and maintain partnerships with hardware and broadcast companies such as contribution/distribution encoder vendors, closed-captioning gears, and services.

  • Ability to organize and maintain maps & drawings of venue infrastructures for communication with all entities

  • Acts as a central resource for engineering and production, collaborating with teams to develop and execute technical plans that align with Netflix's creative and technical objectives, often managing concurrent schedules.

  • Responsible for troubleshooting, diagnosing, and reporting audio, video, and infrastructure issues.

  • Monitor and manage cloud-based and hardware-based video infrastructure. Provide analysis and remediation of any issues in the video workflow.

  • Manage, build, and evolve ground ingest capabilities, including signal acquisition, inspection, validation, and standardization.

  • Monitors the industry for emerging technologies, developing trends to keep Netflix live on the cutting edge.

  • Work closely to help enable new feature development by figuring out how the feature affects overall operations and how to make it work at scale.

  • Be present on launch days at Network Operations Center (NOC) or ground ingest facilities as required.

  • Be able to work with flexible hours based on the live events schedule.

  • Must have flexibility to travel for scheduled live events

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of broadcast remote operations experience (preferably network level) in a coordination or supervisory role 

  • Strong understanding of digital audio/video fundamentals, compression technologies, distribution formats, and associated technologies such as Multicast and Unicast video distribution, MPEG Video (2,4, & HEVC), MPEG-2 TS, HDR, SCTE-35 & ESNI signaling, closed-captions, satellite video distribution, and ad-splicing.

  • Experience with video transport protocols such as SDI, SMPTE-2110, RTP, RTMP, SRT, Zixi, RIST, HLS, MPEG-DASH

  • Proficient in Video and Audio Compression technology

  • Understanding of nuances of remote production and the on-site technical operation

  • Knowledge of remote production facilities and equipment vendors

  • Deep understanding of MVPD-based linear ecosystem and working knowledge of OTT video distribution, contribution technology, and architecture

  • Ability to assess and troubleshoot video and audio quality

  • Experience with on-premise video acquisition with partners or co-location facilities.

Nice to have

  • Experience with cloud-based infrastructure

  • Experience with at least one programming language (Java, Go, Python)

  • Experience in Unix (or unix-based systems), shell scripting, and good SQL knowledge

  • Experience with web technologies and distributed systems with microservices architecture

info.title: Ads Marketing Manager, Germany
info.jobDescription:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

The Team

At Netflix, the mission of our ads business is to build a must-buy advertising solution where clients (marketers and agencies) can reach diverse audiences who are highly engaged with the breadth and quality of our content.  The Ads Marketing team shapes our core advertising positioning and drives the go-to-market strategy to bring this positioning to life through compelling, differentiated messaging and activations.  By activating these messages across both sales channels (presentations, materials) and broader non-sales channels, the team builds widespread awareness and excitement among our key advertising partners. 

The Opportunity 

As the Ads Marketing Manager, Germany, you will play a crucial role in establishing Netflix Ads predominately in the German market, with a light touch in Austria and Switzerland as well. You'll be responsible for strategizing and executing B2B marketing activities that drive brand recognition, align with sales objectives, and resonate with local advertisers. This role requires a proactive, versatile marketer with a firm grasp of the B2B landscape and experience in cross-functional collaboration.

You will also engage in broader business strategies and actively pursue learning and development opportunities, continually growing and evolving as a Netflix marketer and leader.

Core Responsibilities: 

  • Develop Go-to-Market Strategies: Design and craft dynamic go-to-market strategies and narratives that empower the Sales team and resonate with advertising clients. Collaborate closely with the Global Ads Marketing team to ensure alignment with global messaging.

  • Event Strategy & Industry Engagement: Lead Netflix Ads’ presence at local industry events and custom client engagements, ensuring impactful representation and relevance at each touchpoint.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with teams across Communications, Product Marketing, Measurement, Sales, Brand Partnerships, Comms, Events and Marketing to maintain a unified ads narrative across all channels and touchpoints, support market launches and foster ongoing growth in Germany and German speaking markets.

  • Business Goal Alignment: Synthesize business objectives to define key audiences, optimal channels, and regions to activate, ensuring marketing initiatives align with overarching goals.

  • Data & Insights Analysis: Utilize data insights and new ad solutions to uncover and share compelling B2B stories tailored to the region and German market, enriching the value proposition for advertising partners.

  • Advertiser Relationships & Insights: Gain a deep understanding of advertiser partners and gather actionable insights that shape both product and marketing strategies, representing partner needs to cross-functional teams.

  • Point of Contact for Trade Bodies: Serve as the main point of contact for activating and managing relationships with local trade bodies, enhancing industry alignment and fostering credibility.

  • Leadership Updates: Deliver consistent updates to leadership, providing a comprehensive view of successes, challenges, and requests, ensuring transparency and support for the German market’s strategic goals.

Qualifications:

  • 7 or more years of experience in B2B marketing, product marketing, digital advertising, or marketing communications.

  • Familiarity with the CTV, OTT, or streaming landscape is preferred.

  • Proven expertise in product positioning, narrative crafting, and collateral development.

  • Skilled in partnering with regional marketing and sales teams to shape and communicate strategy, positioning, and messaging effectively.

  • Demonstrated ability to generate and implement creative ideas, collaborate with agencies, and manage multiple projects with precision under tight deadlines.

  • Experience developing a variety of content types—blog posts, case studies, presentations, creative assets, and thought leadership pieces—to advance marketing goals.

  • Proven success in creating impactful B2B event activations, and first party and third party , to support commercial goals. 

  • Strong aptitude for working in cross-functional environments, effectively aligning diverse stakeholders and scaling communications.

info.jobDescription:

Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

At Netflix, we seek to entertain the world by inventing entertainment experiences our people can’t live without and connecting them with stories for our over 300 million members in 190 countries.  

The core function of the Netflix product is to distribute our entertainment offerings - TV series, film, games, live events, podcasts, etc. - to our members. When a Netflix member opens our app, the product aims to help them choose a story to watch or a game to play that is right for them at that moment. To do this well, we need both a deep understanding of our content and the intelligence to present the right evidence (artwork, trailers, synopses, etc.) to enable their choice. 

The Creative Production DSE sits at the intersection of evidence production and content understanding. We are a team of data scientists and analytics engineers who partner closely with world-class product, merchandising, AI, and engineering teams. We help inform the production of artwork, trailers, and text descriptions of our titles, as well as the quality and completeness of title metadata through rigorous analyses, in-product experimentation, mathematical modeling, and analytics. 

We are looking for an exceptional leader to manage this team and work in highly cross-functional settings amidst a complex and global stakeholder landscape. A strong candidate for this role is able to inform decision making using data and exceptional judgment, possesses excellent communication and collaboration skills, and is a strong, seasoned people leader who can effectively guide a talented team. 

This role is based in Amsterdam, Netherlands. 

In this role, you will:

  • Lead a team of technical roles across data science and analytics engineering to shape the measurement and innovation strategy for the asset creation and content understanding spaces, balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders to drive durable business impact

  • Own end-to-end outcomes for measurement and insights in your domain, ensuring the team delivers timely, decision-ready work that meaningfully shapes product direction and development

  • Partner closely with other functions to frame the right problems, surface tradeoffs, and build a shared, causal understanding of content distribution

  • Set a clear vision and direction for the team, establishing priorities and operating norms that enable strong thought partnership, high-quality execution, and sustained impact

  • Act as a role model for Netflix values in day-to-day work and interactions, demonstrating strong judgment, candor, and accountability

 To be successful in this role, you will have:

  • Demonstrated experience leading data science, analytics, or related technical teams in product-focused domains, with accountability for both setting direction and delivering outcomes

  • Strong analytical judgment and structured thinking, with the ability to move from messy data and ambiguous problems to clear insights, recommendations, and decisions

  • Ideally worked with stakeholders across multiple time zones, and been successful at developing durable ways of working

info.title: Sr. Account Manager
info.jobDescription:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

The Role:

Netflix is seeking a Senior Account Manager to join our growing Netflix Ads team in Japan. This role is a critical partner to Sales and cross-functional stakeholders, responsible for managing our most strategic client and agency relationships.

The Senior Account Manager will focus on advertiser retention and growth while leading the full pre-to-post sale campaign workflow. A key part of the role is demonstrating strong problem-solving skills — engaging directly with clients, anticipating challenges, and driving long-term solutions through clear communication and strategic account planning.

This position requires balancing commercial strategy with operational excellence, ensuring Netflix Ads is seen as a trusted, solutions-oriented partner to our advertisers.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage our top and strategic accounts in partnership with Sales team and driving revenue growth

  • Serve as the first point of contact for campaign-related escalations, resolving issues in partnership with cross-functional teams before they require management intervention

  • Partner with aligned Sales Partners and/or Sr. Sales Partners to understand client goals and objectives in order to deliver excellent client service

  • Host weekly Pipeline & Pacing meetings with Sales Partners to align on upcoming launches and active campaign performance

  • Build Strategic Media Plans and contribute to RFP responses around campaign packaging, pricing, targeting, etc. 

  • Partner with cross-functional teams on the production of custom creative assets  

  • Collaborate with Account Managers in other regions to share learnings and best practices

  • Work closely with Campaign Management and Ad Operations for flawless order implementation and technical troubleshooting

  • Responsible for overseeing the delivery performance of Ad Campaigns and partnering with clients on necessary campaign optimization tactics 

  • Provide clients with necessary campaign performance including post-campaign wrap reports 

  • Ability to navigate campaign escalations and contribute to long-term solutions to prevent similar issues in the future

  • Maintain an in-depth understanding of Netflix Ad products, sponsorship offerings, targeting capabilities and ad policies. 

  • Contribute to monthly billing & invoicing  process with clients and finance team

  • Establish strong working relationships with client and agency partners, leaning into the sales strategy of the market or the book of business


We’re Looking for:

  • Extensive experience in Account Management and/or Sales Planning across both offline media (e.g., TV, sponsorships, live events) and digital advertising platforms, with a strong focus on video advertising

  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to engage directly with clients, navigate challenges, and drive long-term solutions through clear and effective communication

  • Experience working in Sales Operation systems (CRM, OMS, Ad Servers)

  • Strong knowledge of digital media sales and marketplaces, including Direct IO, Programmatic Guaranteed, and PMP advertising

  • Proven track record in advertiser retention and growth, with expertise in strategic account planning

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including experience engaging with senior-level stakeholders

  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to make data digestible and actionable for cross-functional teams

  • Demonstrated project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and stakeholders simultaneously

  • Familiarity with advertising research and verification vendors such as Nielsen, ComScore, Moat, IAS, DoubleVerify, Kantar, etc.

  • Fluency in Japanese, with the ability to communicate effectively in English for internal collaboration

If you have a passion for entertainment and a desire to work in a fast-paced, innovative environment, we would love to hear from you. Come join us and help us entertain the world!

【募集要項】

Netflixでは、日本で成長中のNetflix Ads チームに加わるシニアアカウントマネージャーを募集しています。このポジションは、営業や他部門のステークホルダーと密接に連携し、最も戦略的なクライアントおよび代理店との関係構築、管理を担う重要な役割です。

シニアアカウントマネージャーは、広告主クライアント維持と成長に注力し、プリセールスからポストセールスまでのキャンペーンワークフロー全体をリードします。この役割の重要な部分となるのが、強力な課題解決能力を発揮することです。具体的には、クライアントと直接関わり、課題を予測し、明確なコミュニケーションと戦略的アカウントプランニングを通じて長期的なソリューションを推進します。

このポジションでは、コマーシャル戦略とオペレーションの卓越性のバランスを取り、Netflix Ads が広告主にとって信頼できるソリューション志向のパートナーとして認識されることが求められます。

【主な業務内容】

  • 営業チームと連携し、主要かつ戦略的なアカウントの管理および収益拡大を推進

  • キャンペーンに関するエスカレーションの一次窓口となり、管理職の介入が必要になる前に他部門と協力して課題解決を図る

  • セールスパートナーやシニアセールスパートナーと連携し、クライアントの目標や目的を理解したうえで、卓越したクライアントサービスを提供

info.title: Full Stack Software Engineer 4 - Localization Engineering
info.jobDescription:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

At Netflix, localization isn't simply about translation. It's how we make stories feel native to audiences around the world. Every subtitle, dub, title treatment, artwork, and localized experience helps millions of members connect with content in their own language and culture. Critically, localization is not downstream of Netflix's content pipeline — it is inside it. Content cannot play for international audiences until it is localized.

The Logistics Management squad is the operational backbone of Netflix's localization platform. We own the tools, workflows, and infrastructure that order, track, and fulfill every piece of content.

The team is reimagining how localization works at Netflix. We build the platforms, products, and innovations that enable translation, cultural adaptation, and localization workflows at a global scale. You'll own some of the team's most ambitious initiatives from concept through launch. You'll define how work gets done, create clarity in ambiguity, and partner across engineering, product, design, and business to drive alignment, navigate tradeoffs, and deliver meaningful business outcomes.

We're especially excited to meet people who have built AI-native products and agentic workflows. This includes designing systems where humans remain in the loop and workflows are orchestrated reliably at scale. Experience with durable workflow orchestration, event-driven architectures, distributed systems, and resilient automation is highly valued. You'll help shape platforms that can reason, coordinate, recover from failures, and continuously improve while operating reliably in production. This is an opportunity to rethink how agents, workflows, automation, and human expertise come together so Netflix can deliver world-class localized experiences to members around the globe.

Qualifications

  • Deep experience building complex, high-quality user interfaces with HTML, JavaScript/TypeScript, and CSS, with expert-level proficiency in React and modern frontend architecture (component design, state management, performance optimization)

  • A strong eye for UI/UX craft. You build interfaces that are clear, predictable, and hold up reliably for enterprise users who rely on them daily

  • Experience designing and consuming GraphQL and/or RESTful APIs to power rich client experiences, and comfortable working across the stack, including services built in Java or similar OO languages

  • A proven track record of building resilient, high-scale, low-latency services in production, and translating business requirements into technical designs and data models

  • Work cross-functionally with design, product, and engineering partners to build, test, deploy, and launch UIs that operationalize our localization workflows at scale

What Sets You Apart

  • You’re a self-starter who takes initiative and drives work forward without needing significant direction

  • You proactively use AI tools to accelerate your workflow, learn faster, and amplify your impact

  • You communicate clearly and are comfortable navigating ambiguity. You ask the right questions, seek out the right context, and make good judgment calls without complete information

  • You are product-minded. You're curious about the "why" behind what you're building, and you bring your own ideas and opinions to the table rather than just implementing a spec as given

  • You take a thoughtful, practical approach to problem-solving that considers tradeoffs and avoids over-engineering

  • You take an interest in how people actually use what you build, and look for ways to get early feedback and validate your work rather than shipping and moving on

  • You evangelize new ideas and exemplify technical leadership with a bias for action.

  • You appreciate the complexity of engaging with a global challenge, and are passionate about crafting interfaces that feel native, no matter the language or locale

  • You are a resourceful engineer who can independently identify the root cause of issues and implement dependable, maintainable solutions across the entire stack

Bonus Points

  • Experience applying AI in production systems, e.g., integrating LLMs into user-facing or internal tools and able to identify where applied AI can meaningfully improve workflows

info.title: Director, Head of Advertising Sales - APAC Export
info.jobDescription:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

Our China Export Advertising strategy is a long-term bet to help ambitious Chinese brands become global brands. By combining Netflix’s premium entertainment, global reach, and advertising capabilities, we have an opportunity to help Chinese advertisers build relevance with audiences around the world and deliver measurable business outcomes.
 

We’re seeking a Head of Advertising Sales, China Export to build and lead this business—developing the market, deepening relationships with China’s most ambitious advertisers and brands with global ambitions, and creating the operating model required to connect decision-making in China with execution across Netflix markets around the world.
 

About the Role

As the Head of Advertising Sales for China Export, you will own the strategy and commercial development of Netflix’s China Export advertising business. This is a builder role: you will define where we play and how we win, establish the relationships and capabilities required to grow the market, and create repeatable ways of working that allow the business to scale.

The role sits at the intersection of China and Netflix’s global advertising organization. Success will require navigating complex client and agency ecosystems, leading across functions and geographies, and bringing teams from APAC, EMEA, and the Americas together around a shared strategy for Chinese advertisers.

You will be based in Singapore and report to the APAC Head of Advertising.
 

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and execute the China Export advertising strategy, identifying where Netflix has the greatest opportunity to help Chinese brands grow globally and translating that opportunity into a clear commercial plan.

  • Own and deliver revenue goals, developing long-term partnerships with China-based advertisers, agencies, and holding companies focused on international growth.

  • Establish a disciplined approach to prioritization by identifying the clients, categories, markets, and partnerships where Netflix has the greatest right to win and concentrating resources on the highest-value opportunities.

  • Develop the China Export playbook, working across Netflix teams to establish scalable approaches to product, measurement, creative, and campaign execution that meet the needs of Chinese advertisers operating across global markets.

  • Educate and develop the market, using insights, case studies, and thought leadership to build understanding of Netflix’s value proposition and create demand among Chinese advertisers and agencies.

  • Lead agency engagement and enterprise sales efforts, navigating complex organizational structures and building relationships across multiple levels and stakeholders.

  • Lead across Netflix’s global organization to align Sales, Product, Measurement, Operations, Marketing, and Creative teams around China Export priorities, ensuring clear ownership and effective execution across markets.

  • Be the voice of the customer, translating advertiser and agency needs into insights that inform Netflix’s product, measurement, and operational roadmap.

  • Build and lead a high-performing China Export team, develop talent, and evolve the organization and operating model as the business scales.
     

What We’re Looking For

  • Extensive experience in digital and/or international advertising, with meaningful exposure to export marketing, global brand building, performance marketing, or cross-border business development.

  • Deep understanding of the China advertising ecosystem and the ambitions and challenges of Chinese companies expanding internationally. Fluency in both Mandarin and English is required.

  • Demonstrated experience building a new business, market, or commercial capability from an early stage, including defining strategy, establishing operating mechanisms, prioritizing resources, and scaling what works.

  • Demonstrated experience originating commercial opportunities in one market and mobilizing teams across multiple international markets to execute and scale it, creating alignment across functions and geographies through influence rather than formal authority.

  • Strong relationships and credibility across the China advertising ecosystem, including advertisers, holding companies, and China-based performance and export-focused agencies.

  • Experience working with performance-oriented advertisers and expanding the conversation to brand building, translating business and growth objectives into premium brand and video strategies.

  • Excellent strategic thinking, storytelling, and commercial judgment, with the ability to translate a long-term vision into clear priorities and action.

  • Strong people leadership, with demonstrated ability to attract, develop, and lead high-performing commercial talent.

  • Comfort with ambiguity, experimentation, and iteration, with the judgment to balance near-term commercial opportunities against the long-term development of the business.

  • Strong cross-cultural fluency and the ability to operate effectively in a global, highly matrixed environment.

  • Curiosity about entertainment, culture, and the role Netflix can play in helping brands connect with audiences around the world.

  • Interest in our unique culture (read our culture memo to learn more).

info.title: Manager, Production Design - Brand Creative Studio
info.jobDescription:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

The Netflix Brand Creative Studio (BCS) is our in-house team of Strategists, Creatives, Designers, Producers, and Program Managers. We are the creative collective behind Netflix's most high-profile brand initiatives, developing work that builds passionate fandoms and shapes how the world connects with our brand. Our mission is to strengthen the Netflix brand and drive business value by creating culturally relevant marketing that is as entertaining as our shows, films, games, and experiences. Our studio serves as a centralized partner for a wide range of business-critical areas—spanning Global Brand and Brand Partnerships, Ads, Consumer Products, and live experiences like Netflix House.

As Netflix continues to expand into new business units, formats, and physical experiences, the volume and complexity of design output across the company continues to grow. To support this scale, BCS is evolving its operating model to include a dedicated production design team focused on speed, systems, and consistency, without compromising craft.

THE ROLE

We are seeking a Manager, Production Design to join the Brand Creative Studio. This is a senior individual contributor role within the production design team, responsible for driving high-quality, systems-led creative execution across multiple business functions, including the Netflix Brand, Netflix House, Product Marketing, Consumer Products, and Corporate Communications.

This role reflects a creative agency and design studio model of  visual design meets production design tooling and workflow expertise, where the focus is on translating brand strategy and design systems into scalable, repeatable outputs across channels, markets, and use cases. You will operate as a hands-on design expert—owning complex workstreams end-to-end, elevating the quality and consistency of production output, and helping shape the systems and frameworks that enable the team to scale.

You will partner closely with the Senior Manager, Production Design, cross-functional stakeholders, and external agencies to ensure work is executed with clarity, craft, and operational rigor. While this is not a people management role, you will be expected to mentor junior designers, provide creative direction on production workstreams, and help set the standard for how production design operates within BCS.

A strong portfolio demonstrating visual design and systems thinking, high-volume execution, and brand-led production work is required.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Visual Design Craft & Hands-On Production Design

  • Own and drive production design across complex, high-volume workstreams, including lower-funnel marketing assets, campaign toolkits, sales materials, and presentation systems for executives, sales, and high-priority communications.
     

  • Bridge elevated visual craft with production efficiency. Develop daring, high-impact visual concepts from open-ended briefs, while maintaining brand design system consistency and technical scalability across platforms.
     

  • Translate brand design systems, toolkits, and creative direction into scalable production frameworks that support speed, consistency, and quality across teams and partners.
     

  • Develop and refine templates, modular systems, asset frameworks, and production workflows across channels and markets.
     

  • Serve as a hands-on design lead, producing work directly, while also elevating the output of the broader production design team.
     

Cross-Functional Creative Support

  • Act as a trusted creative partner to teams across Brand, Netflix House, Product Marketing, Consumer Products, and Corporate Comms, supporting a wide range of outputs from performance marketing and physical environments to executive communications.
     

  • Lead presentation design for high-visibility needs where clarity, consistency, and brand expression are critical.
     

  • Ensure work is fit-for-purpose across audiences and channels, while maintaining alignment with Netflix brand standards.
     

Mentorship & Creative Guidance

  • Mentor and guide production designers, providing clear creative direction, constructive feedback, and support for professional growth.
     

  • Help establish best practices and craft quality benchmarks that raise the bar for production design output across the team.
     

  • Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, and pride in craft within the production design practice.
     

Agency & Partner Collaboration

  • Collaborate with external agencies and production partners, helping ensure output aligns with Netflix brand standards and production frameworks.
     

  • Support the Senior Manager in defining when work should be handled internally versus externally, based on scale, complexity, and timelines.
     

  • Review and provide feedback on agency deliverables to maintain quality and consistency.
     

Quality, Craft & Continuous Improvement

  • Uphold high standards of design quality across all production outputs, including executive-facing and external presentation materials.
     

  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve workflows, systems, and templates to increase efficiency and consistency while raising the creative bar.
     

  • Stay current on best practices in production design, creative operations, and design tooling.
     

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 8–11 years of experience in visual design, production design, or creative operations within a creative agency, design studio, or scaled in-house brand team.
     

  • Proven track record of leading high-volume, brand-led production design across multiple channels and formats.
     

  • Strong background in building, managing, and evolving design systems, templates, and modular frameworks.
     

  • Experience overseeing a broad range of production outputs, including presentation design for senior leadership, sales, physical events, and digital and print marketing materials.
     

  • Ability to translate complex information into clear, well-structured visual communication across formats.
     

  • Demonstrated experience mentoring designers and providing creative direction, even outside of a formal management role.
     

  • Exceptional collaboration skills, with experience partnering with cross-functional teams and external agencies.
     

  • Fluency in modern design tools and workflows (Figma, Adobe Creative Suite; motion experience a plus).
     

  • Enthusiasm for leveraging AI tools and automation to enhance workflows, while identifying inefficiencies in the production process (project work examples a plus).
     

  • Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
     

  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment.
     

  • A hands-on leader who can move fluidly between strategic thinking, systems-level problem solving, and direct design contribution

Our Team:

The Ads Platform team builds the advertising systems and integrations that power the delivery of ads using our world class content delivery ecosystem. We deliver ads in a manner that’s thoughtful of our members’ viewing experience and drives great outcomes for advertisers. 

Our team is new and yet faced with the ambitions of building highly performant advertising systems and delivering high impact to our business by monetizing our incredible slate of content. This PM will be responsible for ads experimentation and incrementality measurement products. This role will focus on building measurement products for customers that utilize various experimentation and incrementality methodologies so they can isolate the causal impact Netflix’s ad campaigns have on their media objectives. These customers include advertisers and agencies, as well as third party partners such as measurement or other ad tech vendors.

info.jobDescription:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. Our Team:

The Ads Platform team builds the advertising systems and integrations that power the delivery of ads using our world class content delivery ecosystem. We deliver ads in a manner that’s thoughtful of our members’ viewing experience and drives great outcomes for advertisers.
 

Our team is new and yet faced with the ambitions of building highly performant advertising systems and delivering high impact to our business by monetizing our incredible slate of content. As one of the newest entrants in the Connected TV advertising space that’s rapidly growing, we seek to build unique value propositions that differentiate Netflix from other ad-supported streaming services.
 

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager in the advertising space who is excited to join us on this journey.
 

About the Role:

We are seeking a seasoned Senior Product Manager to own the vision, strategy, and execution of our Ads Targeting Platform that structures, surfaces, and activates audience and contextual signals across forecasting, media planning, and advertiser sales. This is a highly visible, high-ownership role that requires both deep technical fluency and sharp commercial instincts. You will set the long-term direction for how targeting signals are architected, governed, and consumed by partner teams, while driving near-term delivery against a complex, multi-stakeholder roadmap. You will be the connective tissue between sales, GTM, engineering, and data science; translating advertiser market demands into durable platform capabilities and ensuring our targeting infrastructure is a genuine competitive differentiator.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Define and Own the Platform Vision: Set the long-term strategic direction for the Ads Targeting Platform, establishing a clear and compelling vision for how audience signals, contextual signals, and data taxonomies come together to power advertiser outcomes at scale.

  • Drive Roadmap and Strategy: Lead roadmap prioritization across a complex landscape of partner needs, technical dependencies, and business objectives — making sharp tradeoffs and building organizational alignment around a coherent, ambitious product strategy.

  • Architect for Scale: Partner deeply with engineering and data science to make foundational decisions about signal ingestion, normalization, taxonomy design, and data storage — ensuring the platform is built to scale with the business and adapt to a rapidly evolving targeting landscape.

  • Elevate the Advertiser Sales Cycle: Bring authoritative knowledge of how enterprise advertisers and agencies plan, buy, and measure media. Ensure the platform anticipates and supports the full sales cycle, from early forecasting and media planning through campaign activation and optimization, and that sales teams are equipped to position our targeting capabilities with confidence.

  • Lead Cross-Functional Alignment: Operate as a senior leader across sales, ad operations, GTM, data engineering, and partner teams. Drive alignment on priorities, resolve competing demands, and champion the platform's roadmap at the executive level.

  • Champion Signal Quality and Data Governance: Own the standards for how targeting signals are defined, classified, and maintained across the platform. Establish governance frameworks that ensure data quality, commercial relevance, and compliance with evolving advertising regulations.

  • Shape GTM Strategy: Partner with sales and marketing leadership to define how targeting capabilities are packaged, positioned, and brought to market; influencing how advertisers perceive and purchase our targeting products.

  • Communicate Vision at All Levels: Influence without authority across a large, matrixed organization. Articulate a clear and inspiring product narrative to engineers, executives, and commercial partners alike.

  • Expert-level understanding of the advertising ecosystem, including DSP platforms, programmatic buying, audience and contextual targeting, CTV advertising, and how enterprise advertisers and agencies approach media planning and investment.

  • Deep experience with data taxonomies, signal classification, and audience data infrastructure — with strong opinions about how targeting data should be structured to serve both technical and commercial needs.

  • Demonstrated ability to make foundational architectural decisions in partnership with engineering and data science, with fluency in ad serving systems, SSPs, DSPs, APIs, and integration frameworks.

  • Strong UX leadership experience, with a track record of delivering interfaces and workflows that make sophisticated data accessible and actionable for sales, media planning, and operations teams.

  • Executive-level communication skills and the ability to build alignment across engineering, sales, GTM, legal, and data teams in a fast-moving environment.

Our Team

The Ad Eventing team sits within the Ad Serving & Decisioning org at Netflix Ads. We own the systems that ingest and process billions of ad events per day — from client-side beacons fired during playback to server-side signals from our ad server. Our work spans real-time event ingestion, deduplication and validation, stream processing pipelines, and the authoritative data contracts that downstream systems (billing, reporting, pacing, ML) depend on. We operate at the intersection of reliability engineering, data infrastructure, and ads domain expertise.

We are looking for a senior technical leader to own the technical direction of this pod, set the architectural bar, and drive execution on the hardest problems in event processing at Netflix scale. info.jobDescription:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

The Opportunity

Language Producers are the bridge between Netflix’s global content ambitions and the on-the-ground, in-market reality. They sit close to our members: in-region, speaking the language, understanding the culture, and translating data into meaningful, market-specific decisions. The Language Producer for Global English Content Localization is accountable for how members experience English-language localized audio, timed text, and marketing assets, ensuring Netflix customers across the globe get the highest-quality, most culturally resonant English localization — what a great time to join Netflix!

The Role

The Language Producer is a Content Localization expert accountable for language and partner health across English-language assets — the main liaison between Netflix and local dubbing, timed-text, and marketing localization vendors, and the execution arm of our partner strategy. This role is the first line of contact for local partners, focused on quality at scale rather than exhaustive title-by-title supervision. Success is measured by the health of the language and partner ecosystem, the role stewards, not by how many titles it personally touches.

This is a 60/40 role: roughly 60% of the time is spent strengthening the local partner ecosystem — vendor relationships, talent pipelines, training, and feedback loops — and 40% is spent on direct, tiered engagement with a curated slate of high-priority titles and assets. Partners are the first line of defense on execution; the Language Producer trains, aligns, and trusts them to meet Netflix’s quality bar, and steps in directly where judgment moves the needle most (in-market popularity, language expansion, new formats, or systemic quality signals). This is a demanding, fast-moving position that requires someone who can hold a strategic, ecosystem-level view while getting as tactical as necessary to deliver content, working across all components of English localization — dubbing, timed text, and marketing — alongside in-territory and cross-functional teams.

Responsibilities

PARTNER ECOSYSTEM MANAGEMENT (~60%)

  • Own the local relationship with English dubbing studios, timed-text and DL/PLDL vendors, and talent partners — run recurring tactical syncs and quarterly strategic reviews grounded in performance data, escalating global strategy, vetting, and contract matters to Global Resource Management (GRM).

  • Train, align, and support partners so they can consistently meet Netflix’s quality bar without relying on constant internal review; partners own day-to-day execution, and self-QC and local expertise are the default.

  • Build and grow talent pipelines and databases for English-language dubbing and audio description; identify casting gaps (mature voices, diverse casting, new AD narrators, niche genres) and design or sponsor initiatives with GRM to close them, monitoring progress against milestones.

  • Collaborate with partners on dubbing talent casting and mix reviews for select titles, while enforcing adherence to creative guidelines across all dubbed titles; look for opportunities to improve efficiency and innovation in budget, scheduling, and vendor mix.

  • Closely monitor union/guild activity, market rates, and the competitive landscape that could influence pricing, capacity, or general market behavior.

  • Act as a local integrator of partner and quality data and escalate critical local issues for visibility, even when the ultimate resolution sits with Legal or Public Policy.

TITLE-LEVEL ENGAGEMENT ACROSS WORKFLOWS (~40%, TIERED)

  • Apply a tiered support model across every asset type: engage directly (“Touch”) on the highest-priority titles for the market — roughly the top tier by in-market popularity, language expansion, or strategic slate — and rely on data and partner escalation (“Analysis”) for the rest of the slate.

  • Import assets (audio and timed text): for Touch titles, own material review (locked cut, context, terminology), creative and operational alignment with partners before work starts (casting, creative approach, scheduling), and creative review of final assets — including a pre-delivery watchdown of secondary audio and targeted timed-text QC — to validate outcomes and extract learnings that improve the wider ecosystem.

  • Same-language and pivot assets (OL forced narratives, SDH, PLDL/DL, English pivot templates): steward partner workflows and standards; align on the creative approach, terminology, and quality expectations for Touch titles; and use QC reports and spot checks to diagnose and address systemic gaps across the rest of the slate.

  • Main Title / Episode Title localization: own translation approval and oversight of vendor-suggested titles for Touch titles in English-speaking markets, and serve as the escalation point for linguistic questions on English MT/ET more broadly.

  • Marketing materials: conduct post-launch quality review of primary trailers for Touch titles; serve as an escalation point — not a systematic approver — for non-AV marketing assets like copy and taglines, in line with a predictable, ecosystem-focused workload.

  • Define standards of creative excellence and general creative guidelines for the market; conduct risk assessments for special upstream localization requests; and analyze content and language performance trends to address localization challenges in collaboration with Title Producers.

GUIDELINES STEWARDSHIP

  • Own and maintain language-specific style guides and creative guidelines (Timed Text Style Guides, Audio Description and DL/PLDL Style Guides, Creative Excellence Guidelines), keeping them current, accessible, and reflective of real production workflows.

  • Use guidelines as a primary tool for partner training, performance feedback, and quality interventions, and feed back learnings from title-level work to evolve them with new formats and workflows.

LANGUAGE & PARTNER HEALTH (QUALITY AT SOURCE)

  • Diagnose language health using metrics, QC/TQ signals, and member feedback; translate findings into a market-level strategy — where quality is strong versus where systemic intervention or training is needed.

  • Track vendor performance over time to inform smart routing, training priorities, and vendor-mix decisions, with the goal of reducing reliance on third-party QC as partner quality matures.

INNOVATION & AUTOMATION

  • Stay current on how technology — ASR, machine translation, TQ models, and automation — is reshaping the localization process, and help define “fit-for-purpose” quality standards by format and tier as the company’s strategy develops.

  • Act as subject matter expert for localization workflows in English, supporting the Dubbing Strategy and Innovation roadmap and Netflix’s tooling ecosystem to drive vendor adoption.

  • Participate in tests and quality control of lip sync, VO, machine translation, and core asset roll-outs; feed structured feedback back to Strategy & Innovation (S&I) and algorithm teams rather than treating model outputs as a black box.

CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION

  • Initiate, support, and collaborate with cross-functional partners on Inclusion and Diversity initiatives to keep strategy consistent across the organization.

  • Be sensitive to the local competitive landscape and maintain a working knowledge of localization contracts and local best practices between talent and Netflix’s vendors.

Requirements

  • A minimum of 5–10 years of dubbing and/or timed-text title/language management experience (creative and operations).

  • Based in Los Angeles, CA, with a willingness to travel internationally and the flexibility to work across time zones to support a globally distributed team.

  • Ability to inspire trust and build teams while representing Netflix professionally to partners.

  • Curiosity about innovation and the ability to adapt to new technologies and processes, including automation and AI-driven quality tooling.

  • Comfort reading and questioning data and dashboards (QC/TQ metrics, partner ratings) to drive decisions — this does not require a data science background, but does require the ability to connect metrics to member experience and turn them into vendor action.

  • A strong understanding of localization workflows and pipelines, including real-time workflows, and the ability to execute titles at various points of production (development through delivery).

  • Experience navigating complex vendor relationships, including difficult conversations about quality, accountability, and automation.

  • Highly analytical, able to identify root causes and propose changes to existing workflows; adept at writing, facilitating, and presenting analyses.

  • Familiarity with (or willingness to learn) English-language localization contracts, union/guild dynamics, and local market best practices.

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred and/or equivalent, relevant work experience.

  • Native fluency in English is mandatory; proficiency in another language is beneficial.

The Security Services Engineering organization supports the Netflix workforce by creating and operating the security access control model, including authentication, authorization, and cryptographic software services. Our access control use cases will continue to become more complex as we increase investment in Netflix Originals content production ecosystems, including Content, GenAI, Ads, Gaming, Live streaming, and more. Our workforce and partners are global, and they access our information in different patterns and with varying needs from various locations and devices. With security and ease of information access in mind for our ongoing growth, we recognize that the traditional corporate network security perimeter no longer meets our requirements. Instead, we invest in identity as a perimeter on the open internet, with reliable, robust, and strong access-control models and services to protect our information.

The Role

This role focuses on building the access experience layer at Netflix — designing, building, and operating the services that make access control safe and straightforward for hundreds of internal engineering teams. You will be part of the Access Experience Engineering (AXE) team in Warsaw, Poland, focusing on the integration and experience layer that sits on top of Netflix's core access control infrastructure. You will partner closely with ACE and the Security Services Engineering organization, both primarily based in UCAN, as part of a follow-the-sun, async-first model.

You will work on a mix of projects encompassing ownership of system design, implementation, partner integration, rollout strategy, and maintenance of access tooling and integration services — including the adoption layer for future of access management at Netflix, Netflix's next-generation access management platform, as well as APIs, SDKs, and self-service workflows that enable internal teams to implement access securely and consistently.

One engineer on this team will serve as an in-time-zone security anchor — a technical lead who brings a pragmatic, risk-aware lens to AXE's designs and implementations and partners directly with ACE Core on security architecture decisions.

This role is based in Poland and can be performed remotely within the country.

info.title: Manager, Engineering - AI Search Platform
info.jobDescription:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

About the organization

Content Infrastructure & Solutions (CIS) empowers engineers working on content, studio and enterprise applications to be innovative and agile in supporting Netflix's global content production needs. We do that by providing scalable and resilient infrastructure for large-scale media, assets, data, workflow and communication use cases.

Connected Enterprise Foundations (CEF), part of CIS, provides highly leveraged and fully managed data, search, workflow and messaging platforms for Content, Studio and Enterprise Engineering. CEF's charter is a connected enterprise experience: consistent, composable platform primitives that application teams and their agents build on, rather than a collection of separate products each with its own model of the world. Our sibling teams include Knowledge Foundations (data and domain modeling), Eventing and Communications Platform, Enterprise Workflow Platform, and the Enterprise Developer Paved Road.

About the team and the role

The AI Search Platform team owns Graph Search, Netflix’s enterprise search-as-a-service platform. Graph Search provides engineering teams with a unified way to index, search, and resolve entities across Content, Studio, Ads, and Enterprise. The team also builds and operates capabilities that enable internal users and agents to access the graph through natural language. It partners closely with the Knowledge Foundations team on the Unified Data Architecture, Data Dictionary, and Entity Graph.

The platform operates at significant scale today:

  • Approximately 19,500 weekly active users, more than double year over year

  • 13.5 million API calls per day, up 97% year over year

  • 233 production indices containing 13.3 billion documents, with index count up 74% year over year

  • More than 200 client applications consuming the search API, more than double year over year

You will lead a team of eight engineers based in Warsaw. The team has deep end-to-end ownership of the platform: it operates its own on-call, has delivered order-of-magnitude latency improvements across indexing and query paths, and has developed AI-powered operational tooling that has been adopted by other CIS teams.

The platform is at an inflection point, which makes this role particularly important:

  • From service to self-service. Graph Search is a powerful platform, but adoption is not yet effortless. Multi-tenancy, data product integration, and self-service onboarding are the next major steps.

  • From applications to primitives. The team has deliberately chosen not to build standalone end-user applications. Instead, it provides composable search primitives that enable other teams to build their own products, agents, and experiences while the team owns the underlying platform. Defining and maintaining that boundary, including evaluating when a use case does not belong on the platform, is a key part of the role.

  • Advance agentic and semantic search without neglecting the core. Agents are becoming first-class consumers of search, and semantic retrieval and entity grounding are major areas of investment. At the same time, keyword search remains the largest source of user value. The challenge is to advance the platform for emerging AI use cases without under-investing in the fundamentals that users depend on today.

  • Build a stronger discipline around impact. The team has an opportunity to become much more rigorous in connecting its investments to measurable business and organizational outcomes. Prioritization should be evidence-backed rather than strictly driven by inbound requests. You’ll also have the opportunity to shape how the team prioritizes its work and measures success.

To learn more about what the team does, check out the following tech blogs written by the team:

  • How Netflix Content Engineering makes a federated graph searchable

  • How Netflix Content Engineering makes a federated graph searchable (Part 2)

  • Reverse Searching Netflix’s Federated Graph

  • The AI Evolution of Graph Search at Netflix: From Structured Queries to Natural Language

What you will do

You will lead a team of software engineers to deliver high-impact results. In this role you will:

  • Be a thought partner to the product manager, engineers, and engineering managers across Netflix engineering in setting the vision, strategy, and adoption path for Search, natural-language search, and Smart Tables as platform capabilities. Ensure we build the capabilities that enable engineering teams across Netflix to design and ship AI search solutions at scale.

  • Collaborate closely with Knowledge Foundations and the broader CEF organization to align roadmaps across Graph Search, Entity Graph, Data Dictionary, Unified Data Architecture, and Communications Platform, so stakeholders experience a coherent set of capabilities rather than adjacent products.

  • Serve as a credible technical advisor to the team, helping engineers make thoughtful, well-informed decisions in complex and ambiguous situations.

  • Raise the team’s rigor around impact. Define meaningful leading indicators, ask stakeholders for evidence behind their requests, and deprioritize work that does not demonstrate sufficient value.

  • Own the operational excellence of a Tier 1 platform, including 24x7 on-call responsibilities, capacity and performance headroom, infrastructure-level data validation, observability, and SLOs that help prevent predictable outages rather than discover limits through incidents. Flexible scheduling or coverage accommodations can be supported where appropriate.

  • Drive AI-first ways of working across the team, both by treating agents as first-class consumers of the platform and by advancing agent-assisted engineering practices, supported by the code review, change-risk management, testing, and evaluation practices required to use them safely at scale.

  • Build trusted relationships with partners and stakeholders, connect opportunities across teams to maximize business impact, and prioritize work beyond the boundaries of your immediate domain when it benefits the broader organization.

  • Communicate complex technical and product ideas clearly through written and verbal channels and influence decisions across a diverse set of stakeholders.

  • Balance near-term business needs with strong engineering principles by investing in foundational technical work, paying down technical debt, and making incremental improvements that deliver timely results while strengthening the platform over time.

  • Lead, hire, coach, and develop a team of engineers. Challenge them to perform effectively, expand their ownership, and grow their impact beyond their immediate scope.

  • Foster a strong culture of accountability and help the team deliver reliably and predictably for critical business stakeholders.

  • Build and nurture an inclusive team culture where every team member feels empowered, respected, and able to contribute at their best.

What we are looking for

  • Experience building and operating highly reliable platform systems that support large-scale, business-critical use cases, including 24x7 on-call responsibilities and highly available, low-latency services.

  • Strong technical acumen in distributed systems, with the ability to move between implementation details and broader architectural strategy. You will represent the team’s technical decisions credibly, evaluate assumptions, and maintain strong engineering standards.

  • Experience building and leading inclusive teams. Ability to attract and retain talent, ensure diverse perspectives inform decisions, and foster a culture of accountability where individuals take ownership while contributing to the team’s collective success.

  • Ability to create an environment of open, direct communication where team members feel comfortable giving constructive feedback, recognizing strong performance, and addressing areas that need improvement.

info.title: Solution Architect - Talent Technology Engineering
info.jobDescription:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.


This role is a horizontal architect position for HR Technology. The architect is accountable for designing and governing the foundational HR systems and integrations that HR, Talent teams rely on, across both third‑party (3P) platform. You are responsible for the North Star architecture of 3rd party systems across multiple HR domains and vendors. 


What You’ll Do


1. Architect the HR Tech Ecosystem


North Star & Strategy

  • Define and maintain the target architecture for HR technology across domains 

  • Develop a multi‑year (≈2+ years) architecture roadmap describing how HR systems, integrations, and data models evolve to support business strategy (e.g., growth, new markets, workforce models).


3P + 1P Boundary Setting

  • Determine what capabilities sit in 3P platforms versus 1P services.

  • Decide when to leverage vendor capabilities versus building differentiated 1P experiences.

  • Assess when to consolidate, sunset, or introduce vendors.

  • Establish guardrails for configuration vs customization vs 1P extensions within HR platforms.


Standardization & Paved Roads

  • Establish and own standard patterns for:

    • HR data models (e.g. positions, organizations, compensation, locations).

    • Integrations (APIs, events, batch, and file-based, where necessary).

    • Identity, entitlements, and access control across HR systems.

  • Deliver “out‑of‑the‑box” solutions and reusable templates to minimize one‑off integrations and fragile implementations.


Foundational Systems

  • Lead the architecture of foundational HR systems and services that serve as horizontal sources of truth (e.g., worker master, job catalog, HR events).

  • Ensure these systems meet requirements for completeness, correctness, timeliness, and auditability to support HR and downstream Finance/Compliance needs.

2. Data Architecture (Horizontal Across Domains)


Data Ownership & Lineage

  • Define golden sources for HR entities and how data flows into analytics, Finance, Security, and other consumers.

  • Ensure HR data is traceable, auditable, and explainable from original source to reporting and downstream usage.


Non‑Functional Requirements Embedded

  • Embed security, privacy, and regulatory requirements directly into the architecture, including:

    • Regional data residency and cross‑border data transfer considerations.

    • Role‑based access controls and least‑privilege principles.

    • Employee privacy expectations and internal policies.

  • Partner with Security, Privacy, and Legal to convert these requirements into repeatable technical patterns rather than ad‑hoc process overlays.


3. Decision-Making, Stakeholder Management & Influence

  • Engage with Talent and cross functional  partners to understand processes, pain points, and risk areas 

  • Translate business outcomes into solution architectures that are sustainable, maintainable, and aligned with long‑term strategy, not just limited by immediate tool configuration options.


Influence 

  • Provide architectural direction to engineering teams building 1P services and integrations.

  • Review solution designs and identify approaches that conflict with the target architecture.

  • Enable vertical/domain teams to focus on business needs by ensuring the horizontal foundations are robust and well‑defined.

  • Represent the HR architecture to 3P vendors and partners.

  • Evaluate and, where necessary, challenge vendor proposals that increase complexity, create lock‑in, or duplicate existing 1P capabilities without clear benefit.


Making Trade‑Offs

  • Make explicit, documented decisions on:

    • Short‑term HR needs versus long‑term ecosystem health and simplification.

    • Level of customization versus maintainability, scalability, and upgradeability.

  • Document decisions and rationale and be prepared to revisit them when new evidence emerges.


4. Execution & Ownership

  • Identify opportunities to rationalize redundant tools, platforms, and integrations.

  • Propose and lead decommissioning efforts for low‑value, high‑cost, or overlapping components.

  • Champion an architectural approach that reduces complexity, improves reliability, and lowers total cost of ownership across the HR technology landscape.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8–12+ years in enterprise engineering/architecture roles, with significant time as a Solutions / HR Tech / ERP architect or equivalent.

  • Hands-on experience architecting ecosystems with multiple 3P HR systems and custom 1P services.

  • Deep understanding of at least one major HCM or HR suite (Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, etc.), including integrations and extension patterns.

  • Understanding of Modern integration patterns and data modeling for people/HR domains, and security, privacy, and compliance expectations around employee data.

  • Demonstrated ability to operate as a horizontal architect serving multiple teams.

  • Influence and challenge senior stakeholders (HR, Eng, vendors) with clear, data-driven arguments.

  • Make non-obvious architectural trade-offs and live with the consequences.

To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. info.title: Software Engineer L4/5, Javascript Foundations
info.jobDescription:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

Who We Are We are the JavaScript Foundations (JSF) team in Warsaw. We are key partners in building the "UI Paved Road" at Netflix, operating within a global, virtual organisation that shepherds JavaScript across the entire company — from the browser to Node.js services powering our studio and streaming systems.

Our Mission Our product isn't a single app — it’s the developer experience itself. While our sibling teams focus on specific layers of the stack — Node.js Platform on server runtime, UI DevEx on browser runtime, and Design Systems on visual components — we tackle the foundational language-level challenges that unify them all. We own the strategy for dependency management, supply chain security, and TypeScript, ensuring the ecosystem remains healthy, secure, and modern across both browser and server.

Why It Matters At our scale — serving hundreds of millions members — "foundational" means high-impact. Whether it’s automating annual Node.js LTS migrations for thousands of services or defining the patterns for how we share code across the fleet, we measure our success by the collective velocity of every UI engineer at Netflix. We tackle language-level problems so they can focus on entertaining the world.

About This Role

  • Deeply understand how developers use JavaScript at Netflix to create the optimal solutions and abstractions for their use cases, and to help drive and evolve recommended practices

  • Collaborate with teams internally and in the JavaScript community to shepherd and evolve the JavaScript vision at Netflix

  • Provide and integrate libraries, tools, or workflows that enable developers to build JavaScript software efficiently

  • Reconcile the needs of our internal ecosystem against the trends of the external ecosystem

  • Define and improve the dependency management, packaging, and publishing story for Node.js

  • Address complex architectural problems with simple, intuitive designs

  • Drive adoption of new technology into existing complex systems

Excelling In This Role

  • You collaborate effectively with a variety of stakeholder groups: customers, partners, and the external JavaScript community

  • You build and maintain strong relationships across stakeholder groups through continuous feedback loops to ensure high alignment in our investments

  • You create clarity and drive alignment across stakeholder groups on technical and non-technical initiatives 

  • You are a curious and proactive learner that seeks to minimize assumptions and seeks to deeply understand before writing code or taking action

  • You thrive in an ambiguous environment and can self-manage and self-prioritize your time, energy, and resources

  • You are a storyteller and can weave a narrative joining the Netflix ecosystem with the external ecosystem

The team anchors on the human-facing elements of technology. These elements are emphasized in our Culture Memo and are applied in our day-to-day work. Code is a very small slice of this team's impact.

Our new tier allows us to attract new members at a lower price point, while also creating a compelling path for advertisers to reach audiences that are deeply engaged. We wrapped up our first three years of the journey and are well into year four with more exciting things to come!

Ads Platform Org

The Ads Platform Engineering org builds advertising systems and integrations that power the delivery of ads using our world-class content delivery ecosystem. We use a number of Netflix investments and innovations to power our ads - a unique mix of client and server-side ad insertions, state-of-the-art content delivery systems, ad encoding recipes, content understanding and metadata, etc. We deliver ads in a manner that’s thoughtful of our member’s viewing experience and drive great outcomes for advertisers. We also ensure that advertiser brand safety is ensured during serving, members only see the most appropriate ads for them.

About Our Team

The Campaign Management & Media Planning team is central to orchestrating the end-to-end campaign lifecycle and media planning capabilities for Netflix’s advertising business. We are building innovative, in-house ad tech solutions that empower advertisers and internal stakeholders to seamlessly plan, launch, monitor, and optimize campaigns at scale. Our systems serve as the bridge between advertiser intent and ad delivery, enabling seamless integration, automation, optimization, compliance adherence, troubleshooting, and management of advertising campaigns. We closely collaborate with partner teams across Order Management, Creatives, Audiences, Forecasting, Measurement, Reporting, and more to facilitate effective campaign management and media planning on behalf of our members, advertisers, and Netflix.

The team focuses on a few key areas in those domains 

  • Building applications and APIs that support every stage of the media planning process, from initial plan creation and inventory allocation through to campaign activation and completion.

  • Building applications for full-cycle campaign management - from setup through to monitoring and troubleshooting through to completion.

  • Building applications to facilitate the setup and execution of ads on Live Events

  • Providing transparency on performance as well as delivering actionable insights and recommendations to users

  • Collaborating with other stakeholders across Ads Platform (Engineering, Product, Data Science, and Design) to build solutions that will provide leverage for our technology and business.

Our team is new and yet faced with the enormous ambitions of building highly performant advertising systems and delivering high impact to our business by monetizing our incredible slate of content. As one of the newest entrants in the Connected TV advertising space that’s rapidly growing, we seek to build unique value propositions that help us differentiate from the competition and become a market leader in record time.

We are looking for highly motivated engineers working in the advertising space who are excited to join us on this journey.

Skills & experience we’re seeking:

  • 7+ years of experience, 4+ years of experience in Ads domain

  • Broad knowledge of ad tech and advertising landscape, programmatic advertising, and digital marketing trends.

  • Familiarity with the full campaign lifecycle - from pre-flight, to in-flight, to post-flight. 

  • Experience in building first party tools, APIs and services that leverage data and real-time insights to support media planning and campaign management workflows.

  • Familiarity with the main aspects required for a successful campaign - including, but not limited to Audiences, Creatives, Measurement, Forecasting, Ad Serving, Reporting, Billing, and OMS.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

Nice to haves:

  • Working knowledge of AI/ML/GenAI techniques and an ability to apply them to everything from optimizing Ad Ops workflows to building MCPs

  • Experience working in the CTV space and knowledge of its unique constraints

 

Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $499,000.00 - $820,000.00.

Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits.
