info.title: Pan-APAC Communications Manager- Advertising, Partnerships & Internal Communications
info.jobDescription:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

It's an amazing time to join the Netflix team in APAC as we continue to transform entertainment and bring our region’s stories to audiences around the world.

This role sits at the intersection of Netflix's ads story, a diverse set of APAC businesses and markets, and the people inside Netflix — and will be responsible for connecting those dots.

The Team:

Communications at Netflix represents a seasoned group of professionals shaping and telling the story of Netflix as the global leader in streaming entertainment. The work of this team is critical in illustrating the company’s success and reinforcing our reputation in a fast-changing, complex and competitive global landscape. We tell compelling stories about our Netflix titles, brand and local initiatives, working closely with advertising, partnerships, content, policy, publicity, production, and other functions to infuse these stories with their efforts.

Role Overview:

We are seeking a Manager to lead our advertising and partnerships communications in APAC and oversee internal communications across the region.

This role will serve as the regional communications lead for Netflix's advertising business across APAC, connecting our global advertising communications strategy with the needs and opportunities of our local markets. They will partner closely with regional Ads leaders and cross-functional teams, identify stories and opportunities that can travel across the region, and equip local communications teams to tell compelling stories about Netflix's advertising business in their markets.

They should have a strong understanding of the advertising ecosystem and how to leverage communications channels all across APAC, especially Korea, Japan, Australia, and China. Proficiency in Mandarin and English is an advantage, and candidates with a proven track record of new media and social-first storytelling will be preferred.

In addition, the role will lead our internal communications activity across the region — helping APAC staff understand global and regional priorities, feel connected to leadership with regular programs and events, and stay inspired by creative internal campaigns.

The ideal candidate will be a strategic thinker, a strong communicator, and a relationship builder, who can be a trusted partner and adviser to teams across multiple disciplines. This role will create and manage communications strategies, including pitches, announcements, and executive comms both internally and externally (closely partnering with our Regional Leadership Team).  

As Manager, Advertising, Partnerships & Internal Communications - Pan APAC, you will:

  • Craft press narratives and leverage regional storytelling opportunities to shape perceptions across APAC around our ads business and capabilities

  • Be the regional touchpoint for advertising communications — working with local comms and advertising teams to shape story angles and translate business strategy into communications strategy

  • Serve as a trusted communications partner to APAC Ads leaders and cross-functional teams across Sales, Marketing, Measurement, Product and other functions, bringing communications counsel and an informed regional point of view to business priorities

  • Support communications for Netflix's growing Export Ads business, partnering closely with the Singapore-based business team to build the narrative and communications strategy for Mainland China and other export markets

  • Develop and nurture business media relationships, with a deep understanding of the regional press landscape and targeted pitching strategies

  • Be the connective tissue with global advertising comms — ensuring best practice across the region and identifying relevant global opportunities for local teams

  • Touchpoint for our partnership announcements across the region — working closely with the Partnerships team and third party suppliers on a range of bundles and deals.

  • Draft communications plans, announcements, briefing materials, and messaging documents

  • Leveraging locally-led brand partnerships, consumer products, and live experiences to highlight the creativity and innovation within APAC

  • Lead internal communications across APAC — helping employees understand regional and global priorities, strengthening connection with leadership, and developing creative programs that build context and connection across our geographically diverse teams

  • Raise the team's collective capability by applying and sharing AI-driven approaches to reputation monitoring, pitching, drafting, and workflow efficiency

This role is based in Singapore, and reports to the Director, Communications - Pan-APAC.

The candidate must:

  • Have 10+ years of experience in advertising and/or corporate communications

  • Have established working media relationships at trade, entertainment, consumer, and business outlets, along with a keen interest in non-traditional and emerging media channels

  • Clear and concise communication style; strong written and verbal skills that can effectively convey complex ideas

  • Strong ability to work cross-functionally, collaborate with a range of teams across the business to deliver shared impact, and clearly communicate broader business priorities to the wider team

  • Comfort translating technical or product-driven concepts (e.g., ad tech, agentic AI tools) into clear external narratives, partnering effectively with product and technology communications counterparts

  • Be comfortable communicating with both external and internal audiences, including partnering with senior leaders to translate business priorities into clear, engaging communications

  • Experience handling a high volume of complex projects and tasks for multiple people and teams while simultaneously managing competing priorities

  • A curious and ambitious self-starter with an interest in what drives conversation and how Netflix can be at the forefront of ads innovation. 

  • Have a point of view, and be able to offer a unique perspective and voice.

Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Netflix Korea Photo & AV Studio team is seeking a creative and experienced Manager to lead the development and execution of photo and AV assets for Netflix original titles. In this role, you will shape the visual identity of our titles from the production phase onward, driving fan excitement and supporting 360-degree marketing campaigns.

Is This You?

Do you get your adrenaline pumping watching behind-the-scenes action of your favorite series? Do you find yourself diving into social media and publications just to catch every making-of story and photo? If the answer is a resounding “Yes!”, then the Photo & AV Studio team may be perfect for you.

At its heart, Photo & AV Studio is about telling stories. Our ideal candidate is a creative, strategic, and solution-oriented storyteller who brings seasoned communication skills and excels at multi-tasking in a fast-paced environment, driven by a passion for capturing the essence of our content.

The Role

The Photo & AV Studio Manager will lead the on-set coverage strategy of Korean Original title productions, including series, films, unscripted and live. With strong cross-functional partnerships across multiple departments — from marketing to product and content — the Manager is responsible for bringing to life the on-set creative needs of a title campaign.

 

The role requires a high level of creativity, an inquisitive and innovative personality, strong project management, and an editorial background attuned to great visual storytelling. This role works across photo and video content, utilizing knowledge of TV and film productions, talent and filmmaker relations, marketing strategies to shape, enhance and support Marketing and Publicity campaigns across the globe.

 

Having a strong creative storyteller’s instinct that can pivot through the unpredictability of production is key to success in Photo & AV Studio.

* Please submit your portfolio when applying for this role. If the file is too large to upload, please include a link to your portfolio in your resume.

Key to being a successful Photo & AV Studio Manager is as follows:

  • Having a strong creative storyteller’s instinct to shape campaign identity

  • Ability to see the bigger picture of the campaign and drive strategic, high-impact creative solutions 

  • Bridging on-set intelligence with stakeholders to optimize resources and drive campaign success 

Responsibilities of the role include:

  • Develop content strategies in collaboration with your cross-functional partners in Marketing, Publicity, Social, Product and Content to align on the title-specific creative needs

  • Leverage your deep editorial and creative expertise to solve business opportunities through authentic visual storytelling and compelling photo and audio-visual assets

  • Optimize the production cycle to meet the creative needs, while driving seamless communication from set to key stakeholders   

  • Lead the creation of engaging narratives that tell the “story behind the story”, conducting in-depth interviews with on-screen and off-screen talent to shape narratives that elevate the campaign

  • Read scripts to plan, hire, and supervise unit photographers and video crews for capturing the best on-set assets, while fostering strong industry relationships

  • Produce photo and video content for editorial photoshoots and events that drive campaign messaging and foster conversation

Skills and Requirements:

  • 10+ years of experience as a content creator, creative producer, art director at an entertainment and lifestyle company, media outlet. Marketing and/ or PR experience is a plus

  • Strong creative eye with a keen understanding of visual storytelling in the service of audience-first communication strategies

  • Understand and have contacts in the photography and video industries in Korea and working knowledge of digital media file specs and size formats

  • Extensive knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite is a plus

  • Business level fluency in English is required

info.title: Associate Counsel - Korea
info.jobDescription:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

The opportunity

We are looking for a talented and business-minded counsel to join the Netflix Legal team in Seoul.

This role offers a unique opportunity to support Netflix’s fastest-growing and most dynamic business areas in Korea, including Advertising, Consumer Products, and Marketing/Brand Partnerships. Sitting at the intersection of structuring complex B2B transactions and navigating evolving regulatory landscapes, you will provide strategic legal solutions to help launch and scale new initiatives.

This position is ideal for an agile attorney who is prepared to lead innovative business models from the ground up and handle strategies within a highly collaborative, fast-paced environment.

The role will report to the Korea MACC (Marcomms, Ads, and Consumer Products) Legal Lead, based in Seoul, Korea.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • End-to-End Deal Execution: Draft, review, negotiate, execute, and manage a wide range of B2B commercial agreements supporting Netflix’s growth initiatives in Korea, including consumer products and marketing/brand partnerships — independently or under supervision as appropriate.

  • Advertising Business Support: Provide comprehensive legal support to Netflix’s advertising business in Korea by structuring and negotiating agreements with advertising agencies, advertisers, measurement partners, and third-party ad-tech service providers.

  • Strategic Business Partnership: Serve as a legal partner to the advertising, consumer products, and marketing/brand partnerships teams, providing practical, business-oriented advice on deal structures, risk allocation, rights, sponsorship frameworks, and new ad products.

  • Regulatory Compliance: Provide clear and pragmatic guidance on Korean advertising regulations—including consumer protection, fair labeling, and promotional standards—effectively translating regulatory requirements into actionable business recommendations.

  • IP Portfolio Advisory: Advise on usage rights, restrictions, and approvals related to Netflix’s intellectual property portfolio (trademarks, logos, content clips, talent likeness, and brand assets) in connection with commercial and marketing activities.

  • Global & Regional Alignment: Collaborate closely with global and regional legal teams to align local transactions with Netflix’s broader business objectives and policies, while appropriately localizing legal approaches for the Korean market.

  • Operational Excellence: Develop, maintain, and continuously improve contracting processes, scalable templates, and playbooks to enable efficient deal-making in an evolving business environment.

  • Insights & Knowledge Management: Monitor and track deal structures, key risk profiles, and evolving legal trends in new business domains to contribute to the team’s long-term knowledge management.

Requirements:

 The successful candidate will have 4+ years of relevant legal experience, either in-house and/or at a leading law firm, with a bar membership in good standing in at least one jurisdiction (Korea preferred).  

The role requires excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Korean, and the ability to translate complex legal and regulatory issues into clear, practical, and business-oriented advice for a wide range of stakeholders. Given the highly cross-functional nature of the role, strong collaboration, influence, and interpersonal skills are essential.
 

The ideal candidate should also be able to demonstrate the following:  

  • Proven experience drafting, negotiating, and managing B2B commercial agreements in English, preferably including licensing or strategic partnership agreements.

  • Strong capabilities in navigating local regulations and industry standards, with the ability to advise on compliance in a practical, business-enabling manner.

  • Solid working knowledge of intellectual property rights, including trademarks, copyrights, and brand usage, and experience advising on usage rights, restrictions, and approvals in commercial and marketing contexts.

  • Sound legal judgment and analytical skills to balance legal considerations effectively with strategic business objectives.

  • Ability to independently manage multiple matters simultaneously, maintaining strict attention to detail under tight timelines.

  • Comfort working with global templates and cross-border stakeholders, ensuring appropriate localization for the Korean market

  • Intellectual curiosity and an eagerness to take on evolving areas, including emerging advertising products, technologies, and new business models.

  • High standards of professional ethics, integrity, and discretion, and alignment with Netflix’s culture and values.(see Netflix’s culture memo)

info.title: Promotional Assets Project Manager, Launch Operations
info.jobDescription:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

The Opportunity

Netflix is looking for an operationally strong project manager to join the Launch Operations team, supporting asset production and traffic management across our portfolio of Netflix Original titles.

You will be part of a larger Launch Operations team that manages end-to-end title launches across the globe. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced coordinator to help Netflix bring creative assets to life on the service. 

In this role, you will partner with internal teams and external agencies, and vendors to build project plans, track milestones, and coordinate parallel asset workstreams to ensure timely, launch-ready asset delivery and accuracy.

 What You’ll Do:

  • Coordinate the fulfillment and trafficking of media assets (artwork images, promotional AV, etc.) from intake through final, launch-ready delivery

  • Support milestone and timeline development for asset workflows and align cross-functional partners to shared plans

  • Partner closely with internal teams (creative, product, marketing, merchandising) and external agencies or vendors to ensure requirements and context are clearly communicated

  • Serve as a primary operational point of contact for agencies and vendors, including access provisioning, tooling setup, and workflow guidance

  • Support high-security or sensitive projects by helping manage access controls, asset handling requirements, and compliance with Netflix standards

  • Maintain and regularly update trackers, dashboards, and task management queues to ensure asset workflows remain on track

  • Track versions, specifications, dependencies, and approvals across the asset lifecycle

  • Surface risks early and support the resolution of escalated issues related to asset delivery, quality, or timing

  • Become fluent in Netflix tooling to set up, ingest, track, approve/reject, and troubleshoot assets across the delivery pipeline

  • Support post-launch and live servicing asset needs, including non-standard or high-context requests

  • Create, maintain, and contribute to workflow documentation, specifications, and operational guidance

  • Execute a high volume of concurrent, detail-oriented tasks with accuracy, speed, and sound judgment

What You’ll Need:

  • 4 - 6+ years of experience in media asset operations, production coordination, or project coordination

  • Proven ability to manage high-volume workflows across multiple timelines and stakeholders

  • Strong attention to detail, follow-through, and operational rigor

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving environment

  • Excellent organizational and task-management skills

  • Hands-on experience using workflow and tracking tools such as Airtable, Asana, Monday.com, or similar

  • Experience working closely with creative agencies and managed-service vendors

info.title: Senior Data Scientist 5 - Media Science
info.jobDescription:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

Our Content business is responsible for weighing trade-offs between budget, schedules, and quality across the movies and shows we produce all around the world. The Media Science DSE team uses data to help the business navigate those decisions with clarity. Our metric frameworks and analysis directly shape how we enable creative teams to produce the best movies and shows for our members.

EMEA is a growing hub within our broader Data & Insights org, and we are looking for a stunning Senior Data Scientist based in Amsterdam to join our growing Studio Production DSE team. In this role, you will partner with Product Management and cross-functional product teams, Finance & Strategy, and Content Operations & Innovation leadership to scale and innovate content creation workflows. Through thoughtful metric research and causal inference modeling, you will have the opportunity to directly influence decision-making around how we produce and innovate on global content production - helping Creatives bring their best vision to life on screen.

As a Senior Data Scientist in this space, you will:

  • Be the second Applied Inference Data Scientist in Media Science Data Science & Engineering, helping shape how the discipline shows up and drives impact in Studio Production

  • Be a strategic thought partner for Content & Business Product PMs, Content Operations & Innovation leaders and teams, Finance & Strategy, and AI Innovation & Strategy DSE – scoping ambiguous, greenfield questions and proposing data science approaches where no playbook exists

  • Identify metric research and causal inference opportunities to assess the impact of media innovation efforts and improve the efficiency and effectiveness of media creation

  • Help Studio navigate cost, time, and quality trade-offs by delivering research that connects production decisions to member and business outcomes

  • Own your research agenda end to end - from design and execution on causal analysis through to interpretation and dissemination

  • Present your research and findings clearly to both technical and non-technical partners, translating complex analysis into decisions leadership can act on

  • Build and maintain strong partnerships with a variety of business and product stakeholders, working directly with them to introduce and influence data-informed ways of working

  • Collaborate with exceptional Data Scientists and Analytics Engineers in-region and globally to explore our operational data and uncover insights that help creative teams produce even better shows and movies for our members

  • Serve as a regional expert on Studio Data Science & Engineering, helping educate and connect regional offices to existing research and data solutions from across the team

About you:

  • Advanced degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Economics, or related quantitative field

  • 5+ years of relevant experience with a variety of causal inference methods, including quasi-experimental designs and managing complexities around smaller sample sizes

  • Strong statistical knowledge and intuition, utilized in observational causal analysis and applied machine learning settings, with demonstrated business impact

  • An expert in SQL and Python

  • Proven track record wrangling data, performing exploratory data analysis, designing metrics and tests, building causal inference solutions, and articulating data stories to deliver meaningful business impact

  • Strong verbal and written communicator who can develop and deepen effective relationships with a wide variety of stakeholders and communicate technical concepts clearly and concisely to less technical audiences

  • A self-starter with a learning mindset who is exceptionally curious – eagerly diving into new spaces and bringing informed ideas to the table

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and a fast-paced environment; able to take ownership and thrive with minimal oversight and process

  • Thrilled about innovating in the Content Production domain via novel experimental techniques and comfortable taking (smart) risks in your work

  • Extensive experience within the EMEA region, adept at working across different cultures on a globally-distributed team, collaborating with fellow team members and partners to ideate on and deliver impactful research

  • Netflix culture resonates with you

  • Plus: Experience creating data products and dashboards such as Tableau

  • Plus: Designing and analyzing A/B tests

Culture

You will have the opportunity to impact the business in a meaningful way, working alongside smart people who love to solve hard problems, and who not only expect but also foster high performance. You will have the freedom to innovate, solve interesting problems, and influence decision-making in a fast-paced, exciting environment. info.title: Senior Manager, Change Management & Technology Enablement - Finance PMO
info.jobDescription:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

In this newly created, high-impact role within our Finance Program Management Office (PMO), you will serve as the architect and champion of change management across our portfolio of Finance transformation programs. This includes defining how the Finance PMO approaches change - establishing frameworks, standards, and toolkits that become the backbone of every project we run - and cultivating a small, high-performing team of change professionals, fostering a culture of excellence and continuous development.

As a visible, strategic partner to program managers, business stakeholders, and Finance leadership, you will translate complex transformations into clear, human-centered adoption experiences that stick. The role is accountable for the full change journey - from stakeholder analysis and impact assessment to training, readiness validation, and go-live sustainment - and leverages strong Finance process expertise to understand and manage impacts on Finance teams and the wider organization.

The position operates at both the strategic level (designing frameworks, advising leadership) and the tactical level (building detailed comms plans, running workshops, tracking adoption metrics, etc.). You understand that technology only delivers value when people actually use it - and you make that happen.

This is a hybrid position that can be based in either Los Angeles or Los Gatos and offers the flexibility to work remotely part-time. Occasional travel may be required to other office locations, including internationally.

Responsibilities

Change Management Practice & Framework

  • Define and own the Finance PMO change management methodology - establishing a scalable, repeatable framework (tools, templates, and standards) that elevates the consistency and quality of change delivery across all PMO-led programs.

  • Develop and maintain a library of reusable change management artifacts: stakeholder analysis templates, change impact assessment frameworks, communication plan structures, readiness survey toolkits, RACI models, and training design guides.

  • Act as the internal expert and coach on change management best practices; build change capability across the PMO team and broader Finance organization so that change management becomes a core competency, not a one-off activity.

  • Benchmark against industry frameworks (e.g., Prosci/ADKAR, Kotter, McKinsey Influence Model) and adapt them pragmatically to Netflix's culture and operating model.

Portfolio Change Management

  • Provide holistic change management strategies across the Finance PMO project portfolio - ensuring that change impacts are assessed, sequenced, and managed at the portfolio level, not just the individual project level.

  • Lead change management on significant, high-visibility PMO initiatives from end to end: scope change impact assessments, develop and execute communication plans, manage stakeholder engagement, design and oversee training programs, and conduct readiness assessments prior to go-live.

  • Proactively identify change saturation risks across the portfolio - flagging moments when concurrent programs may overwhelm stakeholder groups - and recommend sequencing or pacing adjustments to protect adoption outcomes.

  • Partner closely with Finance PMO Senior Program Managers and Program Managers to integrate change management activities into project plans, ensuring change is never treated as an afterthought.

  • Manage and track change management deliverables across the portfolio; provide regular reporting on change health, adoption progress, and stakeholder sentiment to PMO leadership.

People Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead, develop, and retain a team of direct reports; set clear performance expectations, provide consistent coaching, and conduct formal performance management with transparency and care.

  • Build a culture of high standards - holding the team to rigorous craft while creating the psychological safety needed for iteration and growth.

  • Manage team capacity across the portfolio; make deliberate prioritization calls when demand exceeds bandwidth and escalate tradeoffs clearly to PMO leadership.

  • Build change management capability across the broader Finance PMO — coaching program managers and business partners to embed change thinking into their work, extending the team's reach without extending headcount.

Stakeholder Experience & Communications

  • Build strong relationships with Finance stakeholders to gain deep understanding and awareness of their unique needs.

  • Design stakeholder engagement strategies that go beyond information sharing — creating experiences that build genuine understanding, confidence, and commitment to change.

  • Develop executive-ready communications, leadership roadmaps, and briefing materials that equip sponsors and Finance leaders to actively champion change.

  • Build and execute comprehensive global communication plans for Finance transformation programs — spanning emails, FAQs, newsletters, town halls, presentations, and digital channels — coordinating with internal communications partners to align messaging and timing.

  • Conduct and analyze readiness assessments, pulse surveys, and feedback mechanisms to continuously gauge stakeholder sentiment; translate insights into action plans that address resistance and close adoption gaps.

  • Develop and maintain stakeholder maps, resistance registers, and engagement trackers to ensure no impacted group is overlooked.

Training & Capability Building

  • Develop training strategy for Finance transformation programs - encompassing needs analysis, content design, delivery planning (live, virtual, self-paced), and post-training reinforcement.

  • Build and deploy train-the-trainer programs that extend change management and technology enablement capacity across the Finance organization, empowering super users and business champions.

  • Measure training effectiveness and adoption outcomes; apply data-driven insights to iterate and improve enablement approaches.

  • Partner with Finance subject matter experts, product teams, and L&D resources to develop high-quality training materials, job aids, and quick-reference guides that support sustainable change.

GenAI Adoption & Technology Enablement

  • Lead team members in the change management and adoption strategy for GenAI across the FinOps organization - ensuring that AI tools and intelligent automation solutions are embraced, embedded, and sustained by Finance teams.

  • Partner with the Finance GenAI Champions, product, and engineering to design adoption pathways for new AI capabilities; translate technical rollouts into compelling business change journeys that prioritize the user experience.

  • Lead team members in the development and execution of GenAI upskilling and enablement programs for Finance - including needs assessments, learning curricula, train-the-trainer programs, and self-serve learning resources - to build a GenAI-fluent FinOps workforce.

  • Report on GenAI adoption metrics across FinOps; use adoption data to diagnose resistance, surface barriers, and drive targeted interventions that accelerate value realization.

Qualifications

Required

  • 10+ years of experience in change management, organizational change, or transformation enablement, with at least 3 years leading change management on large-scale, cross-functional programs in a Finance or technology-oriented environment.

  • Proven ability to design and implement change management frameworks, methodologies, and toolkits from the ground up — not just apply pre-built approaches.

  • Deep understanding of core Finance processes — Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Record to Report, and Planning, Budgeting & Forecasting — and the change dynamics unique to Finance transformation programs.

  • Demonstrated experience leading Finance technology adoption initiatives, ideally including enterprise systems (ERP), AI, automation.

  • Demonstrated experience managing and developing a team of direct reports: setting performance expectations and coaching individuals to growth.

  • Strong executive communication and storytelling skills — able to distill complex changes into clear, compelling narratives for diverse audiences ranging from frontline users to C-suite.

  • Expertise in developing and executing multi-channel communication plans and stakeholder engagement strategies for global, cross-functional audiences.

  • Experience designing and delivering training programs, including train-the-trainer models, with the ability to adapt delivery to diverse learning needs.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage change at a portfolio level — balancing multiple concurrent programs and proactively identifying change saturation risks.

  • Exceptional facilitation skills; experience designing and leading workshops, readiness assessments, and cross-functional alignment sessions.

  • Strong analytical mindset — able to design adoption metrics, interpret data, and use insights to refine change strategies.

info.title: Engineering Manager - Ads Campaign Management
info.jobDescription:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Since launching our ad-supported tier in 2022, the momentum has been unstoppable—we reach over 94 million global monthly active users! As we enter our fourth year, our ambition is massive, and we are just getting started.

Our Team

The Ads Engineering team at Netflix is dedicated to creating a world-class advertising ecosystem that drives our advertising business. This team's mission is to develop advanced technology that ensures exceptional experiences for both our members and advertisers. Our responsibilities encompass a broad spectrum of products, ranging from sales and media planning to optimizing advertiser outcomes and execution. This includes inventory and order management, campaign execution, ad serving, audience and identity management, measurement, reporting, and finance.

We use several Netflix investments and innovations - a unique mix of client and server-side ad insertions, state-of-the-art content delivery systems, ad encoding recipes, content understanding, and metadata, etc. We deliver ads in a manner that’s thoughtful of our member’s viewing experience and drive great outcomes for advertisers. We also ensure that advertiser brand safety is ensured during serving so that members only see the most appropriate ads for them.

Our team is faced with the enormous ambitions of building highly performant advertising systems and delivering high impact to our business by monetizing our incredible slate of content. As one of the newest entrants in the Connected TV advertising space that’s rapidly growing, we seek to build unique value propositions that help us differentiate us and become a market leader in record time. Our roles come with expectations of delivering in a rapid clip,  comfort with  lofty goals and big ambitions,   the visibility that comes with strategic initiatives, and  responsibility and an appetite to operate like a startup within an established company.

The Ads Campaign Management team is responsible for our in-house Order Management System (OMS) used by our account managers to facilitate the booking and execution of advertising campaigns on behalf of Agencies, Brands, and Advertisers. The team owns key parts of our campaign hierarchy (Orders, Line Items) and closely intersects with almost every other team across Ads Engineering (Creatives, Forecasting, Audiences, Measurement, Ad Serving, etc)  as well as business teams across Account Management and Ad Operations to facilitate the set-up, execution, and monitoring of ads across the Netflix ecosystem. 
 

As an Engineering Manager you will:

  • Drive success in a fast paced, flat organization with minimal process and a heavy emphasis on ownership.

  • Support your team by contextualizing the larger vision, enabling prioritization and fostering high focus and executional excellence.

  • Operate as an ambassador of the Netflix Culture

  • Create a dream team by hiring, retaining, and growing high performing talent.

Skills & experience we’re seeking:

  • Experience designing and building campaign management systems used by ad operations teams, advertisers, and agencies for campaign setup, trafficking, and lifecycle management across multiple sales channels (direct, programmatic, self-serve, etc.).

  • Proven ability to deliver APIs and user interfaces that enable campaign creation, editing, flighting, targeting, and budget management for both simple and complex campaign structures.

  • Experience building monitoring and troubleshooting tools to ensure campaign integrity, enforce business rules, and provide transparency into campaign status, pacing, and delivery performance.

  • Familiarity with workflow automation, approval processes, and SLA tracking to streamline campaign launch and reduce operational friction for internal and external stakeholders.

  • Demonstrated success in leveraging data and ML-driven insights for campaign optimization to maximize advertiser outcomes.

  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including sales, ad operations, product, measurement, and engineering to drive continuous improvement and innovation in campaign management capabilities.

  • Experience with building modern backend and frontend applications on cloud / AWS  using Java, Spring Boot, React, GraphQL, Node.js or equivalent technologies. Experience with distributed systems and microservices, NoSQL databases, queues like Apache Kafka and a solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.

  • Track record of building and leading high-performing engineering teams, setting technical direction, and delivering complex platform initiatives

  • Ability to navigate ambiguity and define clear strategies in a fast-evolving ads landscape

  • Excellent communication skills; you can explain complex systems to both technical and non-technical partners

  • 10+ years of total experience with 3+ years of management experience in building and leading diverse software engineering teams. 

  • A strong product mindset along with experience in delivering large complex projects collaborating with a variety of cross-functional stakeholders that are technology, operations or business focused.

  • General understanding of the advertising marketplace and landscape. 

  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking with demonstrated product sense and leadership in the working environment

Nice to haves:

  • Familiarity with legal compliance and changing landscape of ads regulations around the world.

  • Familiarity with ML and advertising systems that leverage data to drive optimal outcomes for the users and the business.

  • Experience working in the CTV space and knowledge of its unique constraints

info.title: Engineering Director - Partner Enablement Applications
info.jobDescription:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

The Client and Partner Technologies (CPT) organization is chartered with enabling brilliant Netflix experiences on devices and building the foundational client systems and tools that make those experiences possible. Within CPT, the Partner Enablement Apps (PEA) group builds and evolves our suite of web applications that power the lifecycle of our device and payments partnerships.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an Engineering Director to lead and scale the Partner Enablement Apps engineering organization. This group develops business‑to‑business applications that enable our device partners (TVs, streaming sticks, set‑top boxes, and other “10‑foot” devices) and operator partners (ISPs, telcos, TV and mobile carriers) to integrate with Netflix APIs, manage device and service lifecycles, and operate Partner Payment experiences (including bundling Netflix with their offerings). Our tools are used both by external partners and by Netflix teams to integrate, launch, operate, monitor, update, and retire partner experiences at scale.

In this role, you’ll drive the long‑term technical strategy, organizational health, and delivery excellence across multiple teams, ensuring our partner and internal experiences are reliable, intuitive, and ready for the next generation of integrations.

The Team

You will lead a growing engineering organization that is primarily based in Warsaw, Poland and includes team members in the United States, Brazil, Netherlands, and Taiwan. The organization currently consists of four domains and requires building strong relationships across time zones and fostering a cohesive, high-performing culture despite geographic distribution.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Define and drive the long-term technical vision and roadmap for Enablement Applications, aligning with broader Netflix objectives

  • Partner with Product Managers, Designers, and senior leadership across wider organization and cross-functional stakeholders to influence organizational strategy and prioritization

  • Identify opportunities for innovation and platform evolution that will scale to support Netflix's next hundred million customers

  • Own the technical and organizational strategy for migrating and deprecating legacy services while maintaining operational excellence

People Leadership & Organizational Development

  • Build, mentor, and retain a world-class engineering team, including hiring and developing engineering managers and senior individual contributors

  • Create an environment where engineers at all levels can do the best work of their careers

  • Foster a culture of continuous learning, psychological safety, and engineering excellence

  • Champion diversity and inclusion, ensuring all team members can thrive regardless of background

  • Provide thoughtful coaching and career development support tailored to individual growth needs

Technical Excellence & Delivery

  • Establish and maintain a strong, mature foundation for core services across all Enablement Apps:

    • Comprehensive testing strategies (unit, integration, automated testing)

    • Robust monitoring, alerting, and observability

    • Scalable and sustainable on-call support models

    • Data quality and engineering best practices

  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners to design and implement scalable, performant, and reliable solutions

  • Stay current with industry trends, tools, and technologies, assessing their relevance and driving adoption where appropriate

Operational Excellence

  • Own reliability and support for Partner Enablement Applications, including first-tier support for internal and external partners

  • Drive operational maturity through metrics, SLOs, and continuous improvement initiatives

  • Balance innovation with stability, ensuring the team delivers value while maintaining system health

Cross-Functional Partnership

This is a highly collaborative role with partners across multiple time zones. While the cross-functional partners make every effort to accommodate time zone differences, effective collaboration requires meetings outside standard local working hours. The schedule is managed flexibly to balance business needs and personal schedule. 

Travel to other organizational locations is expected several times per year to participate in leadership offsites, planning sessions, and strengthening cross-functional relationships.

  • Build strong relationships with Product, Design, Partner Engineering, and Business Development teams

  • Effectively communicate technical concepts and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders

  • Navigate complex organizational dynamics and drive alignment across distributed teams

​Requirements

Experience

  • Extensive software development experience with strong technical foundations

  • Significant experience managing managers or leading multiple teams with prior team management experience

  • Proven track record of building and scaling engineering organizations

  • Experience with distributed systems, web applications, and cloud infrastructure

Leadership & Communication

  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence at all levels of the organization

  • Strong judgment and ability to make high-quality decisions in ambiguous situations

  • Experience fostering inclusive team cultures where diverse perspectives are valued

  • Comfortable with in-office collaboration a few days per week (team and partners work in person regularly)

Technical

  • Deep understanding of full-stack engineering practices and modern software development methodologies

  • Familiarity with CI/CD systems (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Spinnaker), build tools (Gradle), and cloud platforms

  • Strong grasp of reliability engineering principles (monitoring, alerting, incident management)

  • Demonstrated success working with globally distributed teams across multiple time zones

  • Demonstrated experience or strong interest in building intelligent systems powered by AI, including agent-based architectures and task automation—moving beyond traditional enterprise web applications toward the next generation of software development.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with data platforms and analytics systems

  • Prior experience at a high-growth technology company operating at scale

Our Tech Blog, research papers, and a steady run of speaking engagements put that work in public view every year, and our engineering audience finds it. The audience we haven't reached yet feels the difference in using Netflix without seeing what produced it: designers, founders, reporters, and the wider group of people shaping where technology and culture intersect.

This opportunity calls for an editor with unusual range. You can read a technical paper on NeurIPS and come out with a headline, and you carry that incredible instinct to everything else you take in: an hour at vowels research library, an afternoon at magCulture, a thread on r/singularity where people are debating the next decade in real time. You can write about technology and are curious about it, without sounding out of touch with who the technology is for.

The job is putting that judgment to work at scale. The role runs an editorial operation: an editorial calendar our teams plan around, a review process an engineer will trust with their first paper, resilient standards, and a vision for how these stories reach people through conventional and unconventional channels.

We're hiring for judgment about what we publish, when, in what form, and who it should reach. Where you built that judgment is industry agnostic. If your background doesn't map exactly to the description below, we encourage you to apply anyway.

The Role

The Manager, Product & Technology Editorial will lead the editorial strategy and day-to-day execution across our owned technology channels, including our Tech Blog. You will drive the editorial standards and cadence for our Tech Blog, own the operational process for reviewing published papers and external speaking engagements, and partner closely with our Social and Editorial Communications leads to amplify our product and technology narratives beyond traditional press for launches.

You will partner closely with engineers and researchers publishing technical work and the broader Product & Technology Communications team to ensure our external channels consistently reflect a clear, elevated, and distinctly Netflix point of view on technology and innovation.

The role is based in our Los Angeles or New York office, with the potential to be remote for the right candidate.

Responsibilities

Tasks are strategic, timely, and varied. They include but are not limited to:

Editorial

  • Set and maintain a consistent editorial approach across our published research papers, Tech Blog articles and other critical outputs.

  • Raise the editorial bar on our owned channels — sharpening voice, standards, and structure so content reads as strategic and intentional rather than purely technical.

​

Operations

  • Own and maintain the editorial calendar, and the publishing and speaking review process, from intake through publication.

  • Identify and implement more efficient workflows for editorial review and publishing, partnering with legal, policy, and technical teams as needed.

  • Maintain consistent, repeatable processes so contributors across the org have a predictable, well-supported path to publish or speak externally.

Collaboration

  • Build and manage a close partnership with Social and Editorial Communications to develop creative approaches that extend our storytelling beyond traditional press — identifying new formats and channels for amplification.

  • Act as the connective tissue between technical contributors and our broader communications and marketing teams.

Innovation

  • Elevate our Tech Blog by developing a sharper eye for which technical work is genuinely story-worthy — surfacing and pitching the strongest candidates for elevation outside of the Tech Blog.

  • Own and execute the development of a new, ownable destination for our innovation narrative beyond existing channels.

  • Help shape new formats — digital and physical — that celebrate the technical excellence of our teams’ work to a broader audience in a creative, story-forward way that challenges conventions.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of relevant editorial, publishing, or communications operations experience across tech, innovation, entertainment, or related industries.

  • Deep fluency in sub-cultures, emerging new media platforms and well-read — you’re interested in everything from analog to digitally-native media; chronically online in the best way.

  • SEO and/or GEO fluency.

  • First principles, systems thinking; equal parts editorial instinct and operational rigor.

  • Excellent written and verbal communications, with strong editorial judgment for tone, structure, and voice.

  • Demonstrated operational excellence — adept at managing editorial calendars, review pipelines, and cross-functional coordination on tight timelines.

  • High judgment with the ability to make principled decisions, even amid ambiguity.

  • A strong point of view and the ability to effectively socialize and influence across cross-functional teams and leaders.

  • A collaborative, team-player mindset with comfort working independently and proactively.

  • A strong bias for action, curiosity, and an instinct for connecting dots across culture, innovation, and business priorities.

info.title: Video Algorithms Intern, Video Coding (Gaussian Splatting), Fall 2026
info.jobDescription:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

The Role

Gaussian Splatting (GS) is a 3D/4D scene reconstruction technique that enables photorealistic novel-view synthesis with low rendering complexity, making it attractive for deployment on consumer devices such as TVs, streaming sticks, phones, and laptops. Realizing this vision requires addressing several open technical challenges, such as a significant reduction in model training/encoding time and more efficient compression. As part of the Video Algorithms team during this 24-week Fall internship, you will help us investigate the potential of GS as a future streaming format and explore possible improvements, with a focus on building towards a practical system.

During the internship, you will:

  • Explore GS model compression strategies using open datasets

  • Contribute to early thinking on additional dataset needs for representative scenes.

  • Characterize trade-offs among GS model size, training time, and rendered quality, and quantify the gap relative to streaming-rate targets

  • Identify and experiment with strategies to reduce training/encoding time and/or to improve GS compression efficiency

  • Design and implement a proof-of-concept (PoC) that showcases GS-based rendering on content of interest

Who Are You?

  • Currently pursuing a PhD in a technical field such as Computer Science, Engineering, Math, or Statistics,  with an expected graduation date in June 2027 or later.

  • Thrives working in complex, dynamic, and fast-moving environments. 

  • Strong software development skills and feels comfortable with software engineering best practices (e.g., version control, testing, code review, etc.).

  • Successful track record in research of 3D/4D scene reconstruction, novel-view synthesis, Gaussian Splatting or NeRF, differentiable rendering, neural graphics, or 3D computer vision.

  • Solid understanding of machine learning and deep learning concepts, with hands-on experience training and evaluating ML models.

  • Able to program fluently in Python 

Nice to Have: 

  • Familiarity with real-time rendering and GPU programming (CUDA, WebGL, graphics pipelines).

  • Background in video compression, streaming systems, or codec standards such as HEVC and AV1.

  • Involvement in open-source multimedia or graphics projects.

  • Experience with large-scale distributed systems and cloud computing.

About the Role

Netflix's Creative Innovation team works at the intersection of storytelling and emerging technology, shaping how solutions like Generative AI influence production practices across the Studio and the broader industry. This role sits at the center of that work.

You will own relationships with Generative AI technology and vendor partners that support Netflix productions, understanding what they can deliver, where they're headed, and how they create value for our work. You'll also help promising, earlier-stage companies mature into partners Netflix can rely on, and work closely with Legal and Security to make sure every partnership is one we can stand behind.

  • Evaluate what partners can deliver. Understand their tools and workflows well enough to assess capability versus marketing, and translate that into recommendations Netflix teams can act on with confidence.

We want these experiences, along with merchandise offerings, to help promote love for our titles so they become part of the zeitgeist for longer periods of time and drive long-term value for Netflix.

Netflix is seeking a Manager, Experiences Retail Store Operations to lead store operations for Netflix's Direct-to-Consumer Retail, with a focus on Netflix House. This role owns store operations end-to-end: from shaping strategy with leadership, to owning the technology and tools that power the stores, to working directly with hourly Retail Crew on the floor. Reporting to the Head of Netflix Experiences Retail, this person will build the processes, systems, and standards for a new and growing retail concept, while making sure day-to-day execution is consistent, efficient, and drives revenue across locations.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working at every level, equally at home presenting a plan to senior leadership and solving a problem on the sales floor mid-shift. They can take a general goal and turn it into a clear, practical process that the Retail Crew can actually follow, and they use data to check that it's working rather than relying on instinct alone. This is a hands-on, build-it-yourself role for someone who wants to help define how a new kind of retail experience runs, including the technology behind it, not just maintain an existing system.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategy, Operating Model & Process

  • Define and evolve the store operations strategy for Netflix House and other physical retail touchpoints.

  • Design and maintain the operating model (processes, standards, and SOPs) covering daily store routines, inventory management, fan service, loss prevention, and general store administration.

  • Identify operational gaps through direct floor engagement, Crew feedback, and data analysis, and close them with practical, field-ready solutions.

  • Build, own, and track the efficacy of the loss prevention strategy.

  • Spend periodic time on-site with Retail Crew to understand real operational friction firsthand, building credibility as a partner who solves problems.

Retail Technology & Systems Ownership

  • Own the retail technology stack across venues, including point-of-sale (e.g., Shopify), RFID, inventory management, and other in-store systems and tools.

  • Lead the evaluation, selection, implementation, and ongoing optimization of retail technology to keep Netflix's stores at the forefront of the industry.

  • Partner with IT/Engineering and outside vendors to scope, test, and roll out new systems, managing transitions from planning through go-live.

Performance & Financial Insights

  • Define and monitor key store operations KPIs (inventory accuracy, shrink, sell-through, labor efficiency, guest experience) across venues.

  • Partner with Central Ops and Store Managers to optimize Retail Crew scheduling and hours, ensuring venues are appropriately staffed without overspending on labor.

  • Partner with Finance on store budgets and expense tracking; build reporting that supports leadership decision-making and surface opportunities to improve revenue, conversion, and efficiency.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Communication

  • Act as the main link between HQ strategy and what actually happens on the floor, partnering with Visual Merchandising, Merchandising, Marketing, Finance, and Tech.

  • Partner with Central Ops to ensure a unified approach from Central to onsite teams.

  • Translate cross-functional initiatives (product launches, brand activations, system changes) into clear, store-ready execution plans.

  • Own communications to venue teams, ensuring Crew stay informed without being overwhelmed.

  • Collaborate with our partner vendors and agencies to ensure work is completed on time and on budget according to our agreements.

New Venue Openings & Expansion

  • Lead operational planning and execution for new venue openings, including opening plans, timelines, staffing strategies, training schedules, and readiness checklists.

  • Travel regularly to new and existing venues to support openings, training, and operational assessments.

  • Partner with Design, Construction, Visual Merchandising, IT, and Finance to ensure venues open on time, on budget, and to brand standard.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 10+ years of retail operations experience, spanning both strategic/HQ-level work and hands-on field or store-level execution.

  • Direct, hands-on experience with retail technology systems: POS platforms (e.g., Shopify), RFID, and inventory management systems, including leading system implementations or major technology transitions.

  • Demonstrated ability to build operational structure in ambiguous, still-forming environments.

  • Data-driven mindset with experience building KPI frameworks, dashboards, and financial/operational reporting.

  • Experience writing and implementing scalable SOPs.

  • Comfortable and credible operating at every level: presenting to senior leadership and working directly alongside hourly Crew.

  • Experience leading new store/venue openings.

  • Experience in experiential, entertainment, hospitality, or non-traditional retail environments a plus.

  • Willingness to travel regularly to Retail touchpoints.

info.title: Social Manager, Ads Marketing
info.jobDescription:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

As the Ads Social Marketing Manager, you will play a pivotal role in how Netflix tells its advertising story across social platforms - reaching advertisers, agencies, and industry partners with the same creative instinct and storytelling craft we bring to consumer social. The line between B2B and consumer content is disappearing: ad and business content now shows up natively in the same feeds as entertainment content, and the best B2B storytelling today borrows directly from consumer social. You will translate our Ads value proposition, research, and product innovation into compelling, channel-specific narratives that build awareness, consideration, and preference for Netflix Ads.
 

This role serves as a strategic bridge between Social Marketing, Ads Marketing, Sales, Comms, and other cross-functional partners working across the business. Your objective is to build, scale, and test  social strategies and programs to support Ads go-to-market campaigns, industry moments, and executive thought leadership spanning all social platforms - LinkedIn and industry channels where advertisers and agencies live, but with the same platform fluency, cultural timing, and creative risk-taking that defines Netflix's consumer social work.

This role partners closely with ads cross-functional partners to ensure Netflix Ads messaging  shows up consistently and impactfully across our organic and executive social presence, helping to drive commercial outcomes and long-term brand equity for Netflix Ads.


Key Responsibilities:

Build and Execute Social Strategy for Netflix Ads

  • Develop and implement an integrated social and digital strategy for Netflix Ads, with focus on LinkedIn and other platforms where advertisers, agencies, and industry stakeholders are especially active. 

  • Translate Ads Marketing narratives - product positioning, research insights, case studies, event moments, and thought leadership—into audience-first content frameworks tailored to media buyers, CMOs, planners, and industry influencers.

  • Design and run always-on and campaign-based social programs that support Ads go-to-market efforts, includingProduct and format launches, Research and insights releases, Industry event tentpoles (e.g., upfronts, key conferences, trade events), Client success stories and case studies

  • Stay ahead of B2B social trends, platform changes, and professional community behaviors to ensure Netflix Ads remains differentiated and relevant in the social landscape.

  • Use experimentation and testing to refine content formats, posting strategies, and narrative angles - balancing data-driven decisions with a willingness to take smart creative risks.

Embedded Partnership with Ads Marketing & Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Serve as the primary Social partner for Ads Marketing, ensuring Ads business priorities, positioning, and product narratives are reflected in platform strategies and channel roadmaps. 

  • Align with Ads Marketing (global and regional) on go-to-market plans, messaging hierarchies, and campaign timelines.

  • Work closely with XF partners including Comms and Brand to amplify relevant announcements, media stories, and industry comms connected to Netflix Ads.

  • Attend cross-functional meetings, strategy sessions, and planning forums (e.g., campaign kickoffs, event planning, research roadmap reviews) to ensure shared context and cohesive execution across touchpoints.

  • Partner with executive comms and stakeholders to support executive social presence (where relevant) around Ads narratives, including thought leadership and event visibility.

Channel Programming & Editorial Execution 

  • Manage all Ads-related channel programming across Netflix’s relevant social channels (especially LinkedIn, but also other corporate or industry-facing channels) ensuring the right Ads stories reach the right audiences at the right time. Includes content creation and execution, scheduling and approvals for Ads-related social content - serving as one of the final eyes on posts to ensure accuracy, adherence to policy, timeliness, and the Netflix voice.

  • Develop editorial frameworks and series for Netflix Ads Marketing including research/insights spotlights, partner and client showcases, and industry POVs from Netflix leaders

  • Ensure all Ads content aligns with brand and legal guidelines, and is consistent with the broader Netflix and Netflix Ads positioning.

Audience Development

  • Define and refine target audiences (e.g., agencies, brand marketers, CMOs, planners, trading desks, industry press) and build strategies to reach and engage them on social.

  • Drive meaningful engagement and funnel behavior, pulling audiences deeper into the Ads ecosystem (campaign microsites, case studies, events, newsletters, webinars, sales enablement touchpoints).

  • Use social and campaign analytics to track performance against clear learning agenda and KPIs (e.g., reach within target segments, engagement quality, traffic to Ads properties, event interest).

  • Surface insights to Ads Marketing, Sales, and Product partners, influencing future narratives and go-to-market decisions.

  • Identify and scale successful content formats and programs across additional markets and teams.

  • Inform and refine a measurement framework tailored to B2B social (e.g., quality of engagement, seniority of audience, brand sentiment among advertisers).

Background & Specific Skills:

  • 7+ years in social media management or content marketing, ideally within media, advertising, technology, or publishing.

  • Understanding of social platforms and strategy, social especially on LinkedIn and other platforms where advertisers, agencies, and industry stakeholders are highly active.

  • Sharp creative judgment and a track record of finding unexpected, culturally resonant angles for a story.

  • Experience translating business priorities, product positioning, or research into audience-first storytelling - this can come from B2B, brand, or consumer social backgrounds.

  • Proven experience building and executing multi-channel social strategies that support brand and product narratives, including long-term (e.g., 6–12 month) programs and fast-turn initiatives.

  • Demonstrated success partnering with marketing, sales, product, research, and communications teams to bring cohesive narratives to market.

  • Comfortable using data and experimentation to inform strategy, with a track record of leveraging insights to optimize content and programming—while remaining open to bold creative bets.

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage several projects concurrently in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment, and adhere to evolving deadlines.

  • Demonstrated ability to build strong relationships and work across many internal cross-functional teams, locally and globally.

  • High tolerance for change and a capacity to accomplish significant work in a dynamic, high-performance culture.

  • Respect, understanding, and enthusiasm for the Netflix culture and for the future of ad-supported streaming.

info.jobDescription:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. It’s a great time to join our team, and as Netflix grows globally and in the UK, we continue to look for the best and brightest talent to scale with our growth. Visit our culture memo and long-term view to learn more.

We are looking for a talented Tax Analyst to join our tax team in London to support the day-to-day tax operations of, and provide tax planning and structuring support to, Netflix's growing business in London, which includes Netflix’s largest production hub outside of UCAN. The ideal candidate will join our UK-based tax team and have excellent organisational and collaborative communication skills. They will also possess a strong attention to detail and a hands-on mentality.

This position offers unique opportunities for growth as our business expands, enabling you to become a well-rounded tax professional with a deep understanding of the film and television industry.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Corporate tax compliance and reporting: Coordinate with external tax advisors and internal tax compliance and financial reporting teams to perform a first review of UK statutory accounts and corporation tax computations and ensure UK incentive administrative compliance.

  • Corporate tax planning and advisory: Contribute to corporate tax advisory projects which support our business as it continues to grow and develop in the UK.

  • Communication with HMRC: Together with the rest of the team, assist in communication with HMRC, whether on general compliance matters or responding to questions.

  • Production Incentives: Research and understand UK and international film and television production incentives, such as the Audio Visual Expenditure Credit in the UK. Collaborate with the UK tax team to assist with evaluating and applying for production incentives including British cultural test applications, incentive estimates and tracking of our incentive claims.

  • Production Tax Support: Provide support and advice on UK tax matters to our production finance and production accounting teams, including UK VAT, PAYE, National Insurance Contributions, obligations under off-payroll worker rules and taxation of foreign entertainers (FEU).

  • Risk Management: Assist with maintenance of our UK Risk & Control Matrix

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate with external tax advisors and internal teams, including EMEA tax compliance, financial reporting, production finance, production legal and physical production teams. Liaise with the content accounting team on financial reporting of incentives.

  • Research and Documentation: Research complex tax issues and prepare technical documentation. Monitor changes in tax legislation and advise on their impact on Netflix’s operations, keeping business partners informed clearly and concisely.

  • Process Improvement: Contribute to the development and implementation of process improvements across tax compliance, reporting and advisory to enhance efficiency and accuracy.  We are always keen to improve!

Candidate Profile:

  • Chartered Accountancy or Chartered Tax qualification

  • Individuals who have recently qualified and are working towards the level of senior/ assistant manager in an accountancy practice or studio are likely to be suited to this unique challenge. 

  • Recommended 3 to 4 years of UK tax consulting or industry experience.

  • Experience in corporate tax preferred  - Experience in corporate tax advisory, international tax, US inbound companies, or transfer pricing would be an advantage.

  • Experience in tax issues relating to studio productions would be helpful, but is not required.

  • You embrace and advocate Netflix values.

  • Self-starter with the ability to work autonomously and effectively in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong communicator capable of building relationships with external advisors and internal teams.

  • Skilled multitasker, able to prioritise and meet tight deadlines.

  • Hands-on, proactive, and innovative.

  • Curious and enthusiastic, willing to ask questions and challenge the status quo.

  • Flexible to collaborate across multiple time zones and willing to travel overseas.

info.title: Senior Manager, Communications - India
info.jobDescription:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

The Opportunity:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, bringing exceptional stories to audiences in more than 190 countries. As Netflix enters its second decade in India, we are building on ten years of redefining streaming entertainment, championing Indian storytelling and helping local stories find audiences around the world.
 

Today, Netflix's role in India extends far beyond entertainment. We invest in creators, strengthen the country's creative ecosystem, partner with government and industry, and help shape conversations around storytelling, culture, technology and the future of entertainment.
 

This is an opportunity to join the Communications team at a defining moment in Netflix India's journey. You'll help shape the reputation of one of the world's most influential entertainment brands while working at the intersection of storytelling, business, policy, culture and technology.No two days are the same. One day you could be advising senior leaders on a complex reputational issue. Next, you're helping launch a landmark series, shaping a public policy narrative, working with journalists on a major business story, or partnering with our content teams to tell the story behind India's next global hit.
 

If you enjoy solving complex communications challenges, building narratives that influence perception, and working with extraordinary people across disciplines, you'll love this role.
 

The Role:
We're looking for a communications leader with exceptional judgement, curiosity and strong strategic instincts. This is not a specialist role. We're looking for a communications generalist-someone who has successfully managed a broad range of corporate, consumer, executive, reputation and issues-led communications, and understands how those disciplines come together to build trust in a brand.
 

The ideal candidate is equally comfortable developing long-term communications strategies, navigating high-profile issues, advising senior leaders, and rolling up their sleeves to execute.
 

A strong understanding of India's media and entertainment ecosystem is important not because we expect an expert in entertainment, but because the ability to understand the broader cultural landscape, industry dynamics and stakeholder environment is essential to succeeding in this role.
 

The successful candidate will bring approximately 13–15 years of communications experience across agency, corporate or media environments, ideally working with high-profile brands, complex reputational issues and senior stakeholders.
 

What You'll Do:

  • Shape and execute integrated communications strategies that strengthen Netflix's reputation in India and reinforce its role as a long-term partner to the country's creative economy and storytelling ecosystem.

  • Partner closely with teams across Public Policy, Content, Publicity, Marketing, Product, Partnerships and leadership to build compelling narratives.

  • Anticipate emerging issues, identify reputational risks and develop proactive communications strategies.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders on communications strategy and stakeholder engagement.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships across business, financial, technology, entertainment and trade media.

  • Write and edit a broad range of communications materials including executive messaging, press materials, speeches, opinion pieces and strategic documents.
     

We're Looking For Someone Who:

  • Has exceptional judgement and communications instincts.

  • Is a good writer who can simplify complexity into clear, compelling narratives.

  • Thinks strategically but enjoys execution.

  • Is highly collaborative and comfortable influencing across functions.

  • Curious about entertainment, business, technology, culture and public policy.

  • Understands how India's media ecosystem operates.

  • Has experience managing complex issues and advising senior stakeholders.

  • Is entrepreneurial, resourceful and comfortable operating in ambiguity.

  • Has a bias for action and consistently delivers high-quality work at pace.
     

To Thrive at Netflix:
 

The people who succeed at Netflix combine independent thinking with sound judgement. They are curious, candid, collaborative and comfortable challenging conventional thinking. They take ownership, thrive in ambiguity and are motivated by impact.If our culture resonates with you, we'd love to hear from you.

This is an experienced, high-impact role requiring autonomy, strategic thinking, and a strong ability to drive cross-functional alignment and execution.

  • Serve as the escalation 1:many starting point for sales and clients across 1P/3P solutions, including  issues related to measurement products, performance results interpretation,  and coordinating with Product and Sales Solutions to resolve challenges efficiently.
