  • Ensure all measurement solutions—1P and 3P—are ready for scale, supporting documentation, training, and enablement for the Measurement team and other stakeholders as relevant

About You

  • 8+ years of experience in digital media, ad tech, measurement, or product operations, with a track record of independently owning complex projects or functions.

  • Experience with omnichannel marketing, attribution models, conversion tracking, ROI measurement and optimization, particularly with performance advertisers.

  • Familiar with measurement methodologies across verticals and the advertising measurement ecosystem of 1st & 3rd party solutions.

  • Project management experience dealing with high volume of measurement requests

  • Demonstrated ability to create and lead client facing analysis, including calls and in-person presentations, to drive data driven recommendations. 

  • Knowledge of clean room measurement use cases, ability to interpret client requests.

  • Experience querying and interpreting measurement outcomes in data clean rooms.

  • Familiar with infrastructure based on one (or more) of these environments: ADH, AMC, Meta AA, Snowflake, AWS, Infosum, LiveRamp, Habu.

  • Proficient with query languages like SQL, exposure to multi-party collaboration a plus

  • Experience partnering with Product, Engineering, and external vendors to enable new solutions, and understanding of product go-to-market processes. 

  • Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, prioritize effectively, and drive outcomes in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with a bias for action and attention to detail.

info.title: Success Manager (EMEA)
info.jobDescription:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

 

The Team 

Content and Business Product Success uniquely sits between the teams developing the software products for Netflix Studio and the Studio employees & external partners who utilize these products. The Content & Business Product Success Manager (SM) is a trusted advisor for building relationships, designing and delivering tailored learning experiences for end users, driving product adoption, and enhancing their engagement with Netflix-built apps. We are responsible for developing user communication & education strategies and implementing blended, scalable learning solutions. SMs foster relationships with specific user groups across various business functions, gather & interpret product feedback, and provide actionable insights into how products are received for our Product partners who manage roadmaps. 

This role is UK-focused, but success requires global thinking and proactive collaboration across regions to support users worldwide.

The role is based in our London office on a hybrid basis, with flexibility to work remotely. Occasional travel might be required.

Responsibilities 

Design – Create & Build

  • Design and deliver scalable, blended learning experiences (e.g., instructor-led training, documentation, and digital content) that translate complex business workflows into clear, user-friendly content, tailored to a global audience and aligned with product go-to-market strategies

  • Build and maintain a comprehensive library of learning resources and subject matter materials across a portfolio of products

  • Develop and execute innovative communication and learning strategies that drive user engagement, product adoption, and overall user success, while serving as a strong user advocate within the Product & Technology organization

Deliver – Execute & Ship

  • Lead end-to-end project management for communication and learning initiatives, including defining goals, creating project plans, coordinating across teams, and ensuring timely delivery

  • Own communication strategies for product and feature launches, ensuring users understand workflow impacts, key changes, and value propositions

  • Drive change management efforts that enable internal and external users to successfully adopt and gain value from new and evolving products

Partner – Collaborate & Align

  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders, including Product, Engineering, Insights, Data Management to define user learning goals, align on communication strategies, and support business objectives

  • Collaborate with teams to ensure tools and workflows align with the reporting requirements and operational efficiency goals of the business functions you support

  • Build strong relationships with Studio business partners, SMEs, and end users to foster trust, influence outcomes, and effectively represent user needs in product decisions

Inform – Analyze & Surface Insights

  • Gather, analyze, and synthesize high volumes of information and user feedback from multiple teams, systems, and stakeholders to identify trends, surface actionable insights, and communicate them effectively across the organization

  • Use data and insights to craft compelling narratives that communicate user experience, product performance, and adoption trends to Product and Business stakeholders

  • Ability to understand and communicate domain-specific concepts and workflows to non-expert audiences in a clear and engaging way

Qualifications

Our ideal candidate will have the following experience, but don’t feel that you must have it all before you apply:

  • Will thrive in our Culture;

  • Has 5+ years of Learning and Development or Customer/User Success experience.  

  • Language: English (Required) / Other European languages (nice to have)

  • Deep GenAI fluency and comfortable with AI-powered productivity tools, used to produce high-quality learning and enablement materials that elevate the end-user learning experience

  • Ability to design blended learning programs (set goals, create and deliver curriculum & all materials, gather data, measure effectiveness)

The Content Localization team,  responsible for dubbing, subtitling, and accessibility assets, plays a crucial role in delivering Netflix programs to an expanding international audience by focusing on high-quality localized audio and text services, fostering a collaborative team environment, and utilizing cutting-edge technology.
 

As a Regional Lead, you will ensure that members experience the highest quality dubbed audio and expertly crafted subtitles, preserving creative intent and enhancing the localized experience for viewers everywhere. With Netflix's ongoing international expansion, support for new languages, and the introduction of new content genres, providing world-class dubbing and subtitling services is essential to our success, making this an exciting time to join the company.
 

Role Overview
The Director of Content Localization, APAC will serve as the primary leader and strategic liaison for all localization efforts, including dubbing, subtitling, and the suite of accessibility assets across the APAC region. This role oversees the management of multilingual content for Netflix, ensuring the highest standards of quality, operational excellence, and cultural relevance. The Director will lead and mentor a diverse team of Language Production Leads and Operations Leads, driving innovation and supporting Netflix’s growth in the region.
 

Key Responsibilities:


Strategic Leadership & Execution

  • Develop and execute a regional localization strategy, including dubbing, subtitling, and related workflows, tailored to the region and aligned with global objectives and KPIs.

  • Partner with regional and global leaders to adapt and implement the global localization strategy, ensuring prioritization of resources and efforts across dubbing, subtitling, and other language services.

  • Support and drive the rollout of Netflix’s 5-year Localization vision, including innovation and technology adoption in both dubbing and subtitling.

  • Represent the APAC region’s needs and insights in global operational and creative strategy discussions for content globalization.
     

Team Management & Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop high-performing Dream Teams of Localization Language Leads,  (Senior) Managers, and Localization Operations across multiple APAC countries.

  • Hire, develop, and retain top talent, fostering a diverse, inclusive, and internationally minded team culture.

  • Oversee team performance and development, maximizing contribution and potential within the organization.
     

Cross-Functional Partnership & Advocacy

  • Collaborate closely with Content, Production, Marketing, Legal, Public Policy, Finance, and other cross-functional teams to ensure seamless localization workflows for both dubbing and subtitling.

  • Advocate for the APAC region’s needs, generating insights, initiating programs, and influencing localization decisions company-wide.

  • Build strong partnerships with key regional organizations and represent Netflix at industry and company events.
     

Operational & Financial Excellence

  • Drive standardization and continuous improvement of localization workflows, ensuring creative, technical, and operational excellence.

  • Partner with Finance and Accounting to track and manage local localization, dubbing, and subtitling costs, monitoring market trends and union/guild activity.

  • Monitor competitor activity to inform strategy and maintain Netflix’s leadership position in localization, dubbing, and subtitling.
     

Thought Leadership & Innovation

  • Identify opportunities for growth, quality improvement, and scalability within localization, dubbing, and subtitling operations.

  • Contribute to Netflix’s culture of curiosity, responsibility, and innovation, sharing best practices and learnings across regions.

  • Deliver impactful analyses and presentations to executive audiences, translating complex ideas into actionable insights.
     

Representation & Market Presence

  • Professionally represent Netflix in the regional localization, dubbing, and subtitling marketplace.

  • Attend and speak at industry events to promote Netflix’s localization capabilities and vision.
     

Requirements:

  • 15+ years of people and organizational management in a global enterprise, ideally within the entertainment industry.

  • 10+ years of scaled operations, localization (including dubbing and subtitling), and internationalization experience, with extensive team leadership.

  • Proven ability to lead and influence at the executive level, with superior operational management and organizational skills.

  • Demonstrated success in strategic planning, business analysis, and making data accessible to diverse audiences.

We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Our Team:

The Ads Platform team builds the advertising systems and integrations that power the delivery of ads using our world-class content delivery ecosystem. We deliver ads in a manner that’s thoughtful of our members’ viewing experience and drives great outcomes for advertisers. 

Our team is new and yet faced with the ambitions of building highly performant advertising systems and delivering high impact to our business by monetizing our incredible slate of content. As one of the newest entrants in the Connected TV advertising space that’s rapidly growing, we seek to build unique value propositions that differentiate Netflix from other ad-supported streaming services.

We are looking for a Product Manager in the advertising space who is excited to join us on this journey.

About the Role:

We’re looking for a Product Manager to help build the infrastructure needed to serve ads in Live events. In this role they will:

  • Identify ads management and serving needs unique to Live events due to high unpredictability, massive traffic spikes, and simultaneous global delivery. 

  • Take a holistic yield management approach across direct and indirect demand and supply channels, long-term commitments and real-time bidding. 

  • Work with internal product and engineering stakeholders as well as external partners across both the Live Streaming and the Ads infrastructure teams to enable seamless ad delivery for our customers.

  • Manage products from concept to launch, delivering features iteratively to solve the business challenges before them.

  • Define how we will measure the success and effectiveness of our products, and drive the execution and continuous evaluation of those metrics. 

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams in sales, ad operations, marketing, strategy, policy, finance, and legal to bring products to market and increase adoption.

We’re seeking a candidate who has:

  • 6+ years of Product Management experience with a proven record of successfully launching and scaling platforms

  • Live advertising experience in either real-time bidding or ad serving domains. 

  • Experience with yield optimization for a publisher across programmatic and direct sales channels, ideally with Live ad supply.

  • Demonstrated ability to analyze complex data sets and derive actionable insights to drive product decisions.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts to diverse audiences.

  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization. Experience collaborating with Insights, Design, Engineering, Data Science, and other Product Teams.  

  • Experience working in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment, with a strong ability to adapt to new challenges and opportunities.






 

 

Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $440,000.00 - $725,000.00.

Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here.

info.title: Merchandiser (UK), Product Merchandising
info.jobDescription:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

 

The Product Merchandising team connects members to Netflix's world of entertainment by blending intuitive merchandising and market expertise to position, promote, and present content so members find it easy and enjoyable to choose what they'll love. 

The Product Merchandising Team UK and Nordics positions our local award-winning, industry-leading content for distribution on the Netflix service through our work on individual titles as well as the broader catalogue in our markets. 

The Role

Product Merchandising blends intuitive merchandising strategy and deep local expertise to position, promote, and present content — making it easy and enjoyable for every Netflix member to choose what they'll love. We're blending global scale with deep local expertise, and we're looking for people who can bring both. 

As a Merchandiser, you shape the merchandising experience for Netflix members in your markets — across creative, editorial, and catalog dimensions. You are a platform-first impact driver: someone who shapes how the Netflix experience looks, reads, and feels for members in the UK across every surface, every content format, and every moment. 

What You'll Do

Shape the Local Member Experience 

  • Drive the local UK merchandising calendar — planning activations around title launches, cultural moments, seasonal trends, and member lifecycle milestones throughout the year.

  • Lead distribution and promotion strategy for local title launches — from positioning and merchandising strategy through to post-launch performance.

  • Propose, develop  and execute catalog activations (rows, hubs, custom promotions) that drive content discovery and reflect what resonates culturally with consumers in your market.

  • Develop messaging campaigns — push notifications, emails — that connect members to content they'll love, timed to the moments and titles that matter locally.

  • Editorialize catalog content beyond new launches to support member engagement, surfacing library titles and hidden gems at the right point in the member journey. Partner with cross functional stakeholders to drive business impact at the local level through this work.

  • Connect the dots between platform logic, consumer insights, and content strategy to drive strong merchandising activations and learning agendas. 

  • Apply deep awareness of local trends, social and cultural zeitgeist, and platform behavior to shape what gets surfaced, when, and how — in close partnership with Marketing and Comms.

  • Advocate for your market's needs in regional and global conversations, sharing context that cross-functional partners cannot access without you.

  • Work closely with Content, Marketing, Product teams, and external agency partners to proactively share context, surface trade-offs, and align on priorities to deliver a cohesive member experience.

  • Operate within global governance frameworks and playbooks, ensuring local activations complement the global calendar.

  • Act as the local intelligence layer to surface on-the-ground market insights and trends, and contribute to playbooks and standards that can be scaled across markets in partnership with local Consumer Insights and Content Strategy.

Creative & Editorial 

  • Partner with local marcomms on Product Title Creative Assets for priority titles, using external agencies where additional assets may be required. Briefing and reviewing imagery, copy, and promotional materials. 

  • Ensure Product Assets across image, AV and copy adhere to Netflix's standards for quality, consistency, and local authenticity.

  • Operate within the global Merchandising Playbook while driving locally resonant decisions. 

  • Use AV where needed to deepen member engagement across the title lifecycle and provide clear, actionable feedback to ensure output meets positioning, creative guidelines, and timelines.

  • Partner with Creative Services and Design to ensure assets perform across all devices, with particular mastery of mobile as a primary discovery canvas in the UK.

  • Optimize consumer messaging (email, push, in-app notifications) that feels genuinely individual — tailored to member behavior and lifestyle signals, not generic promotional copy.

Turn Data into insights to drive better experiences

  • Partner with regional Performance Analysts and Technical Merchandising to monitor and report on activations at the local level. Ensure hypotheses created at the local level are reflected in data gathered post launch. 

  • Contribute to A/B testing and experimentation, using data, dashboards, analytics tools alongside qualitative market insight to continuously improve the member experience.

  • Think in business outcomes, not just creative outputs: track and communicate the impact of merchandising decisions on member engagement, viewing behavior, and platform health metrics to your peers and cross-functional partners.

  • Write clear, well-reasoned strategic briefs that articulate the why behind your activation decisions and earn alignment from partners and leadership.

  • Fluency in business metrics and translating them to merchandising strategy. You understand the UK business inside out, think member-first, and know how to bridge both to achieve ambitious business impact. 

  • Work at pace: move from concept to live activation quickly while maintaining quality and intentionality.

What We're Looking For

  • A proven ability to engage customers via digital promotional and/or merchandising tactics, driving product engagement in an authentic and culturally relevant manner. 

  • Deep cultural fluency in the UK and curiosity to learn about new ones. You understand what resonates, what's trending, and what UK members respond to.

  • A strong track record of using data to make decisions — you're comfortable reading consumer insight studies, dashboards, spotting patterns, and translating insights into action.

  • Experience writing strategic briefs: you can define a problem clearly, build hypotheses, stress-test your own assumptions before making a recommendation with conviction, and bring stakeholders along.

  • Operational excellence: you're organized and accurate under high-volume, fast-moving conditions.

  • Think in systems: you instinctively connect content, members, product behavior, and market context into a coherent picture, and you know which questions to ask to fill in the gaps before forming a view.

  • A collaborative approach: you work well across functions, time zones, and seniority levels, and you know when to push back and when to align.

  • Genuinely love entertainment: you are an avid consumer of content across film, series, and beyond, and you bring real passion and taste to the work.

  • Native or full professional fluency in [local language(s)] and English; mastery of [local] editorial and cultural standards.

info.title: Senior Manager, Marketing Partnerships - Korea
info.jobDescription:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

It's an exciting time to join Netflix as we continue to transform entertainment globally. We are bringing new stories and games to millions of people worldwide. A key to growth is our ability to work well with distribution partners across the world. 

As we move beyond 300 million members and hundreds of partnerships worldwide, we are looking for a talented individual to drive strong outcomes for our partnerships in South Korea Our priority partners in the region will span across mobile, broadband & digital players, Consumer Electronics players, select Ecommerce businesses and other leading consumer brands.

When we partner with these brands, we approach business and marketing opportunities together to attract new audiences and drive business impact.  Reporting to the Director of Partner Marketing APAC, this role will be responsible for connecting the dots across the market, building and owning a holistic functional strategy, identifying key strategic levers and working closely with the Country Partner Marketing leads to maximise impact via Partnerships. 

This role will be based in Seoul. We are looking for an experienced Partner Marketing leader with a deep understanding of the South Korea market and partners. The right candidate is a strategic marketing professional who enjoys commercial management, understands entertainment and has successfully delivered on a regional scope.

The Role

The successful candidate will be a seasoned professional with demonstrated experience in building strong Partner Marketing strategy & delivering tangible business outcomes. 

A passion for technology and entertainment is a must, in addition to a keen understanding of how access to entertainment fits into consumer’s lives and how it is likely to evolve over time. As Sr Manager, Partner Marketing Korea, the successful candidate will be the functional expert and a critical link between key cross-functional teams like Business Development, Partner Solutions, Partnership Strategy & Analysis and Country Marketing to achieve business goals in the region. This role will require some travel in the region and will work closely with several stakeholders, both internally and externally.

Responsibilities:

  • Build and own the Partner Marketing strategy for Korea with a clear lens of how it will help deliver on our broader business strategy.

  • Partner with the country teams to develop, refine and execute functional strategies, including defining clear goals and short, mid & long term roadmaps.

  • Provide thought partnership and  guidance around opportunity sizing, identifying consumer & partner motivations, key GTM levers and clear success metrics for initiatives across existing & new partnerships in the region.  

  • Establish & foster deep relationships with key senior marketing stakeholders on the partner-side. 

  • Partner with key cross-functional  teams, including but not limited to Business Development, Partner Solutions, Partnership Strategy & Analysis and Country Marketing to maximise Partnership impact in the region. 

  • Partner with key stakeholders within Netflix international offices and headquarters.

  • Identify strategic functional priorities that can scale across the sub-region. 

​Qualifications:

  • More than 15 years’ experience across Tech & Entertainment is essential. Experience across Digital/PayTV/Telecommunication/CE is a plus.

  • Excellent market  knowledge and expertise. 

  • An expert in Full Funnel Marketing, including Retail / Sales, who is also experienced in budget ownership.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset: consumer-oriented, outspoken and impact oriented. 

  • Possess the ability to manage multiple time-sensitive projects simultaneously without the support of a large team, working both independently and in close collaboration with a wide variety of stakeholders.

  • Strong knowledge and interest in both business and marketing challenges with a keen lens on driving impact.

info.title: Member of Technical Staff, Agentic Systems - Games
info.jobDescription:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

The next challenge for Netflix Games will be applying AI at the scale and quality consumers expect to make real impact. Come be a part of what’s next. We're seeking a technical leader to help shape the strategy, development & delivery of GenAI tools and agentic systems across Netflix Games. This is a pivotal role that will drive how AI creates real benefit and support across the organization, needing a leader who can work on product strategy, internal alignment, and bring state-of-the-art engineering hands-on execution to building agentic systems and machine learning capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Builder PM: Identify key opportunities where AI can add value to teams, defining the product strategy and architecture of new enablement systems.

  • Derive insights from user research and quantitative data to create product roadmaps, which identify the highest return investments, distinguish hype from value.

  • Work across diverse teams in game studios and platforms, to inform and advise on existing initiatives, as well as how new tools will fit within the broader ecosystem.

  • Prototyping to Shipping: Bring product strategy skills and builder capabilities to every initiative, define what's worth building, not just how to build it. Prototype fast to validate ideas with real systems, identify where agentic AI genuinely transforms player experience or team productivity, and take features from concept to production without a handoff layer.

  • Work with technologies across the game organization stack, from game engines, to services, to Agentic systems (Claude Code, Cowork, OpenClaw, custom agents and bots)

  • Contribute to engineering production-grade agentic systems: multi-step reasoning pipelines, tool-use agents, multi-agent orchestration, and autonomous workflows. Design and build the code harnesses and scaffolding connecting frontier models (or open-weight alternatives) to tooling, game engines, and platform APIs.

  • Build reusable agent primitives and infrastructure , MCPs (Model Context Protocols) and shared agentic libraries , that raise the floor for the whole organization and reduce duplicated effort across game studios and platform teams.

  • Where needed, iterate on model capabilities through model fine-tuning, DPO to align outputs with quality preferences, LoRA/QLoRA for efficiency, and RLHF for long-horizon agentic tasks. With the aim of improving overall tools performance.

  • Data Driven Decision Making: Define AI evaluation as a first-class discipline, including defining overall product evaluations strategy, curating offline eval sets, automated scoring pipelines, and regression gates. Define and build online evaluation: A/B testing, production telemetry, user feedback loops, and anomaly detection for agent behavior drift.

  • Partner with external researchers, developers, and companies pioneering work in the agentic AI space. Stay on the forefront of emerging frameworks, open models, and infrastructure patterns, and bring those learnings back to accelerate our own efforts.

  • Collaborate with our engineering and platform teams to build robust solutions and scale core capabilities: model inference, data pipelines, responsible AI compliance, safety guardrails, and graceful degradation at scale.

  • Managing a small team of engineers

Qualifications

We're looking for a technical leader who can help shape the strategic direction for agentic systems across Netflix Games , and a hands-on builder of those systems.

  • 7+ years of experience in AI product strategy, machine learning, and AI engineering with a strong hands-on engineering foundation.

  • 3+ years of experience in the game development industry.

  • Product management experience, identifying user needs, defining product roadmaps, running production development workstreams.

  • Experience in games or interactive entertainment, shipping game features, working in game engines (Unreal, Unity), or building AI experiences for players.

  • Deep, practical experience building and deploying agentic AI systems in production, multi-step reasoning, tool use, multi-agent orchestration, or autonomous workflow automation.

  • Strong Python engineering skills and production experience with agentic frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, Google ADK, or equivalent).

  • Proven experience designing and operating evaluation infrastructure for AI systems , offline benchmarks, automated scoring pipelines, and online experimentation.

  • Deep understanding of the Gen AI ecosystem , open models, data requirements, infrastructure and tooling, safety frameworks, and the trade-offs between hosted and in-house solutions.

  • Comfortable navigating from research prototypes to production-ready systems in a fast-paced, cross-functional setting, in partnership with engineering teams, AI research, and game studios.

  • Strong communicator who can convey complex AI system design to technical and non-technical stakeholders, and build alignment across game studios, platform teams, and leadership.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar agent-to-system connectivity standards.

  • Experience with inference optimization for agentic deployments: latency reduction, cost management, streaming responses.

  • Background in responsible AI: safety evaluation, prompt injection defense, output moderation, and content policy compliance.

  • Experience with the full LLM fine-tuning lifecycle: SFT, DPO, LoRA/QLoRA, and RLHF for long-horizon tasks. Comfortable taking a fine-tuning project from dataset curation through deployment and ongoing maintenance.

  • Published research or public contributions in agentic systems, RLHF, or LLM evaluation.

info.title: Title Producer, Content Localization - Film & Animation
info.jobDescription:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

The Opportunity

As a Localization Title Producer, UCAN - Film & Animation, you will ensure that members experience the highest quality localized experience across our Film, Animation and Kids & Family slate, preserving creative intent and enhancing the localized experience for viewers everywhere. With Netflix's ongoing international expansion, support for new languages, and the introduction of new content formats, providing world-class scalable localization services is essential to our success, making this an exciting time to join the company.

The Role

The Localization Title Producer team will serve as the single point of accountability for the end-to-end localization strategy and execution across all assigned titles and tasks. This role is responsible for orchestrating the seamless delivery of dubbing, subtitling, main/episodic titles, accessibility, and marketing assets, ensuring that all localized content reflects Netflix’s creative vision and meets regional standards for quality and authenticity. This role partners closely with internal and external stakeholders, including Content, Post, Marketing, external partners and more, to optimize workflows, resolve operational challenges, and drive continuous improvement. By championing operational excellence, this role plays a critical role in delivering a world-class member experience and supporting the successful global launch of Netflix content.

Key Responsibilities

End-to-End Localization Ownership

  • Fully own the operational and tactical localization lifecycle for assigned titles, serving as the single point of accountability from initial planning through global launch. 

  • Overseeing all language assets—including dubbing, subtitling, SDH, audio description, marketing supplementals, metadata, main/episodic titles, and forced narratives—proactively managing cross-functional expectations, timelines, budgets, quality control, and ensuring the launch readiness of localized assets for both long form and trailers.

  • Collaborate on localization strategy for new content formats, partnering closely with Strategy & Innovation, Vendor Strategy and Language Production to test, refine and implement scalable models (including automation and assistive technologies) for assigned slate.

  • Design, refine and operate scaled content ingestion workflows for emerging formats, ensuring localization can support high volume and fast turnaround while maintaining appropriate quality thresholds.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Collaboration

  • Act as the main localization point of contact between Content, Post, Marketing, Launch Management, and other internal teams, ensuring alignment and seamless communication throughout the localization process.

  • Facilitate collaboration between Netflix, localization partners, and Language Producers to align timelines, deliverables, and quality standards. Oversee progress, resolve operational challenges, and ensure consistent, authentic localization that meets regional objectives.

Project & Workflow Management

  • Plan, schedule, and manage localization workflows for each assigned title, including setting the title-level language strategy and vendor selection, bid management, financial tracking, and asset delivery.

  • Oversee context gathering, complexity assessment, source material distribution, and project tracking while maintaining operational efficiency, ensuring our localization partners are set up to create localized assets that meet the Netflix creative standard.

  • Analyze localization metrics and project data to identify opportunities for workflow optimization and to proactively resolve operational challenges.

Quality, Risk, and Issue Management

  • Identify, assess, and manage project risks, as well as troubleshoot and escalate quality or operational issues as needed, to keep projects on track.

  • Analyze title level localization metrics and data to identify opportunities for workflow optimization and to proactively resolve operational challenges.

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

  • Champion the adoption of new practices, workflows, automation, and technology to streamline localization processes and support the integration of emerging media types (live, video podcasts, interactive experiences, etc.).

  • Identify and flag challenges within the current workflow to support ongoing operational improvement.

  • Foster a culture of partnership, transparency, and continuous improvement within the team and with external partners.

Requirements

At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. In April 2022, we introduced a new, more affordable, ad-supported tier for our customers, marking a significant milestone for Netflix. Our focus is now on expanding choices for consumers and providing advertisers with a premium TV brand experience that surpasses traditional linear formats. The challenge ahead involves scaling our ad tech to maximize its impact on our business.

Our Team

The Ads Platform Engineering teams build advertising systems and integrations that power the delivery of ads using our world-class content delivery ecosystem. We use a number of Netflix investments and innovations to power our ads - unique mix of client and server-side ad insertions, state of the art content delivery system, ad encoding recipes, content understanding and metadata. We deliver ads in a manner that’s thoughtful of our member’s viewing experience and drive great outcomes for advertisers. We also ensure that advertiser brand safety is ensured during serving, members only see the most appropriate ads for them.

Ads policies are the foundational guidelines that govern what ads can be shown, where they can run, and under what conditions on the Netflix platform. Policies ensure that every ad campaign complies with both local regulations and Netflix standards, by defining rules related to restricted categories, maturity levels, and brand restrictions. The Ads Policies team is responsible for building the platform-level components required for managing Netflix policies and ensuring their enforcement across the entire ads ecosystem, including creative review, campaign setup, targeting, serving and reporting.

You will shape the longer-term architecture of the policy platform and lead highly ambiguous initiatives whose success depends on alignment across Policy, Product, Operations, and multiple engineering teams.

info.title: Korea Finance Director - Strategy, Planning, and Studio Finance
info.jobDescription:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

| The Team
The Finance team partners closely with leaders across Content, Ads, Marketing, Product, Partnerships, and Operations, connecting financial insight with strategic thinking to help the business make better decisions. We bring together perspectives from various teams to create one integrated view of the business.
 

| The Opportunity
We are looking for a Korea Finance Director, Strategy, Planning, and Studio Finance to lead one of Netflix's most dynamic and strategically important markets. 


This role acts as a co-pilot of the Korea business and reports directly to the APAC CFO. It serves as the primary Finance & Strategy partner to the Korea Leadership Team (KLT), acting as a trusted business advisor and thought partner across the market.

Success in this role goes well beyond financial planning or reporting. You'll help shape country strategy, influence investment decisions, challenge assumptions, identify opportunities and risks, and connect cross-functional perspectives to drive stronger business outcomes. The ideal candidate would have an exceptionally strong business acumen, exceptional people and leadership skills, and a strong ability to influence without authority.

You will work across nearly every part of the business while collaborating closely with regional and global partners, making this an exceptional opportunity for someone who enjoys operating at the intersection of finance, strategy, and business leadership.
 

| Core Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the Finance & Strategy leader for Korea and the primary strategic finance partner to the Korea Leadership Team.

  • Act as the business co-pilot, translating financial insight into strategic recommendations that influence business decisions.

  • Bring together multiple Finance teams, including FP&A, Content F&S, Content Accounting, and Production Finance, etc., to provide a holistic view of the business.

  • Partner closely with cross-functional leaders across Content, Ads, Partnerships, Marketing, Product, and Operations to shape country priorities.

  • Help define and execute the country strategy while aligning with broader regional and global objectives.

  • Evaluate investment opportunities, business trade-offs, and resource allocation to maximize long-term business performance.

  • Monitor financial, operational, and market risks while identifying opportunities for sustainable growth.

  • Leverage market intelligence, competitive insights, and regional trends to support strategic decision-making.

  • Foster alignment across local, regional, and global stakeholders, ensuring decisions are informed by both local context and broader company priorities.
     

| We're looking for:
We are interested in leaders who bring strong business judgment, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to connect finance with broader business strategy.

  • 15+ years of experience in Finance, Strategy, or related business leadership roles within technology, media, entertainment, or other complex global organizations.

  • A track record of partnering directly with senior business leaders to influence strategic decisions.

  • Strong commercial acumen and the ability to understand how businesses grow, invest, and create long-term value.

  • The ability to navigate ambiguity, simplify complex business problems, and make thoughtful recommendations.

  • Effective executive communication skills, with experience influencing cross-functional stakeholders without relying on formal authority.

  • A collaborative leadership style, bringing together diverse perspectives across local, regional, and global teams.

  • Strong learning agility and curiosity, with the ability to quickly develop expertise across new business areas.

  • A bias toward action, balanced with sound judgment and thoughtful decision-making.

  • A demonstrated commitment to inclusion, collaboration, and building high-performing teams.

  • Professional fluency in both Korean and English is essential, with the confidence to communicate clearly and build trusted partnerships across local, regional, and global stakeholders.

We are seeking an individual to lead strategic and impactful photography campaigns for our Unscripted and Live programming, driven by creative materials - unit photography, in-stream stills, social, editorial and event photography. The role requires a high level of creativity, an inquisitive and innovative mindset, and a strong project management background. The Netflix Photo Studio specializes in capturing impactful imagery that shapes, enhances and supports our Global marketing, publicity, and product campaigns for our Netflix Original content including series, films, and documentaries.
 
Spearheading the photography capture on set during productions of Netflix Original Unscripted Series and Live events, this role utilizes knowledge of television production and talent and filmmaker relations. A successful candidate is someone who is highly adaptable and comfortable navigating ambiguity. This role will work cross-functionally with the Netflix publicity, marketing, product, and social teams, as well as show production, talent reps, and external photographers and producers throughout the lifecycle of a campaign. A strong knowledge of IATSE 600 rules and regulations is preferred.
 
This job is based in Los Angeles and reports to the Photography Manager - Series.    

Responsibilities of the role include:

  • Develop and execute a photography strategy, per project/title, to capture, produce and utilize impactful visual assets to enhance and support the publicity, social, and marketing campaign throughout its lifecycle

  • Oversee a slate of projects that includes unscripted series Live programming

  • Produce gallery and marketing photoshoots

  • Oversee photography needs for premieres and events.
  • Manage budgets, open internal POs and negotiate rates with third-party vendors.

  • 8+ years experience at a network, studio, or editorial outlet
  • Strong roster of unit, entertainment, event, and editorial photographers
  • Strategic thought-partner and strong team player
  • Experience working on the ground at Live events
  • Deadline-oriented with strong time management skills
  • Strong eye for producing impactful photo assets
  • Experience working with international markets is preferred
  • Ability to handle high volume of complex projects and tasks for multiple people and departments simultaneously and manage competing priorities
  • Must be able to work independently, make sound decisions, think strategically, and maintain accuracy and attention to detail
  • Must possess solid organizational, effective time management and excellent verbal and written communication skills to communicate effectively with internal and external teams
  • Understand and interest in Federal copyright laws, usage licenses and embargoes
  • Understand the photography industry

We are seeking a Workplace Design Manager:  A senior individual contributor who brings strong depth in commercial interior design from program interpretation/space planning through all phases of design as well as, environmental graphic design and styling. The successful candidate is an experienced, enthusiastic, and engaging professional who can communicate clearly at all levels, gains trust with peers through proven track record, and has a strong base in creative workplace interior design. This role works in a fast-paced, high achieving environment and will be working on multiple projects (both interior design and brand related), across the globe. 

This person will report to the Senior Manager of Design. They will operate as an independent Design Manager leading both internal and external teams through the design process, incorporating feedback along the way. 

The ideal candidate has:

  • Done the work, from space planning, concept, schematic and design development, furniture selection/specifications, construction documents, construction administration etc

  • Work to ensure that the external design team is designing the project on schedule, budget, and aligning with the Netflix culture, brand values, and aesthetic, as well as meeting the project based design aesthetic and goals laid out in the visioning session or at project inception.

  • Bring clarity to complex problems, by being an open and collaborative, positive solutions based individual

  • Onboard an external design team and lead them through the interior design process (Visioning, Concept Design, Schematic Design, Design development, Construction documents).

  • Connect the design team with space and occupancy partners to ensure the design supports the overall program and business space needs.

  • Ensure the design team stays on schedule and budget, and aligns with Netflix culture, brand values, aesthetic, and design guidelines while creating a bespoke design tailored for each location.

  • Connect the external design team to the correct internal/external team members needed for full coordination.

  • Lead value engineering discussions with the external design team when needed in order to reduce project cost but maintain project aesthetic.

Act as liaison between the project team and local leadership teams for EGD/brand project check-ins (visioning sessions, concept design, schematic design, and design development) and incorporate feedback as needed. Work with the EGD team to drive creativity and bespoke graphic design solutions for each project. 

  • Drive consistency in environments that foster creativity and innovation, enabling people to do their best work.

  • Manage multiple simultaneous projects through all phases (including environmental graphics/brand design) with accuracy, timeliness, and consistent, concise communication with project managers and cross-functional, local, and regional teams.

  • Guide, support, and give feedback to help realize Netflix's design vision (architecture and brand); review and mark up construction and architectural details, brand-related drawings, and FFE/lighting specs to ensure design intent is properly coordinated.

  • Build and maintain relationships across internal teams to ensure feedback is captured throughout the design process; 

  • Partner with the Workplace team on related design modifications.

  • Stay current on design knowledge, processes, and philosophies, especially Inclusive Design, Sustainability Design, and AI applications.

    • Bachelor's degree in Interior Architecture and/or Interior Design required.

    • Proficiency with Google Suite, Adobe Creative Suite, Bluebeam, CAD, and Revit.

    • Collaborative working style, comfortable partnering with the Head of Design, external design teams, local leadership, and internal Netflix partners.

info.jobDescription:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.


The Role
This role sits on the Program Management team inside Marketing Operations and Production (MO&P) -  the group turning Netflix Marketing's technology, AI and data ambitions into working practice, not just strategy. MO&P manages the operational architecture of marketing; the systems, workflows, and infrastructure that make ambitious campaigns possible, and delivers them, at scale, across every market. 

You'll partner directly with Marketing, Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Customer Success to take emerging technology from possible to adopted, with real visibility and influence into how Marketing operates at global scale. 

Netflix culture provides high agency, autonomy, high talent density, very bottoms-up thinking, and super quick experiments and launching. This role is built for someone who wants to shape how work gets done, not just execute against someone else's playbook.


Key Responsibilities:
Program Execution & Change Management

  • Partner with Marketing and Product to identify and prioritize tooling and workflow improvements that simplify complex processes globally.
  • Author business cases & requirements, program charters/briefs, to translate business needs into actionable programs. 
  • Define scope and work breakdown structures for programs, with clear resource coordination across cross functional teams. 
  • Strategize and implement change management plans for new products or operational processes, partnering with global teams and key stakeholders to minimize operational friction.
  • Craft stakeholder communications, contribute to best-practices documentation, and directly address challenges that emerge during rollout.
  • Activate and lead change across complex and matrixed organizations.


Technology

The Analytics Platform and Experience (APeX)) team is responsible for providing orchestration and compute technologies to ETL and to access nearly 1 ExaByte of data in the Netflix Warehouse. Maestro is a fully managed workflow-as-a-service (WaaS), designed and built in-house to meet Netflix’s scale and complexity. Maestro serves thousands of users—including data scientists, data engineers, ML engineers, and software engineers—powering hundreds of thousands of workflows and millions of jobs every day.

  • Creative Campaigning: Craft compelling brand narratives and pitches that help titles cut through the cultural noise; identify non-traditional story angles via social, fandom, and cultural moments.

  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with creative executives, production, marketing, and legal teams to shape long-term strategy and provide expert counsel.

  • Risk Mitigation: Identify and manage brand and communications risks, including sensitive reactive situations (cancellations, HR issues, controversial content), with sound judgment under pressure.

  • Executive & Talent Management: Secure and coordinate executive, creator, and talent interviews, press tours, panels, and speaking opportunities.

  • 10+ years of experience in communications at an agency, studio, or network, ideally within entertainment or media.

  • Proven track record leading proactive and reactive communications strategy for scripted television, film, or comparable premium content.

  • Demonstrated success building multi-title, “slate” or franchise-level narratives — not just single-title campaigns — that tie to broader cultural, economic, or industry storylines.

  • Deep, established, and active relationships across trade, business, entertainment, consumer, and new, emerging media. A proven, personal track record of pitching, securing, and shaping press coverage.

  • Manage the finishing and delivery of AV assets (teasers, trailers, TV spots, social, etc.) for our cross-functional marketing and communications teams.

AV LOCALIZATION PROJECT MANAGEMENT

  • Coordinate timelines, priorities, and expectations to ensure localized AV is delivered on time, on budget, and in alignment with global campaign strategy.

WORKFLOW & TOOLING IMPROVEMENTS

  • Deep experience in theatrical title marketing, including fluency in:
  • Trailer and TV spot workflows
  • Multiple versioning strategies (ratings, length, regional, platform-specific)

  • Experience with commercial or theatrical shoot production schedules (AV days, EPK, BTS capture, unit shoots) and integrating that material into marketing AV.

info.title: Research Scientist 5 — Content Representation Models (CRM)
info.jobDescription:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

About the Team

The Content Representation Models team creates a single, unified "language" for Netflix's entire library by developing foundation models that understand everything from video and audio to text and artwork at a semantic level. By treating these powerful embeddings as a core product, we give Netflix the ability to match the right content to the right member, supercharging personalization and helping everyone discover something they'll love.

The team's current areas of focus include:

  • Unified Content Embedding: Merging media-based and metadata-based embedding approaches into a single cohesive model, creating rich semantic representations of all content across video, audio, and text modalities

  • Multimodal and Multi-Granularity Embeddings: Creating embeddings from various content types at different levels of detail, from entire shows down to individual shots and clips

  • Semantic IDs: Developing unique, meaningful identifiers for content that enable more sophisticated retrieval and recommendation

  • Profile and Content Embedding Alignment: Aligning member profile embeddings with content embeddings in the same space to enhance personalization

About the Role

We are looking for a Research Scientist specializing in embeddings and representation learning to investigate how we can enhance content understanding capability in Netflix's foundation models.

How foundation models understand content is one of the most important open research questions for Netflix personalization. Today, our models rely on a mix of metadata, behavioral signals, and media-based representations. The opportunity ahead is to significantly deepen that understanding through approaches like Semantic IDs, continuous pre-training, novel representation learning methods, or other state-of-the-art techniques.

The person in this role will help shape that research direction and bring new ideas to the table. This is an area where the optimal strategy is still being defined, which means there is real room to influence the approach and make a lasting impact on how Netflix's foundation models reason about content.

What makes this role unique:

  • Open research problem with real product impact. Enhancing how foundation models understand content is a crucial and unsolved challenge. Your work will directly improve how 300M+ members discover content.

  • Research that ships. This isn't a pure research lab. Your work will feed into foundation models that power personalization across every Netflix surface. The loop between research and member impact is tight.

  • Bring your own approach. We have hypotheses (Semantic IDs, continuous pre-training, etc.) but we're looking for someone who brings their own perspective and methods to the problem.

  • World-class collaborators. You will work alongside researchers and engineers across content understanding, foundation models, and application teams who are pushing the state of the art in personalization at scale.

Responsibilities

  • Drive applied research on enhancing content understanding capability in Netflix's foundation models

  • Conceptualize, design, implement, and validate new approaches to representation learning and content embeddings

  • Explore and apply state-of-the-art AI/ML techniques, including methods for improving how LLMs and foundation models represent and reason about content

  • Develop production-ready solutions and partner with application teams to ensure research translates into member-facing impact

  • Design and run rigorous offline experiments and evaluations to validate new approaches

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams across content understanding, foundation models, and personalization applications

  • Contribute to the broader research community through publications at top venues

What We're Looking For

Must-haves:

  • Ph.D. in Computer Science or a related field with a strong publication record in embeddings, representation learning, or a closely related domain

  • 3+ years of research experience with a track record of delivering quality results

  • Deep expertise in machine learning, including practical experience with LLMs and/or foundation models

  • Strong software engineering skills in Python (eg, PyTorch /)

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience in adopting LLM for Recsys. More specifically, building Semantic IDs and ground them in LLMs.

  • Experience in computer vision or multimodal AI

  • Industry experience in recommendation systems, search, personalization, or retrieval

  • Experience with LLM pre-training, fine-tuning, or distillation

  • Hands-on experience with distributed training

  • Publications in top ML conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, KDD, RecSys)

  • Applied research experience in industrial settings

info.title: Sr. Ad Ops Demand Mgmt Specialist (EMEA)

Cultural agility is a core requirement. You will engage with partners and clients across diverse European markets, each with distinct business cultures, communication styles, and expectations. The ability to build trust and credibility across these markets — and to adapt fluidly — is as critical as your technical expertise.

  • Participate in the adoption and rollout of new tools, automation, and best practices, providing feedback to drive continuous improvement.

  • Stay informed on industry trends, internal process updates, and emerging technologies to keep operations at the forefront of the market.

Required skills:

  • 5+ years of experience in Ad Tech, Ad Operations, or demand management, supporting Account Management, Sales, Ads Policy/Quality, or Product/Engineering teams.

  • Strong expertise in campaign lifecycle management, including trafficking, execution, quality control, monitoring, pacing, and troubleshooting.

info.jobDescription:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Our Team

The Ads Platform team at Netflix is dedicated to creating a world-class advertising ecosystem that drives our advertising business. This team's mission is to develop advanced technology that ensures exceptional experiences for both our members and advertisers. Our responsibilities encompass a broad spectrum of products, ranging from sales and media planning to optimizing advertiser outcomes and execution. This includes inventory and order management, campaign execution, ad serving, audience and identity management, measurement, reporting, and finance.

We use several Netflix investments and innovations - a unique mix of client and server-side ad insertions, state-of-the-art content delivery systems, ad encoding recipes, content understanding, and metadata, etc. We deliver ads in a manner that’s thoughtful of our member’s viewing experience and drive great outcomes for advertisers. We also ensure that advertiser brand safety is ensured during serving so that members only see the most appropriate ads for them.

Our team is faced with the enormous ambitions of building highly performant advertising systems and delivering high impact to our business by monetizing our incredible slate of content. As one of the newest entrants in the Connected TV advertising space that’s rapidly growing, we seek to build unique value propositions that help us differentiate us and become a market leader in record time. Our roles come with expectations of delivering in a rapid clip,  comfort with  lofty goals and big ambitions,   the visibility that comes with strategic initiatives, and  responsibility and an appetite to operate like a startup within an established company.


The Ads Finance team’s vision is to establish a compliant, accurate, automated, and omni-channel Finance and billing system that streamlines and optimizes financial operations for ads, with a core charter to create a unified and compliant Revenue Recognition layer, Automate billing, invoicing, and Journal processes. The Ads Finance platform centralizes and validates all the raw data—from campaign performance to pricing structures—needed to calculate and bill our diverse advertising revenue streams. This ensures financial integrity and consistency, providing a reliable foundation for all core Ad business operations, including budgeting, predicting future revenue, and managing credit and pricing strategies.

We are looking for highly experienced Engineers to architect and build the intersection of our Advertising and Finance systems. You will have an opportunity to design highly scalable application layers and data pipelines that handle high-throughput ad serving/bidding data while ensuring absolute financial accuracy, strict regulatory compliance, and seamless ledger integration.

  • Expertise building and integrating large-scale Finance or Payment systems with deep knowledge of revenue integrity (ACID compliance, revenue recognition, invoicing, data reconciliation, and financial reporting).

  • Experience designing multi-tenant, API-first architectures and scalable microservices (REST, gRPC, Protobuf).

  • Proven track record of delivering complex features with critical business impact in high-throughput environments.

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking with demonstrated product sense and leadership in the working environment.

Nice to haves:

  • Experience translating complex financial concepts into code (e.g., double-entry bookkeeping, journal automation, distributed transactions, tax engine integrations).

  • Experience working within regulated frameworks like SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley) compliance or IT General Controls (ITGC).

  • Working knowledge of event-driven architectures and streaming infrastructure (e.g., Apache Flink, Kafka Streams) to process upstream ad mutations for reactive billing.

We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

The Product Consumer Insights team uncovers compelling ways to attract and engage members around the globe. This Researcher role supports our Commerce team and is focused on understanding consumer perceptions and norms that may influence our plans, pricing, and longer-term business outlook. Specifically, this role will explore themes such as consumer value and willingness to pay, usage of competitor services, and industry norms and trends. 

This is an opportunity to lead innovative research with a demonstrable impact on a global scale. You will be responsible for defining, leading, analyzing, and socializing research studies that generate insights to empower business decisions across the company. You’ll partner with cross-functional teams passionate about delivering the most engaging, innovative, and inclusive experiences.

This role is open to a hybrid remote/in office working model in our Los Gatos location.

In This Role, You Will

  • Design, execute, and socialize research that generates insights to inform our global growth strategy

  • Synthesize data from multiple sources (surveys, behavioral, 3rd party) to craft clear insights with strategic business impact

  • Proactively partner with other CI researchers and cross-functional partners, including Product, Data Science, Finance & Strategy, Content, Marketing, and Brand, to develop new research initiatives

  • Identify best practices in existing and emerging research methodologies

About You

  • Experience in product research, market research, and/or analytics, including hands-on experience leading end-to-end quantitative research studies (e.g., surveys) 

  • Self-starter and problem solver who loves “getting in the weeds” with quantitative data (including survey data, public “big data” repositories, and internal logged data)

  • Experience with data querying, wrangling, analysis, and modeling; proficient in SQL and R

  • A balance of creative and analytical skills with the ability to proactively define research questions, identify appropriate methods, design and execute studies, implement statistical approaches to analyze survey data, and synthesize findings

  • Strong communicator with a bias toward action to proactively collaborate with multiple teams across the company

  • Experience or interest in growth research

  • Mixed methods research experience is preferred but not required 

  • An advanced degree in psychology, social sciences, or a related field is preferred but not required

  • Global research experience is preferred but not required

  • Knowledgeable of relevant statistical concepts (significance testing, regression/linear models). Experience with longitudinal analysis, multilevel/mixed effects modeling, psychometrics, conjoint, and/or survey weighting is a plus

info.title: Senior Manager, Content Policy & Online Safety, APAC
info.jobDescription:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

The Team

The Policy Strategy Partners (PSP) team sits within Netflix’s Global Affairs function as a global, central group of deep policy specialists. 

PSP provides substantive advice, industry and business acumen, strategic vision, and global connectivity to regional public policy teams and the broader business. 

We work closely with Global Affairs regional leads and cross‑functional partners in Content, Legal, Product, Communications, and Marketing to:

  • Shape Netflix’s global policy priorities and business strategies

  • Ensure strategies are locally resonant and aligned with cultural, legal, and regulatory realities

  • Lead engagement with civil society and industry organizations on tech and media policy

  • Within PSP, the Content Policy & Online Safety function focuses on how content, product features, and regulatory frameworks intersect across our portfolio, with a particular emphasis on kids, families, and broader online safety expectations.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Content Policy & Online Safety for a hybrid role based in APAC. This role blends content policy and online safety subject‑matter expertise, with a focus on sensitive content, media regulation, and emerging safety frameworks across the region.

You will:

  • Serve as a strategic advisor on content and online safety issues in APAC

  • Work closely with Content, Product, Legal and Global Affairs teams to anticipate and navigate evolving regulatory, cultural, and societal expectations

  • Help ensure our storytelling and product experiences for members, especially kids and families, are both creatively robust and responsibly delivered

This role requires comfort with ambiguity, excellent judgment, and the ability to move quickly and autonomously while being an effective collaborator.

Role Overview

As Senior Manager, Content Policy & Online Safety, APAC, you will:

  • Lead APAC‑focused content and online safety policy strategy within PSP, serving as a key regional expert on sensitive content, online safety regulation, and media frameworks

  • Translate global policy and regulatory developments into actionable strategies and guidance for local content and product teams

  • Provide nuanced, context‑specific advice on titles and features from concept through launch and beyond, with a focus on cultural sensitivities, societal norms, and regulatory constraints

  • Help define and articulate Netflix’s policy positions and approach to online safety and sensitive content in APAC, particularly for kids and family viewing and games

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategy & Policy Development

  • Translate global and regional policy trends (online safety, media regulation, content standards) into clear strategies for APAC.

  • Develop frameworks and guidance for sensitive content and online safety that can be applied consistently across APAC markets, while respecting local nuance.

  • Contribute to broader tech and media policy work within PSP (e.g., consumer protection, cultural policy) where it intersects with content and online safety.

2. Content Policy & Creative Support

  • Partner with APAC content teams to identify, anticipate, and navigate cultural, societal, and political sensitivities in titles.

  • Provide local, regional and global context to creative teams, helping them navigate the full lifecycle of content (from concept and production through launch, promotion and beyond).

  • Assess potential policy and regulatory risks associated with content and help devise creative, pragmatic solutions that protect both creative expression and the business.

  • Support teams in understanding and complying with existing and emerging media and online safety regulations that impact content and product experiences.


 

3. Online Safety & Product Partnership

  • Work closely with Product, Tech, Legal, and Global Affairs to translate online safety regulatory developments into product and policy strategy for APAC.

  • Monitor and analyze product developments (e.g., safety tools, parental controls, classification systems, kids experiences, games) for online safety implications and share insights internally.

  • Help design and refine programs, policies, and messaging that support safe and trusted experiences for members, particularly kids and families, across content and product surfaces.

4. Stakeholder Engagement & Advocacy

  • Engage with policymakers, regulators, industry associations, civil society, and third‑party experts in APAC on content and online safety issues.

  • Develop clear, compelling materials and positions (briefs, talking points, submissions) that explain Netflix’s services, product features, and approach to online safety and content.

  • Advocate for frameworks that safeguard users while supporting creative freedom and minimizing unnecessary encumbrances on content creation.

5. Cross‑Functional Collaboration & Thought Leadership

  • Act as a key point of contact for Content, Communications, Marketing, Legal, Security, and Product teams on APAC content policy and online safety matters.

  • Provide thought leadership to internal partners on evolving regulatory and cultural trends, spotting global themes and local inflection points.

  • Contribute to internal education and training efforts to deepen understanding of online safety and sensitive content issues across teams.

Requirements

  • Degree in Public Policy, Political Science, Law, International Relations, Film, Media, or a related field.

  • 15+ years of professional experience in public policy and/or content policy, with significant exposure to online safety, media regulation, and/or entertainment.

  • Strong understanding of the media and entertainment ecosystem and its regulatory landscape in APAC.

  • Demonstrated experience working with or within large, complex organizations and navigating cross‑functional decision‑making.

  • What Will Put You Ahead

  • Experience in a regulator, international or regional organization, or a large multinational (ideally with in‑house policy or content experience).

  • Deep understanding of APAC regional sensitivities (cultural, political, religious, social) and how they apply to content and online environments.

  • Proven track record of developing and implementing successful public policy or content policy strategies, including on sensitive or high‑profile topics.

  • Strong analytical, strategic, and creative judgment, with experience classifying and assessing content in different market contexts.

  • Experience engaging with government bodies, industry associations, or civil society on media, tech, or online safety issues.

Who You Are

  • A strategic thinker with strong problem‑solving skills who can manage conflicting priorities and work to clear outcomes.

  • Comfortable operating autonomously in a fast‑moving, ambiguous environment, while being a collaborative team player.

  • Skilled at influencing and aligning diverse stakeholders and synthesizing complex viewpoints into clear, practical recommendations.

  • An excellent communicator, able to translate technical and policy concepts for creative, legal, product, and business audiences.

  • Intellectually curious, proactive, and entrepreneurial - energized by building and iterating in a rapidly changing policy and cultural landscape.

  • Highly organized and able to manage multiple projects and tight deadlines without sacrificing quality.

  • Willing to travel within APAC and occasionally globally as needed.

  • This role is ideal for someone who is passionate about where storytelling, culture, technology, and safety intersect and who wants to help shape how millions of people across APAC experience Netflix.
