The Paved Path — our curated set of recommended, well-supported infrastructure standards — is constantly advancing as Netflix pushes into new technical territory. Our team exists to bring the fleet along with it: setting clear baselines, accelerating adoption across thousands of services, and protecting that progress from erosion over time. We affect both engineering culture and engineering quality at scale.

We operate in pods (3–6 month cycles), partnering closely with the most strategically critical initiatives across Infrastructure Engineering. We build the automation and tooling that lets us execute these at a scale and speed no manual effort could match, including AI-assisted code modification pipelines and fleet-wide orchestration systems.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced L5 Software Engineer who thrives at the intersection of large-scale systems, automation, and cross-functional influence. You will design and build the tooling and automation that powers fleet-wide migration campaigns, partner directly with platform and product teams to de-risk complex infrastructure changes, and help define what excellent Paved Path adoption looks like in practice at Netflix.

This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role. You will own migration projects end-to-end — from scoping and technical design through automated execution, quality validation, and completion. You'll also build durable tooling that outlasts any single campaign.

Key Responsibilities

Migration Engineering
Design and execute large-scale code and infrastructure migration campaigns across Netflix's fleet of thousands of repositories and services. Own the full lifecycle: scoping, campaign design, automated execution, validation, and completion.

Automation & Tooling
Build and extend PME's internal automation platforms — leveraging AI-assisted code modification, rule-based transformations, and batch orchestration — to scale the team's impact across the fleet with speed and reliability.

Technical Design
Write clear, well-researched design documents. Identify and communicate tradeoffs between migration approaches and drive decisions with data and stakeholder input.

Cross-Functional Partnership
Embed with partner teams driving the most crucial infrastructure-level strategic initiatives to deeply understand migration needs, de-risk project execution, and ensure campaigns land successfully with minimal customer toil.

Paved Path Advocacy
Proactively identify opportunities to improve Paved Path adoption and adherence. Surface patterns and systemic opportunities — then act on them. Influence product strategy and roadmaps of platform teams through direct engagement and data.

Operational Excellence
Instrument migrations with telemetry and dashboards. Monitor fleet health, track adoption rates, and build the feedback loops that continuously improve campaign design and execution.

Who You Are

A strong generalist engineer energized by scope and ambiguity — comfortable working across the full stack (backend services, automation pipelines, data models, dashboards) while building depth in the areas that matter most.

A systems thinker who understands that successful migrations are as much about people and process as they are about code — and designs solutions accordingly.

A self-directed owner who can take a high-priority, ambiguous challenge and drive it to completion across teams, time zones, and organizational boundaries.

Someone who builds customer trust through repeated, low-drama delivery. You communicate proactively, course-correct quickly, and leave things better than you found them.

A pragmatic builder who defaults to automation and reuse, builds tools that generalize beyond a single use case, and knows when to ship fast vs. when to invest in durability.

Required Experience

  • Strong backend engineering skills, with demonstrated ability to build and operate production services at scale (experience in Java or Python is a plus)

  • Proven experience navigating and operating within large, complex infrastructure ecosystems — understanding service interdependencies, fleet-wide patterns, and the ripple effects of change at scale

  • Deep, hands-on experience with AI-driven solutions — not as a user, but as a builder. You follow where the technology is going, form opinions, and bring that edge into the work

  • Proven ability to drive complex, cross-functional technical projects from design through completion

  • Strong technical writing: design docs, tradeoff analyses, postmortems

  • Experience working with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred: EC2, S3, EKS/Kubernetes)

  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, influence without authority, and partner effectively with senior stakeholders

Experience We'd Be Excited About

  • Experience with large-scale code migration or modernization campaigns

  • Experience building or operating fleet-management, dependency graph, or service catalog systems

  • Background in platform or infrastructure engineering organizations

  • Familiarity with Java or Python in a backend services context

Studio Creative Director - Next Games, A Netflix Game Studio

From games on TV to mobile and web, Next Games is a Netflix first-party studio that develops approachable games to entertain a diverse, global audience. 

We design games that Netflix members can enjoy every day as part of their subscription. The Role

The studio is growing, and we’re looking for an ambitious, experienced leader to head our creative and product development across a portfolio of approachable, accessible TV (cloud) and mobile games.

This senior leadership role is focused on overseeing a portfolio of game projects, ensuring their creative direction and quality bar align with business goals, market trends, and long-term growth, working closely with other Studio Leadership Team members and broader Netflix. 

You will operate at both the high-level strategic vision and creative direction for the studio and hands-on product oversight, guiding multiple projects from early concept through launch and live operations. You are the key guardian of quality across the studio’s core creative disciplines’ output: Game and Product Design, Art, and Audio, and a catalyst for new game incubation efforts.

This role reports to the Studio Managing Director and is a member of the Studio Leadership Team.

​Please note that because of the summer holiday period in July, we will take a summer break and countinue to go through applications in beginning of August. Thank you for your patience.

What You’ll Do

Define and drive portfolio strategy

  • Articulate the studio’s overall creative portfolio strategy, aligned with Netflix’s broader games strategy.

  • Ensure the creative direction of the portfolio supports business objectives (engagement, retention, growth) and reflects current and emerging market opportunities.

Oversee a portfolio of titles

  • Lead multiple TV (cloud) and mobile titles’ creative direction from incubation through live operations.

  • Continuously evaluate project health, quality, and trajectory, making clear recommendations on investment, greenlighting, pivoting, or sunsetting.

Lead and inspire core creative disciplines

  • Lead, mentor, and further shape the Game and Product Design, Art, and Audio disciplines.

  • Champion collaborative, holistic and player-focused creative practices and raise the quality bar across all disciplines.

  • Support new game incubation and experimentation, enabling rapid learning and iteration.

Partner across the studio and Netflix

  • Work closely with Studio Leadership, Game and Creative Discipline Directors on creative direction, portfolio’s creative assessment, and product roadmapping.

  • Collaborate with production, engineering, data, marketing, and other partners to ensure alignment on goals, timelines, and resources.

  • Represent the studio’s creative vision within the broader Netflix Games organization.

Build scalable ways of working

  • Define how creative work is structured and supported in a growing, multi-project environment.

  • Enable high autonomy for teams while establishing the right level of guidelines, standards, and decision-making clarity.

Experience We’re Looking For

Proven portfolio leadership

  • Track record of setting and executing a consistent product and creative vision across multiple game projects or a portfolio of games.

  • Experience in managing the creative direction of a slate of titles at different stages of the lifecycle (incubation, production, launch, live ops).

Leadership in fast-paced, scaling environments

  • Demonstrated experience leading and scaling creative teams and products in fast-moving, highly dynamic settings.

  • Background in building and managing high-performing multi-disciplinary teams.

Cross-disciplinary collaboration

  • Experience in working closely with creative, technical, and production partners.

  • Comfortable navigating a developer–publisher environment and balancing the needs of both sides.

Deep product & market understanding

  • Strong sense of what high-quality games look and feel like in today’s market, informed by both hands-on experience and creative judgment.

  • Experience using data, KPIs, and player insights to inform creative and product decisions.

  • Up-to-date knowledge of industry trends, player preferences, and the competitive landscape, ideally in mobile and/or TV / cloud gaming.

  • Strong, well-rounded understanding of game development, especially core creative disciplines (game and service design, art, audio), and solid familiarity with engineering and production.

  • Deep understanding of the game development lifecycle from incubation to live operations, including how to evolve products post-launch.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills; able to convey complex ideas clearly to creative, technical, and executive audiences.

  • Exceptional leadership and influencing skills with the ability to inspire, align, and motivate diverse teams without relying on hierarchy.

info.title: General Program Manager (L5) - Developer Enablement
info.jobDescription:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. The Developer Education (DevEd) team empowers every Netflix employee to create, innovate, and deliver at their best by providing accessible, relevant, and high-quality learning experiences. Our product is a more knowledgeable and capable Netflix workforce, not any single educational program. Our outcome is collective innovation, efficiency, and increased productivity across our enterprise.. 

DevEd operates as the Hub of educational expertise at Netflix, partnering with domain teams who provide deep local context and domain-specific content. We are catalysts and enablers, not gatekeepers. We focus on four strategic pillars: Onboarding & Foundational Learning, Continuing Education & Enablement, Documentation Excellence, and Innovation Enablement.

About the role

General Program Manager L5 with breadth and depth of experience in Developer Education and Enablement.

We are seeking an innovative, proactive learning enabler who is passionate about technical training and documentation, and who will amplify how engineers across Netflix learn, ship, and leverage AI in their day-to-day work.

In this role, you will own global developer learning programs end to end: from onboarding and ongoing education to documentation strategy, AI-assisted workflows, and analytics on developer productivity. You will design and deliver high-impact training, drive key enablement initiatives, and work across Engineering, Product, and Support to create learning experiences that measurably reduce friction and boost developer velocity.

This role is pivotal in accelerating developer velocity through jobs-to-be-done (JTBD) driven learning experiences. As a highly trusted individual contributor, you will shape how our global engineering organization learns, adopts new tools, and continuously improves how we build.

Role will require occasional travel to Netflix offices for onboarding, learning events, and quarterly onsites.

What you will do...

  • Design and deliver customized onboarding programs and continuing education experiences through engaging formats tailored for various engineering personas.

  • Manage and prioritize requests for new and updated technical training and documentation, ensuring alignment with strategic goals and learning needs.

  • Guide content creation alongside stakeholders using a train-the-trainer model, enabling domain teams to scale their own educational efforts.

  • Create insightful dashboards and performance metrics from raw data to measure and iterate on the effectiveness of onboarding programs, training sessions, and documentation quality.

  • Partner with internal and external program managers, instructional designers, technical writers, SMEs, and facilitators for program execution.

  • Foster a culture of continuous learning that promotes inclusion and empowers employees to own their growth.

Your experience must include or demonstrate…

  • Confidence in public speaking, with experience delivering technical content to diverse audiences, including seasoned engineers and people leaders.

  • Hands-on experience with GenAI tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude, Copilot) and ability to model effective AI-assisted workflows for technical audiences.

  • Ability to derive and apply data insights (support ticket analysis, learning outcomes, dashboards) to guide decisions

  • Track record of enabling and empowering teams/SMEs to create their own training content (e.g. train-the-trainer, hub-spoke models).

  • Proficiency in creating and editing engaging documentation, with strong opinions on documentation strategy, sustainability, and information architecture.

  • Ability to manage and prioritize a large volume and variety of requests while maintaining focus on high-impact, strategic initiatives.

  • Experience designing blended learning formats (live, hybrid, async, self-paced)

  • Experience leading large-scale initiatives end to end, and influencing stakeholders up, down, and across the organization

Other attributes that will excite us…

  • Deep GenAI fluency and enthusiasm for AI-powered productivity tools

  • Strong technical understanding and comfort collaborating closely with engineers

  • Experience optimizing global or remote training across multiple time zones

  • Familiarity with LMS or similar learning platforms

  • Experience balancing central standards with local team autonomy in training and documentation

  • Track record of running technical education or community events (internal conferences, tech talks, hackathons)

You will be tasked with jointly driving Netflix Advertising opportunities with key Agency partners and Client leaders as well as internal teams (Account Management, among others).  

You will be accountable for delivering revenue targets by leveraging Netflix's unique audience insights and premium content offerings, working closely with our Measurement Leads to develop the best-in-class measurement solutions to meet our Clients’ needs. The role will also be a focal point for driving the necessary internal developments to ensure our success. Proven expertise in effectively working with cross-functional collaboration with Go-to-Market (GTM) and commercial teams will be crucial.

The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of the programmatic advertising ecosystem, an established network of relationships, and a track record of building new market relationships and delivering meaningful revenue growth.

This role will be working out of Germany, and relocation can be supported.

  • Deep understanding of the Media Agencies/Holding Companies and an established network of relationships at the senior level within them.

info.title: Software Engineer 5 - Ads Pricing & Packaging
info.jobDescription:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

We launched a new ad-supported tier in November 2022 to offer our members more choice in how they consume their content. Our new tier allows us to attract new members at a lower price point, while also creating a compelling path for advertisers to reach audiences that are deeply engaged.

Our Team

The Ads Platform Engineering teams build advertising systems and integrations that powers the delivery of ads using our world class content delivery ecosystem. We use a number of Netflix investments and innovations to power our ads - unique mix of client and server side ad insertions, state of the art content delivery system, ad encoding recipes, content understanding and metadata etc. We deliver ads in a manner that’s thoughtful of our member’s viewing experience and drive great outcomes for advertisers. We also ensure that advertiser brand safety is ensured during serving, members only see the most appropriate ads for them.

The Ads Pricing and Packaging team is responsible for developing cutting-edge inventory management systems which support various monetization strategies, including dynamic pricing, rate card management, product packaging, inventory segmentation, and yield optimization.

Our team is new and yet faced with the enormous ambitions of building highly performant advertising systems and delivering high impact to our business by monetizing our incredible slate of content. As one of the newest entrants in the Connected TV advertising space that’s rapidly growing, we seek to build unique value propositions that help us differentiate from the competition and become a market leader in record time.

We are looking for highly motivated engineers working in the advertising space who are excited to join us on this journey.

Skills & experience we’re seeking:

  • Professional experience in building inventory management solutions that support monetization strategies such as dynamic pricing, rate card management, product packaging, inventory split and yield management.

  • General understanding of the advertising marketplace and landscape, with a focus on publisher side challenges like optimizing fill rates and maximizing revenue in the context of inventory management.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.

  • Developed many cloud based applications and comfortable with modern programming languages (preferably object oriented). Experience with distributed systems and microservices, NoSQL databases, queues like Apache Kafka and a solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.

  • Experience in working with cross-functional teams to drive large and complex projects.

Nice to haves:

  • Contributed to an ads industry technology standard (e.g  VAST, OpenRTB) or worked on an industry consortium effort, working group etc.

  • Familiarity with legal compliance and changing landscape of ads regulations around the world.

  • Experience working in the CTV space and knowledge of its unique constraints

info.title: Distributed Systems Engineer 4/5 - Cloud Platform Infrastructure Engineering Tooling
info.jobDescription:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

Netflix has been changing how people watch shows and movies, enabling on-demand access to thousands of movies and TV shows. Recently, Netflix has expanded its entertainment offering to include Live content, like the Jake Paul vs. Mike Tyson match, the NFL Christmas Games, Beyonce's halftime show, the SAG Awards ceremony, and more. Bringing stories in real time to 300+ million viewers around the world is a hard challenge, demanding exceptional levels of scaling, reliability, stability, and operational excellence across our Cloud Platform stack.

About the Team

Cloud Infrastructure Engineering (CIE) builds and operates the foundational platform that Netflix runs on — compute, storage, networking, and performance infrastructure, at global scale. We think of ourselves as platform engineers for infrastructure: building the systems, tools, and abstractions that let Netflix's engineering organization move fast without compromising reliability or efficiency.

We are building the Cloud Infrastructure Tooling team in Warsaw — a new team that will sit at the center of CIE, acting as a multiplier across compute, storage, networking, and performance teams. The charter is to build internal tooling, developer-facing UIs, and shared services that reduce duplication and let CIE's domain teams to increase velocity. The problems we'll solve are technically challenging: our customers will be some of the most demanding infrastructure engineers in the industry, and the systems they depend on run at Netflix scale.

If you want to understand the kind of engineering this team supports, explore:

  • Auto Scaling Production Services on Titus

  • Noisy Neighbor Detection with eBPF

  • Region Evacuation Reimagined

  • Evolving Region Evacuation

  • Consistent caching mechanism in Titus Gateway

  • Mount Mayhem at Netflix: Scaling Containers on Modern CPUs

What You Will Do

  • Design, build, and operate software solutions and tooling that serve CIE's compute, storage, networking, and performance engineering teams — the engineers who run Netflix's cloud infrastructure.

  • Solving real business needs at a large scale by applying your software engineering and analytical problem-solving skills.

  • Building software solutions and tools to improve developer experience and product experience in collaboration with team members and stakeholders.

  • Architecting and building a robust, scalable, and highly available distributed infrastructure.

  • Responsible for driving alignment with stakeholders and setting partner expectations.

  • Leading cross-functional initiatives and collaborating with engineers, product managers, and TPM across teams.

  • Sharing our experiences with the open source communities and contributing to Netflix OSS.

What We Are Looking For

  • 7 or more years of experience designing and building complex, scalable distributed data infrastructure

  • Proficiency in at least one of: Java, Go, or C++, with a strong software engineering foundation that enables you to write clean, maintainable, high-performance code.

  • Practical understanding of at least one infrastructure domain — compute, distributed storage, or cloud networking or performance.

  • Experience owning and delivering high-impact systems end-to-end, with accountability in dynamic and sometimes ambiguous environments.

  • Experience building and operating scalable, fault-tolerant, distributed systems

What Sets You Apart

  • Motivation to work on infrastructure that other engineers depend on, with a focus on building systems that are reliable and resilient.

  • Bringing a product mindset to internal tooling: you think about developer experience, adoption, and the real-world impact on the teams you serve.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and experience helping to shape problem definitions as well as solutions

  • Experience contributing to or engaging with open source infrastructure communities.

  • You approach technical challenges from first principles — you don't reach for familiar patterns when a better solution exists.

 Global Accounts Payable (AP) at Netflix sits within Finance Procurement Operations, alongside Business Partner (Procurement), Supplier Management Operations, Supplier Diversity, and Strategic Operations. AP processes ~ 300K invoices and disburses ~27B annually. We are seeking a Manager of Accounts Payable to lead our Americas AP team. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

 

Role Overview
 

We are looking for a Manager for the Ads Finance & Strategy team, based in Germany to act as the strategic partner to the Ads Sales business. This role partners with the Ads Sales country lead and broader leadership to define the long term ads strategy for the DACH markets, translate it into actionable annual and multi‑year plans, and advise local Ads leadership on market positioning, strategic initiatives, and growth priorities.
 

Key Responsibilities

  • Build a comprehensive, forward‑looking view of the German, Austrian and Swiss advertising markets— trends, regulations, competitive landscape, agency and advertiser dynamics — and identify long‑term growth opportunities across verticals, segments, formats and partner ecosystems.

  • Partner with the German Ads Leadership and cross-functional teams to launch the ads business in Austria and Switzerland.

  • Partner with FP&A and the wider Finance & Strategy  team to lead a long‑term annual planning process for the DACH markets, covering market sizing, targets, investment cases and pricing/deal strategy aligned to long‑term revenue goals.

  • Support business cases for major DACH initiatives (e.g., new product launches, key partnerships, new sales motions) with structured analysis and clear narratives.

  • Continuously monitor and interpret industry trends, competitive dynamics, customer behaviors, and regulatory shifts to anticipate market changes, assess their impact on our business, and translate external signals into clear, actionable strategic recommendations for both long‑term strategy and near‑term decision‑making.

  • Partner with Ads Leadership and Business Operations team in shaping the go‑to‑market strategies for the market, defining how we differentiate and position our ad solutions vs. global and local competitors.

  • Turn data into clear, actionable recommendations: lead monetization and yield analysis (CPM trends, inventory delivery, portfolio monetization), support pricing and deal decisions, and develop standardized reporting that informs weekly trading, quarterly business reviews  and leadership updates. 

  • Serves as the primary Finance & Strategy counterpart for the DACH Sales leadership and cross‑functional partners (Market Planning & Operations, Product, Marketing, Policy); facilitate alignment on strategic priorities and represent the perspective of the DACH markets in global forums.
     

What We're Looking For

info.title: Senior Researcher, Consumer Insights - Japan
info.jobDescription:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

At Netflix, we are shaping the future of entertainment by rethinking how the world discovers and experiences stories. As the industry evolves—from on-demand viewing to live events, new formats, and diversified monetization—understanding audiences deeply and connecting that understanding to decisions has never been more critical.


In Japan—one of Netflix’s most important and distinctive markets globally—this requires more than market knowledge. It demands a nuanced understanding of local audiences, creative communities, and cultural dynamics, and the ability to turn that into clear strategic direction for the business.


About this role
In this role, you will lead Consumer Insights (CI) for Japan, informing both the direction of the business and execution of key projects across Content (anime, live action, unscripted, live/sports) and increasingly Commerce and Product. You will help shape how Netflix identifies and creates “must-watch” moments, and how those moments drive audience growth and engagement.


This is a senior Consumer Insights leadership role in the market. The expectation is to operate as a strategic thinking partner to senior leaders—shaping how consumer understanding informs decisions, alongside delivering high-quality research.
You will own the end-to-end leadership of a thoughtfully constructed portfolio of work—ranging from high-impact strategic initiatives to more immediate business needs—based on what will drive the most value for the Japan business. This includes defining the right questions, driving research and synthesis, and ensuring insights land in decision-making forums with clear implications and actions.
The bar is on clarity of thinking, depth of insight, and business impact—rather than simply volume of output. A core part of the role is exercising strong judgment in shaping the right portfolio of work: balancing immediate business needs with longer-term, higher-impact opportunities, and making deliberate prioritization calls where needed.
Success in this role requires a deep and instinctive understanding of Japan—its audiences, media habits, and creative ecosystem—as well as the judgment to connect local nuance to broader strategic implications. Experience in entertainment, media, or advertising research is highly valuable, given the close connection between consumer insight and creative decision-making in this space.


What We’re Looking For

Contextual Fit

  • Over 10 years of significant experience living and working in Japan in a senior research / insights capacity

  • Native fluency Japanese and Business fluent in English

  • Comfortable operating within Netflix’s culture of high ownership, candor, and autonomy

  • Brings a deep, instinctive understanding of the Japanese consumer, media landscape, and creative ecosystem, and can turn that into business-relevant implications
     

Strategic Ownership & Judgment

  • Operates as a strategic thinking partner to senior business leaders, shaping decisions rather than executing requests

  • Defines the most important consumer questions for the market and proactively identifies where insights can drive impact

  • Demonstrates strong prioritization and judgment in shaping a balanced portfolio of work—knowing when to lean into deeper strategic initiatives and when to support more immediate, high-value business needs

  • Brings a clear voice in setting direction and identifying new strategic opportunities
     

Stakeholder Trust & Influence

  • Builds strong, trusted relationships across Content, Strategy, Product, Marketing/PR, Partnerships, and other cross-functional teams

  • Comfortable operating across different stakeholder levels, including senior leaders and external partners (e.g., studios, production)

  • Communicates clearly and proactively, ensuring insights are understood, adopted, and used

  • Works collaboratively without operating in silos, while maintaining an independent Consumer Insight perspective
     

End-to-End Consumer Insight Initiative Leadership

  • Proven track record of leading end-to-end Consumer Insight initiatives, including both strategic projects and high-impact business-driven work:

  • problem framing

  • stakeholder alignment

  • research design and execution

  • synthesis and landing insights into decisions

  • Ensures work is timely, well-structured, and action-oriented, with clear impact on business outcomes

  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and driving clarity across cross-functional teams

Insight Craft & Synthesis

  • Strong ability to turn consumer understanding into clear, compelling insights and recommendations that shape strategy

  • Able to move beyond individual studies when needed, synthesizing across signals, titles, and data sources into forward-looking narratives

  • Deep expertise in primary research (qualitative and quantitative), with strong judgment on when and how to apply each

  • Solid grounding in secondary data and business metrics to contextualize findings

Operating Model & Ways of Working

  • Operates effectively in a lean, high-impact environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution

  • Designs work around business priorities and decisions, not just research outputs

  • Exercises strong autonomy while staying closely connected to regional and global context

  • Leverages GenAI tools pragmatically to enhance research, synthesis, and stakeholder communication

  • Represents Japan within APAC Consumer Insights and the global Data & Insights organization, proactively bringing Japan perspectives into regional and global discussions to inform broader strategy

  • Mentors and develops the Japan team, providing clear direction, feedback, and coaching to the researcher to ensure strong delivery and continued capability growth


Essential Qualifications

  • Significant experience in Consumer Insights, ideally within entertainment, media, creative or technology environments

  • Proven experience operating in a fast-paced, highly cross-functional, and globally distributed organization

  • Strong foundation in both qualitative and quantitative research, with the ability to partner effectively with analytics and data science teams

  • Demonstrated ability to operate with high autonomy and ownership in ambiguous and evolving business contexts

Your responsibilities include oversight of the Retail Associate, Leads, and Crew that are engaging fans, selling merchandise, staffing the main retail space, and smaller pop-up locations while monitoring sales and revenue goals. You will be tasked with overseeing daily staffing plans, hiring, training, and developing the local retail crew. You will partner with our Retail Vendor team, who is the stakeholder in sourcing and purchasing products, ensuring sales revenue is optimized in collaboration with Netflix Corporate strategy. You are an individual who is passionate about sharing Netflix fandom by leading a crew that is set up for success with great training, knowledge, and the right tools to create memorable experiences. The ideal Retail Manager is a communicative leader dedicated to developing and connecting with their team.

This role reports to the Assistant General Manager and is a salaried, on-site role based in King of Prussia, PA.

  • Optimize ongoing operations to achieve maximum efficiency and best-in-class Fan Service.

  • Act as a Manager on Duty and Safety on Duty for the operation.

  • Align with the Assistant General Manager and other departments to provide a seamless Fan experience.

  • Promote and foster a mindset of continuous innovation for internal teams and external partners.

  • Experience managing direct and indirect teams in an environment that embraces continual learning and change.

info.title: Manager, Music Business Affairs
info.jobDescription:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

THE OPPORTUNITY
Our Legal team in Tokyo is looking for a new member to join the team: a Manager, Music Business Affairs who shares our passion for music, the entertainment industry and great content. Someone who seeks out and thrives in an environment where freedom and responsibility are a tenet, and passion, innovation and curiosity are mandates.  A stunning and selfless colleague for whom no task is too small or insurmountable.  If you loved the series and the music in Glass Heart and Stranger Things or if you love anime, this could be the job for you…

This unique and exciting role will  focus on providing music business, legal and strategy support for the production of Netflix Originals. The role will have broad responsibility and unique insight into multiple aspects of our business and the opportunity to work with a wide number of internal and external partners. This role would also work closely with Netflix's Music Team who are responsible for all of Netflix’s global music business and legal affairs and music strategy, from the production and licensing of Netflix Originals through to the distribution of the Netflix service globally. In addition to being supported by the Legal team based in the Tokyo office, this role will also be supported by the Music Group and its members across the globe.  This role will be based in our Tokyo office and will be a part of the Japan Legal team, while functionally reporting into the global Music team.

RESPONSIBILITIES
Responsibilities include overseeing all music business & legal affairs and all music clearance and music licensing matters during production (film, series), marketing and PR campaigns.  

This includes supporting our production partners in their negotiation of music deals (eg, composer, artist and songwriter deals, music supervisor deals, music clearances and music licensing deals, worldwide public domain assessments, record company and music publishing waivers) in addition to handling certain music deals in-house (eg, negotiating commercial terms and structuring, negotiating and drafting agreements with composers, songwriters, artists, performers, producers, record companies and music publishers, and clearing music and negotiating music license contracts).

This role will also provide music business & legal support and guidance to internal teams, including negotiating and drafting music terms in production services agreements, content licenses and other rights acquisition deals, providing guidance around the creation and delivery of cue sheets, song credits, providing music guidance and working closely with teams such as the Music Production teams and Creative teams, and leading and presenting music presentations and educational music sessions to internal teams and external production partners.  In addition, this role will also support ancillary exploitations of music rights such as soundtrack albums.   


As a Manager, Music Business Affairs your music experience enables you to handle any music situation or issue that may be encountered on a production. You are not flustered by the last minute surprises that inevitably arise when shooting a live action project, series, film or documentary.  

You are able to calmly navigate those situations to arrive at the best solution for the production and for Netflix.

You understand the dynamics among directors, executive producers, creative, line producers, producers, finance, production, post production, credits, labor, marketing, publicity, content localization, business and legal affairs and know when and how to engage and align the appropriate teams when a music issue arises. You also have a deep understanding of the music industry and the dynamics among recording artists, songwriters, record companies, music publishers, music producers, music supervisors's and CMOs such as JASRAC.  

You are comfortable evaluating risk with imperfect or lack of information and have the confidence to make quick decisions.  You may produce locally but you think globally. 


This is an opportunity to shape the future of entertainment.  

The ideal candidate will have: deep expertise in the music market for the production of series and/or film;  and hands-on experience in music clearance, music licensing and negotiating commercial terms and drafting music agreements for series/film/documentary production.   

REQUIREMENTS

The ideal candidate will have: 5+ years of music production experience for anime, series, film or documentaries, including direct, hands-on experience in structuring, negotiating and drafting composer, performer and featured artist agreements, master use and synchronization license agreements, music supervisor agreements, songwriter agreements, record company and music publishing waivers and soundtrack album agreements; in-depth knowledge of music copyright and the series/film production process - from development, budgeting, pre-production, production and post production to music clearance/licensing to composer engagement/recording through to delivery, cue sheets, marketing  and launch; practical knowledge of the Japan music and entertainment industries, including the role of CMOs such as JASRAC, and active relationships with music agents, lawyers,  managers, music publishers and record companies.  Experience providing in-house support in an anime, television, documentary or film production company and/or network is highly preferred.  

The successful candidate will also possess the following:

  • Fluency (written and spoken) in English and Japanese languages

  • Exceptional drafting and project management skills

  • Clear, concise and effective communication skills

  • Highly-collaborative and flexible with the ability to respond positively to change and new ideas

  • Experience managing heavy workflow independently.

  • Demonstrated curiosity about how different backgrounds and cultures affect us at work, and a commitment to acknowledge and work past implicit biases that we all have.

  • Unparalleled organizational skills and an unwavering attention to detail

  • Strong analytical capabilities and judgment, even when the rules are unclear and the issues are of first impression

  • Resourceful and able to pivot quickly, think practically and be solution-oriented

  • Curiosity and eagerness to tackle additional projects as needed, including matters outside of your area of expertise

  • Tech-savvy, with a strong sense of how cloud-based document and database systems are used in a modern business environment

Find out more about Who We Are and what our Culture is like.

  • A great communicator that can build strong working relationships with external advisors and internal teams

  • Able to quickly understand and integrate our business priorities with our finance objectives

  • Accustomed to multitasking, prioritising and meeting multiple tight deadlines

  • Curious and enthusiastic, that’s not afraid to ask questions and challenge the status quo

  • Highly accurate and detail-oriented 

  • Flexible to collaborate with Netflix teams across multiple offices and timezones


Education and Experience

  • Degree in Finance/Accounting and a Chartered Accountant 

  • Experience in efficiently working in a multinational environment and working with service providers

  • Experience in managing / building teams

info.title: Technical Services Coordinator, Netflix House - Philadelphia
info.jobDescription:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

Netflix House is a permanent entertainment venue where fans can interact with their favorite Netflix stories through immersive experiences and elevated hospitality. The first two locations will open at King of Prussia in Pennsylvania and Galleria Dallas in 2025. Netflix House is another step in Netflix's commitment to create immersive, in-person experiences for fans around the globe, including NETFLIX BITES Las Vegas, The Queen’s Ball: A Bridgerton Experience; Stranger Things: The Experience; Squid Game: The Experience, now open in New York, Madrid, Sydney and Seoul; and Stranger Things: The First Shadow, now open on London’s West End and coming to Broadway March 28. Netflix has reached 7.5 Million fans across 170 openings in 100 cities and 40 unique formats around the world with an average guest rating of 4.7 out of 5.

The Role

As the Technical Services Coordinator, you will report to and support the Technical Services Manager, focusing on the operation and maintenance of permanent elements and touring experiences that bring Netflix House to life. The coordinator role blends the focus of prioritization, hustle, and a love for continuous improvement of technical systems and processes. 

You will be involved with all on-site technical services needs, including preventative maintenance, daily technical support, and attraction operation.  You will ensure the smooth operation and repair of technical elements to best serve our Fans and Employees. This individual will need to communicate effectively with internal partners to ensure resources are readily available and operational to support the complex technical nature of the Netflix House experience. 

This on-site role is based in King of Prussia, PA.

What you will do: 

  • Assist in the daily support, maintenance, and technical readiness of Netflix House attractions, including lighting, A/V, show control, scenic, and special effects systems.

  • Support the Technical Services Manager and Coordinator in maintaining all technical aspects of Netflix House's permanent and touring experiences to consistently exceed fan expectations.  

  • Maintenance work, including, but not limited to, preventative maintenance, reviewing and completing repair requests, daily startup, shutdown, and tech support of attractions, handoff to operations, and ad-hoc work as needed.

  • Maintenance planning and implementation, spare parts management, and tool management.

  • Collect data and create documentation for new equipment installations.

  • Support internal stakeholders to ensure minimal disruption to Fan-facing Technical Services operations.

  • Support load-in/out, upgrades, and reconfigurations of both permanent and touring experiences.

  • Work closely and communicate with local Netflix House Attractions, Event, Facilities and Operations teams.

  • Participate in environmental, health and safety (EHS) and compliance initiatives, including routine inspections and readiness drills.

  • Contribute to regular reporting and briefings that capture technical activity, needs, and insights.

  • Promote and foster a mindset of continuous innovation for internal teams and external partners.

What we need from you:

  • Applicants must be at least 18 years of age to be considered for employment.

  • Demonstrated, 2+ years of technical experience in location-based entertainment industry, technical theme park maintenance, technical theater operations, touring technical operations or similar.

  • Knowledge of both permanent and touring experiences preferred.

  • Familiarity with all aspects of theatrical technical systems (lighting, AV, show control, scenic integration, SFX, rigging)

  • Familiarity with electronic circuits, controls, mechanisms, and equipment maintenance.

  • Familiarity with standards and regulatory bodies such as ASTM F24, UL, and TUV.

  • Familiarity with AR, VR, and emerging technologies production and integration is a plus.

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize tasks, maintenance schedules, and positive communication in a high-paced environment.

  • Strong desire to think outside the box and innovate through technical solutions.

  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and digital.

  • Excellent organizing skills using digital tools and Google Suite.

  • Availability to work days, nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotation schedule at a 365-day attraction.

The Role

As the Crew Lead (Retail), you will partner with the Retail Manager and Retail Supervisor to oversee the daily Fan (what we call our guests) and Crew (what we call our employees) experience in the Shop at Netflix House. Your responsibilities include supervising the retail Crew Members during their shift, ensuring they engage with Fans, promote merchandise, and monitor staffing and sales levels. You will be tasked with overseeing daily break plans and supporting operational and technology-related troubleshooting. You are an individual who is passionate about sharing your Netflix fandom through clear communication, product knowledge, and a desire to create memorable experiences. The ideal Retail Crew Lead is dedicated to connecting with their Crew and Fans.

You will focus on pre-shift communications for your assigned Crew, while assisting Supervisors and the Manager On Duty to uphold operational, safety, and Fan service standards within your area throughout your shift. You will be expected to lead by example in real-time by supporting the Crew as they move through retail workspaces.

This on-site, hourly role reports to the Retail Manager with daily oversight by the Retail Supervisor and is based in King of Prussia, PA.

What you will do: 

  • Act as the daily front-line supervisor of the retail Crew Members within Netflix House’s Shop, Kiosk, and Annex. 

  • Assist with the ongoing presentation of retail displays by implementing the provided visual merchandising guidance.

  • Assist with inventory, organization, and maintenance of back-of-house retail storage space.

  • Conduct pre-shift meetings to inspire the Crew and ensure that all staff have the critical information they need to succeed. 

  • Manage dynamic shift labor needs to ensure the correct number of Retail Crew Members are in place to meet daily attendance volume and event requirements.

  • Liaise with the management team on operational needs and issues.

  • Deliver a comprehensive Fan service strategy and act as the point of escalation for service recovery.

  • Ensure the Crew Members provide best-in-class service to our Fans by providing them with knowledge and feedback.

  • Act as a Netflix ambassador to help drive increased fandom and engagement with Netflix shows.

  • Conduct on-the-job training for various roles.

  • Execute Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), including emergency procedures.

  • Foster a culture of safety in all actions.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What we need from you:

  • Applicants must be at least 18 years of age to be considered for employment

  • Prior experience leading teams in retail within immersive experiences, live entertainment, theme parks, or theatre.

  • A calm, clear communicator who can prioritize tasks while staying responsive to Fan and Crew needs in a fast-paced work environment. 

  • A passion for retail experiences that focus on providing outstanding service.

  • Willingness to learn and/or understanding of environmental, health, and safety (EHS) protocols. 

  • A strong sense of ownership, reliability, and pride in creating retail experiences for guests.

  • Ability to inspire and provide feedback to Crew in real-time.

  • General knowledge of the Netflix platform and shows.

  • Availability to work days, nights, weekends, and holidays in a 365-day operation.

  • Strategic partner with Enterprise Operations functional partners Design & Construction, Space & Occupancy planning, Transportation, and Real Estate.

  • Collaborate and align with cross-functional partners such as Talent, AV, Ntech Ops, Corporate Events, Internal Comms, Security Operations, and Systems to ensure we constantly provide a frictionless, safe, and secure workplace and respond to incidents that will occur 24/7.

Qualifications:

  • 3-5 years of workplace experience, with an emphasis on hospitality, corporate, or campus management.

  • Experience leading a diverse team of full-time employees and third-party vendors. 

  • Ability to lead inclusively. Incorporate inclusive leadership principles to drive collaboration, creativity, and innovation among team members. Fosters a workplace environment where diverse perspectives are valued.

  • Strong focus on senior stakeholder engagement and ability to build relationships at all levels.

  • Passionate about creating a great place for employees & visitors.

info.title: Workplace Coordinator, Eyeline Korea (Fixed Term Contract - 12 Months)
info.jobDescription:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with 283 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. In 2021, Netflix acquired Scanline VFX which is a global visual effects company with over 32 years of experience and a reputation for delivering complex, photorealistic effects that enhance storytelling. Known for its expertise in virtual production and innovative technology, Scanline has contributed to major projects across various genres, solidifying its status as an industry leader, and started expanding its Korea operation under a newly named Eyeline Studios powered by Netflix to strengthen its visual effects capabilities and further elevate the quality of its content.

As part of the Global Enterprise Operations organization, the successful individual will play a pivotal role in the APAC Workplace team. This team is focused on providing an efficiently run, safe, amazing, inspiring, and consistent experience for our colleagues, visitors and partners. 

The main responsibilities of the Workplace team is to create an excellent and best-in-class Workplace environment and experience to enable our Netflix employees to do the best work of their lives and to help drive the business forward. The successful candidate will be a thought leader that’s highly adaptable, proactive and resourceful in leading a diverse team in delivering a stunning Workplace experience for our employees and visitors in a fast-paced environment. 

We are looking for an experienced Workplace professional who can grow and lead a successful, efficient, and high-performing Workplace team. This role requires a strategic individual with a crazy focus on excellence and a high growth mindset, and will report into the Manager, Korea Workplace. 

Responsibilities:

  • Deliver a five-star service experience: Act as the first point of contact for employees, guests, vendors, and interview candidates, ensuring all interactions reflect Netflix’s high standards for service, professionalism, and hospitality.

  • Support workplace operations: Build and maintain vendor relationships to ensure top-tier service, handle purchase orders, and oversee inventory of office supplies, swag, and front-of-house materials, ensuring nothing essential is ever out of stock.

  • Be a part of EH&S (Environment, Health & Safety) and ERT (Emergency Response Team) and act as Fire Warden/Emergency POC.Some on-call availability, flexible schedule for off-hours/emergency support

  • Keep communication flowing: Monitor and respond to inquiries on employee-facing platforms such as Slack, addressing questions and concerns efficiently while maintaining a helpful, approachable tone.

  • Maintain high workplace standards: Conduct regular site walkthroughs to ensure the workplace is clean, safe, and aesthetically aligned with Netflix’s culture. Identify and address health, safety, or maintenance issues proactively.

  • Execute memorable events: Collaborate with internal partners and external vendors to coordinate and facilitate employee events, ensuring smooth operations and a positive stakeholder experience.

  • Promote sustainability initiatives: Partner with vendors and internal teams to implement and improve sustainability efforts in workplace operations, driving eco-friendly practices across the office.

  • Create and refine playbooks: Develop and maintain detailed workplace playbooks to document processes, ensuring clarity and consistency for the team and enabling operational excellence.

  • Support cross-functional collaboration: Partner with teams across and outside of Enterprise Operations to execute key projects, improve processes, and meet shared objectives.

  • Contribute to workplace aesthetics: Work with the Workplace Operations team to ensure office aesthetics meet Netflix’s standards, creating an environment that’s welcoming, inspiring, and aligned with our brand.

  • Be agile and proactive: Provide support for ad-hoc projects and initiatives, from workplace pilots to employee engagement efforts, always staying flexible and focused on delivering exceptional results.

  • Oversee the food & beverage program to ensure that the program is designed to fuel creativity, collaboration, and connection.

  • Develop and oversee all Preventative Maintenance Program and ensure all office equipment are functioning properly.

 

Who You Are:

  • Experience: Minimum 5 years in facilities, workplace operations, and hospitality, ideally in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Entertainment or Media experience is a plus.

  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides) and Slack; experience with project management and ticketing tools such as Asana, Zendesk, or similar platforms.

  • Relationship Building: Proven ability to build and maintain positive relationships with team members, cross-functional partners, and external stakeholders, fostering collaboration and trust.

  • Operational Excellence: Proactive and self-motivated, with a strong focus on delivering exceptional results and driving continuous improvement.

  • Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, capable of conveying information clearly, concisely, and with confidence to a variety of audiences.

  • Problem Solving: Exceptional problem-solving abilities, with a willingness to take calculated risks, think creatively, and offer innovative solutions.

  • Organization and Multitasking: Adept at managing multiple priorities in a high-energy, creative environment. Demonstrates strong attention to detail, excellent organizational skills, and the ability to meet deadlines under pressure.

  • Flexibility: A positive, adaptable attitude and the willingness to work outside standard office hours when needed to support operations or events.

  • Culture: A clear understanding of and commitment to embracing Netflix’s unique culture of freedom and responsibility, while contributing to a collaborative and high-performing environment.

  • Ability to be discreet and maintain confidential information

  • Location & Availability: This is a full-time, on-site role based in Seoul, Korea.

  • Candidates must be available to work in person and comfortable working flexible hours, including early morning/late evenings and weekends, as needed.

info.title: Senior Product Designer, Ads Foundations
info.jobDescription:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with 283 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

We recently launched a new ad-supported tier to offer our members more choice in how they consume their content. Our new tier allows us to attract new members at a lower price point, while also creating a compelling path for advertisers to reach audiences that are deeply immersed.

To help us deliver this compelling experience, we’re looking for a highly ambitious, visionary, and experienced Senior Product Designer who will help enable the foundational design components and patterns for our consumer and platform advertising experience, including common capabilities like user access and support systems. Additionally, you will partner closely with our central design systems team to build out and maintain a thoughtful, robust, and extensible advertising design system. Your work will be essential to delivering a delightful, engaging, and highly relevant Ads experience for our Netflix members.

***Flexible Remote Model: This will be a hybrid role. The business will require onsite engagement weekly with the freedom to set a flexible work-from-home schedule. Onsite/Remote depends on the business needs and priority of onsite business meetings, and working from home in low-engagement days/weeks. This role would be best for candidates located in California or in the Pacific time zone, as monthly in-person travel will be required to collaborate with stakeholders and partners in Los Angeles, CA and Los Gatos, CA. That said, we can always make exceptions in location for the right candidate.

About Our Team

Our Ads Experience Design team designs the experience, technology, workflows, and capabilities that power Netflix’s advertising business.  We also design the foundational capabilities and technology for the next-generation of Netflix experiences, like Live entertainment. Our team’s primary superpower is the ability to design creatively and collaboratively in highly complex environments – from core services that power Netflix’s streaming technology to industry-leading partnership platforms.

You’ll be one of the lead designers who crafts the design system and core capabilities that power Netflix’s advertising experience.  More specifically, you’ll be a critical part of one of the most talented and trailblazing advertising design teams in the world.

Why You’ll Love Our Team

  • We’re big on individual responsibility and smart on process.

  • Work with stunning, supportive designers on problems that matter.

  • Top of market compensation and benefits, flexible time off, and work-life-balance.

  • Flexibility to balance work-from-home and in-office work, so long as you’re able to be onsite for meaningful moments of collaboration.

  • Freedom and flexibility to craft your own design workflow, while harnessing Netflix’s world-class design system and tooling.

  • Meaningful financial support for further education and professional growth.

  • An inclusive environment to help you do your best work and feel genuinely supported.

What You Will Do

  • Lead the design and execution of the advertising design system and core capabilities that power Netflix's ads experience. 

  • Partner with the central Netflix design system team to extend and contribute patterns and components.

  • Identify, research, and drive core capabilities that enable ads for our members, like access management, notifications, and support systems.

  • Craft design briefs that provide business, design, and engineering clarity for critical initiatives.

  • Collaborate with engineers, product managers, data scientists, tech writers, and business teams to develop and iterate upon new concepts and facilitate product execution.

What We’re Looking For

  • Domain familiarity with advertising technology and design system best practices - you’re comfortable with advertising nomenclature, operations, and Live streaming technology.

  • A passionate energy for great design and amplifying our team culture.

  • 8+ years as a Product Designer (or equivalent experience) in the B2B2C space, leading high-impact initiatives from concept to execution in technical business areas.

  • 4+ years as a Product Designer developing extensible React components and patterns leveraged across platform and consumer experiences.

  • A versatile portfolio that showcases deep interaction and problem solving skills, specifically case studies that demonstrate expertise and leadership solving complex business platforms through design systems.

  • Understanding of complex workflows designed to scale across diverse, global operations teams.

  • Excellent communication skills that excite stakeholders and articulate a vision.

  • Highly organized with meticulous attention to detail (e.g writing documentation to support your design decisions).

Even Better:

  • Ad tech domain expertise: you’ve developed expertise in delivering advertising technology to a global audience.

  • Experience working with complex internal systems, data platforms, and highly technical environments (like API platforms).

  • Experience leading design strategy for B2B2C advertising ecosystem (e.g. influencing product direction through the lens of experience design).

Compensation Range

Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $120,000 - $515,000

Benefits

Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs.  Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. This person should be able to generate a deep understanding of the content, its audience, and our media landscape and, most importantly, identify how it intersects with Mexican culture.

We work in a fast-paced environment and launch dozens of campaigns per year. At the end of a campaign, there’s always another creative challenge right around the corner.

Collaboration is essential in this role. This person will constantly need to balance the perspectives of our PR, Content, and Social Media partners to build strong synergies, find common ground, and align on the right way to bring our titles to market.

Experience & Skills

  • Leadership: The right leadership style for this position has experience managing creative teams (directly or indirectly). A humble, open-minded leader who excels at building bridges between teams.

A real expert on how to spot insights, write sharp briefs, set an innovative vision, identify big ideas, and make them happen in time.   • Strategic Mindset: A person who can connect the dots to produce cohesive work serving an authentic audience and a tangible goal, and where the tactics ladder up to a campaign strategy.

  • Title marketing campaigns- Develop and lead campaigns to generate conversation around our films and series.

  • Creative process- Knows how to optimize a creative workflow, stay on track with longer-term projects, and react quickly with creativity to new title opportunities.

  • Entertainment marketing. You will lead and launch unique and innovative campaigns for our Netflix originals and any other high-profile content; 

  • Cross-functional excellence. You will serve as a key voice in ensuring that PR, social, and content work seamlessly and in true synergy.

info.title: Director, Discovery & Promotion, Korea
info.jobDescription:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with 283 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

Company & Role Overview:  At Netflix, we are reinventing the way people are entertained by both enabling and innovating how visual storytelling is produced, discovered and enjoyed. Netflix provides a platform for stories from different places and different perspectives to reach, connect, and inspire millions of people all over the world. In this role, you sit at the intersection of content, marketing and product, powering one of the most transformational shifts in the industry. Netflix is the world's leading internet entertainment service with over 230 million members in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, documentaries, feature films, and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. As the Product Discovery & Promotion (PDP) Leader for Korea, you will grow, develop and lead a team that is ultimately responsible for contextualising what is special about Korean stories on our service - for the world.  Your team strives to authentically represent the multiple narratives that exist in every story so that our members can discover the stories that they will love.  You and your team define and drive the creative and operational strategy for how we represent and launch titles across these regions and partner with internal and external partners to ensure a seamless experience for our members in these countries and beyond. Key Characteristics Sought: You value, understand, and can deliver great experiences for our members
  • Approach problems with both a local and regional lens
  • Build strong partnerships locally, regionally, and globally to advocate for the needs, nuances, and complexity of Korea, while seeking a broader understanding and best practices
  • Have first-hand experience working with product/brand/content in Korea
  • Understands that local titles have the power to inspire global phenomena 
  • Have a strong track record of building and cultivating great locally-oriented teams
You are equally adept at defining and driving both Creative and Operational Excellence
  • Understands the challenges and importance of driving high-quality creative work at scale
  • Ensures regional and global business context is considered alongside local ambitions to find the sweet spot for this team
  • Inspires a multi-disciplinary team toward  shared goals, objectives, and opportunities
  • Complexity and volatility do not faze you - you are able to stretch to drive/ set strategy AND drive implementation/ execution
You are a strong strategic partner to cross-functional leaders
  • Great bridge - both to cross-functional teams; as well as to broader PDP (regionally + globally): equally adept at articulating your own vision while also collaborating to drive market success.
  • Adept at speaking to Product considerations (member-first approach, hypotheses forming and experimentation) as well as Marketing/Content concerns (audiences, how to integrate brand into day-to-day work, storytelling)
  • Influence and synthesize functional context and strategy for your teams in a way that best suits the needs of the markets.
You are a builder and developer of strong multidisciplinary teams
  • Bring nuanced and deep local business experience which allows you to provide input on local creative and operational strategy from a market perspective while influencing regional and global teams.
  • Be an excellent leader who sees the big picture. You know how to inspire your own team through the challenges of a rapidly evolving, complex business.
  • Be an invaluable colleague to your cross-functional stakeholders and partners by working with them closely to recognize opportunities and synthesize strategy across other countries, regions, and functions.
  • Be equally comfortable in “left brain” or “right brain” problem solving, but be most excited when both are deployed at the same time and understand how to leverage data and insights to push the boundaries of creative excellence. 
  • Have an eye for compelling creativity, inspire and set a high bar for quality, and advocate effectively on behalf of what’s best for the member experience.
  • Adept at identifying, innovating, and developing opportunities for efficiency and increased impact on the team. 
  • Have experience working within a matrix organisation structure - and be adept at effectively influencing and advocating for both local and global/ functional business goals, serving as a bridge between both.
  • Be an earnest and inclusive leader who will be a great steward of the Netflix culture while also helping it to shape and evolve over time.
Qualifications:
  • Leadership experience in a fast-paced growth environment, adept at scaling within a rapidly expanding company and market.
  • 10+ years of experience in building and growing diverse teams through hiring, developing, and managing a sizable team of high-performers. 
  • Experience working in Korea, with a nuanced understanding of navigating the local challenges and opportunities while synthesizing regional and global contexts.
  • Experience in managing teams and influencing outcomes in a matrix environment. 
  • Comfort working at a company, and in a team, where data and insights are heavily leveraged in decision-making.  First-hand experience with A/B testing is a plus.
  • Business fluency in Korean and English.

info.title: Researcher, Korea
info.jobDescription:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with 283 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

Netflix is the world’s leading streaming entertainment service for over 270 million households in more than 190 countries, connecting people of all ages with stories they love on any of their favorite devices.  The APAC Consumer Insights team is central in uncovering compelling ways to engage and entertain our members across Japan, South Korea, India, Southeast Asia, ANZ, Taiwan and Hong Kong. This Researcher (L4) role supports our country CI leads in Japan and South Korea, who support local decision-making across Content, Marketing, Partnerships, Payments and Monetization efforts.  This is an opportunity to lead innovative research, analysis and storytelling with a demonstrable impact on the growing APAC business. You will be responsible for defining, leading, analyzing and socializing research studies that generate insights to empower business decisions across the company. You’ll closely partner with cross-functional teams, and be passionate about delivering the most engaging, innovative and inclusive content and experiences to our members. In this role, you will:
  • Synthesize data from multiple sources (quantitative surveys, qualitative, behavioral, 3rd party) to craft clear meanings and create bigger insights.
  • Lead both qual and quant ad-hoc research projects across multiple countries and areas (Content, Marketing and Growth), under the guidance of the Japan/South Korea CI lead (Senior Researcher).
  • As part of the APAC CI team, proactively partner with other CI researchers and cross-functional partners, including Content, Marketing, Product, Data Science, Brand, FS&A, Partnerships, etc., to develop new research initiatives.
  • Note this role will start the onboarding in the APAC regional office in SG for 4-6 weeks before locating back to Tokyo/Seoul.
About you:
  • A resilient, flexible, and selfless individual with a growth mindset, comfortable managing through ambiguity and learning new things, who aligns with Netflix culture and values
  • 5-8 years of experience in content or audience related research, and/or analytics. Hands-on experience leading end-to-end quantitative research studies is required. Some mixed methods research experience is preferred but not required. 
  • A balance of creative and analytical skills with the ability to proactively define research questions, identify appropriate methods, execute studies and synthesize findings.
  • Able to prioritize their efforts in line with business needs, and juggle multiple requests from different colleagues.
  • Strong communicator with a bias toward action to proactively collaborate with multiple teams across the company.
  • Strong storytelling and data synthesizing skills.
  • A team player and collaborator who hates working in silo.
  • Attention to details, without losing sight of the big picture.
  • Self-starter and problem solver who loves “getting in the weeds” with quantitative data (including survey data, public “big data” repositories, and internal logged data).
  • Consumer research experience in Japan/South Korea is strongly preferred.
  • Business English and local language (Japanese/Korean) required.
