info.title: Social Marketing Lead, Japan
info.jobDescription:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with 283 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

The Netflix Social Marketing team brings the joy of watching Netflix into the social feed, entertaining fans anywhere they spend their time outside of the service, so they discover new titles to watch and talk about the Netflix brand, titles, and talents. Day to day, that means we set the strategy and work with other teams to curate and create content for Netflix-branded social channels, and develop new audiences across Facebook, X, Instagram, YouTube, podcasts, and more. 

We are seeking a Social Marketing Lead to head our social marketing team in Japan. In this role, you will be thinking through new ways to talk about Netflix content and larger cultural moments that shape conversation within our audience, owning the strategy for Netflix Social channels, and managing a world-class team. As the lead, you will also be hands-on and expected to work on developing title-level social marketing campaigns. To be successful, you’ll need to be a storyteller at heart and have excellent judgment to balance audience interests with the needs of our business. You’ll have a deep passion, appreciation, and understanding of TV, Film, and entertainment broadly, including the Japanese entertainment landscape, with a depth and breadth of knowledge of overall social expertise, consumers, and as well as global trends.

Social Marketing Team Mission:

Our Social Marketing team strives to advocate Netflix Japan as one of the leaders of Japan-centric entertainment culture. The team maximizes social presence effectively through triple media utilization and facilitating deep conversations by creating emotionally resonating content that connects our audience and Netflix titles.

Seek new Approaches: Explore new ideas and methods that break from the norm and emphasize the brand's personality. Create content that resonates with fans' emotions and encourages involvement with joy and deep engagement.

Maximize title excitement: Provide Social strategy and input consumer-centric POV. Maximize social media reach with efficiency by using triple media: Owned, Earned, Paid.

Foster brand love and trust and Build Fandom: Build awareness of Netflix’s diversified, rich, and high-quality content/catalog. Implement a cross-media campaign and its outlet for pre-membership retention. Cultivate and amplify a bigger, more passionate fan base to drive conversations.

Build on our leadership in the social: Continuing the platform growth/expansion roadmap and making a step forward for a mid-long term goal. Gain trust as the number 1 source of information for Netflix content. 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build and execute Netflix’s social media strategy including the Netflix long-term channel strategy & prioritization based on the audience strategy

  • Create innovative and engaging Social Marketing campaign strategies for Netflix-branded Live-action and Anime content

  • Identifying unique opportunities to elevate community conversation and the scale and influence of Netflix's Social channels overall

  • Manage and monitor what’s happening across all Netflix Social channels, including sentiment, trends, and metrics, and ensure content posted to our editorial channels fits into the overall Netflix Social Marketing and Brand strategy 

  • Own the innovation & trend management, identifying new opportunities, building a strong relationship with established and new & emerging platforms

  • Be the voice of our members & fans in the room, work with consumer insights to evolve our knowledge about the audiences

  • Be a Social Media advocate & loud voice internally and externally with partners, talent and producers

  • Manage a team of channel experts & own the social marketing budget

  • As part of the Japan Marketing Leadership team, help evolve and shape the overall Marketing strategy

  • Oversee cross-functional localization workflows for editorial content across channels

  • Work closely with the internal stakeholders in marketing & PR as well as content and others

  • Serve as a thought leader within the team and creative partner on other assets to ensure a healthy overall Netflix Social Marketing editorial ecosystem

The Ideal Candidate has/is:

  • 12+ years of experience in the social or digital marketing team in an agency, start-up, or consumer brand with people management experience.

  • Sophisticated understanding of online social platforms and communities.

  • Proven track record in owning and managing an upscaled digital campaign (and/or integrated marketing campaign) that successfully created meaningful conversations on/offline.

  • A strong grasp of language, especially in Japanese, and is able to write and create effective, engaging content that connects with audiences on social media.

  • Not afraid to switch between day-to-day tactical matters and high level strategy as needed.

  • Deep understanding of how cultural trends form, and the ability to anticipate and act on it.

  • Solid understanding of marketing and social media analytics; you are able to apply a data-centric approach to make content that grabs the attention of the audience and to test and optimize the content.

  • Excellent interpersonal skills and experience working directly with talent and talent representation, in meetings and on shoots/sets.

  • A team player who is able to engage and collaborate with internal teams at Netflix.

  • Excellent pitching/ presenting skills with the ability to read the room. 

  • Clear and concise communication skills in Japanese and English. 

  • Understanding of our unique culture and aligning with it.

  • High tolerance for change, and the capacity to accomplish enormous amounts in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment.

Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with 283 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

Netflix is the world's leading streaming entertainment service with over 278 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, documentaries and feature films across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can watch as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, on any internet-connected screen. Members can play, pause and resume watching, all without commercials or commitments. Join us on a journey to become a stunning team player in a growing Workplace Team to support our Seoul workplace.

We are looking for a Workplace Experience Coordinator who is organized yet flexible and is enthusiastic for both the practical and creative elements of strategic workplace Operations.  This role provides the opportunity to coordinate all aspects of our growing workplace services at the Seoul office, including but not limited to: daily food service and catering, company events, shipping and receiving. Netflix is a fast paced and demanding company that requires a special individual who is able to exercise good judgment and take fast initiative.

A successful candidate will be ready to give improvement suggestions and very passionate, self-motivated, proactive, quick-thinking, flexible, able to pivot when necessary, thorough and able to juggle multiple and diverse responsibilities with a strong emphasis on organization and an unwavering attention to detail at all times. This is a demanding and fast moving position that requires someone who is a proactive and positive thinker, and able to exercise good judgment and communication. 

Guest Services & Front Office Management

  • Oversee reception services and ensure all guests & visitors are provided exceptional experience

  • Ensure visitor badges and temporary passes are in stock 

Facilities and Site Management

  • Be part of a workplace team supporting the  day to day running of the building and workplace services

info.title: Credit Manager
info.jobDescription:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with 283 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

Key to the effort in building a global Internet TV network is the ability to grow and evolve our revenue-generating initiatives across the globe. We continue to introduce new commerce models, pricing strategies, and other opportunities to grow the business and this leader will have the chance to join the growing team of finance experts who support them. Our Revenue team is currently looking for a Credit and Collections Manager to build and develop a sophisticated and best-in-class credit management environment to ensure smooth and efficient business operations. This newly created position will look to solve complex issues across our B2B Revenue verticals, such as Advertising, Partnerships, and Consumer Products, and partner with multiple cross-functional teams to establish and scale our credit (and related) policies and workflows. This role will be based in the United States but will work cross-functionally across many time zones with our US and other international offices.

The perfect candidate will be hands-on and very detail-oriented, have excellent communication skills, be capable of multitasking, and take the initiative to implement efficient and scalable policies and procedures.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

  • Partner with Revenue Accounting and other business leads to design and implement credit policies for multiple revenue and payment streams, including ads, partnerships, payment processors, and consumer products.

  • Implement tools and solutions (1st and/or 3rd party) to enable a highly automated and scalable credit and risk management process.

  • Integrate with and lead the AR and Collections team and related workflows to ensure an efficient and cohesive operational model.

  • Manage the processing of customer credit, ensuring accuracy and efficiency.

  • Oversee the maintenance of accurate customer credit records, using ERP systems such as Workday and other systems.

  • Partner with cross-functional teams during the negotiation phase of large deals with a focus on minimizing DSO.

  • Develop, design, and lead the process for customer inquiries and customer monitoring related to credit and collections, providing prompt and effective solutions.

  • Develop and implement processes for credit and collections metrics and strategies to ensure optimal performance.

  • Perform detailed tracking and analysis of credit and cash collections and collaborate with internal accounting teams to ensure proper treatment under US GAAP.

  • Support monthly accounting close activities as needed.

  • Identify process gaps and drive projects to simplify and automate manual workflows.

QUALITIES WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • Thrive in a fast-paced environment with a high volume of transactions and tight deadlines.

  • Deep knowledge and expertise in Credit Management policies and operations.

  • A passion for building from the ground up with a vision towards the future and scale.

  • Ability to maintain a high level of accuracy in preparing and entering financial

information.

  • A great communicator who can cultivate strong cross-functional relationships and communicate effectively with internal teams and external partners.

  • Intellectually curious and passionate; our team members ask probing questions, challenge the status quo, make changes to improve processes, and have fun while doing it all.

  • Organized, detail oriented, and a speedy learner; you can be successful on our team if you're excited about learning, focused on becoming an expert in the areas you support, and have the drive to succeed.

  • Exemplifies the Netflix Culture.

  • Ability to deal with ambiguity and successfully execute the required tasks.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • 8+ years of relevant experience - credit management experience.

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Finance-related field.

  • Proven project management experience and demonstrated ability to develop a process from the ground up and iteratively improve the process to enable scale and efficiency.

  • Strong leadership skills with experience developing and mentoring others.

  • Experience leading a geographically dispersed team inclusive of an AR and Collections function in a lower cost location. 

  • Advanced Excel experience with the ability to navigate large data sets.

  • Experience with cloud based ERP systems. Workday Financials a plus! 

  • Experience with other Credit-related 3rd party systems and ticketing tools is a plus.

Our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. info.jobDescription:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with 283 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. The reach of Netflix and the fandom we create fuels the “Netflix effect” - a virtuous cycle of great content and intense fandom that catapults our stories into the cultural conversation. Netflix influences what people around the world search for and talk about, the music they listen to, the books they read, the countries they visit, and how they dress. 

Our marketing efforts help to kick start the Netflix effect, and we are providing more and more ways for fans to engage with our stores: Tudum, events like Netflix Bites and Bridgerton experiences, and the launch in 2025 of the first two Netflix House locations. 

Netflix is a data-driven company, and we are hiring multiple data engineers to increase our data support for marketing and fandom activities around the world. The opportunity for impact in these roles is enormous: Netflix social media channels generate more than 100B impressions a year, we are expanding fandom into the real world, and we’ve barely scratched the surface of the data available to support these activities.

What have you done and what do you know? 

  • You have 8+ years of experience and proficiency building data pipelines in both batch and real-time settings, to support a variety of use cases. Some of our data sources are small (e.g., sales at Netflix House), and some are enormous (e.g., social media feeds). Our stack is Spark, Flink, Hive/Iceberg, Kafka - experience with these specific technologies is helpful, but not strictly required.

  • You are proficient in Python for scripting, automation, and data orchestration frameworks, and you can write complex SQL (any variant) for ad-hoc and recurring workflows. You strive to write elegant and maintainable code, and you're comfortable picking up new technologies.

  • You understand how to model data efficiently for reporting and metrics, and how to organize data for scale and fast retrieval.

  • You have experience sourcing and modeling data from application APIs.

  • You’ve worked with common data warehouse solutions, such as Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, Vertica, Teradata, Greenplum, etc. 

What will you do?

  • Fully own critical pipelines and data sets to support Netflix efforts around marketing and fandom.  

  • Directly collaborate with stakeholders to understand needs, model tables using data warehouse best practices, and develop data pipelines to ensure the timely delivery of high quality data.

  • Creatively explore how to use data to continually add value to Netflix. Translate ambiguous business questions into clear data requirements, and then deliver on them.

  • Be a bridge between data engineering and the business, enabling insights that empower our colleagues to make better and more informed decisions. 

  • Build strong partnerships with data scientists, analytics engineers, and machine Learning practitioners to enable research and insight delivery for the business. 

Who are you? 

  • You want to live and breathe the Netflix Culture. Our ways of working are different, and you are excited to embrace and contribute to our culture. 

  • You work quickly and independently while also collaborating effectively across functions (e.g. with marketing experts, data scientists, product managers). 

  • You thrive in a fast paced environment, and see yourself as a partner with the business with the shared goal of moving the business forward.

  • You have a growth mindset, and expect the same from your colleagues. Not only talented, you are also curious,  authentic, selfless, determined, and industrious. You generously give and receive candid feedback, to grow yourself and those around you. 

  • You have strong beliefs that are weakly held: you can deliberate and hear all sides of a discussion, and adapt to new perspectives that emerge from it. 

  • You are a sharp communicator who can break down and explain complex data problems in clear and concise language.

Netflix offers amazing co-workers, new technology, fascinating analytical and technical challenges, and a Culture that's truly unique.

Our mission at Netflix is to connect global stories with global audiences. When a Netflix member opens our app, we have a few precious moments to help them choose a story that is right for them at that instance. Presenting them evidence – Artwork, Trailers, Synopses – that authentically represents each title and resonates with the member is essential to this effort.

Getting this evidence just right for each title is a tall order but our creative strategists, art designers, and video editors are masters of this. Perhaps a more unique aspect of Netflix is that these teams deeply leverage data to inform their decision making as they go about creative tasks like designing artwork & cutting trailers or clips. This is made possible because Netflix UI is a thriving learning machine where Artwork & Video assets are personalized via reinforcement learning. 

We’re looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer based in the United states. In this role, you would serve as a trusted partner for Creative Production leadership. Given this data & insights rich landscape, we are looking for a highly motivated Senior Analytics Engineer to partner with business teams and product managers to empower how we create Artwork and Trailers. Members can watch as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, on any Internet-connected screen. They can also play, pause, and resume watching, all without commercials or commitments.

The Ecosystem Solutions team builds tools that help people around the world integrate their technology with the Netflix platform quickly and with the highest quality. The results of our work can be seen around the world by hundreds of millions of Netflix members… and that number is growing every day.

We would like to find a leader who can help us build our Partner Core Components team in São Paulo.

The best candidate will be truly excited by the prospect of designing and building the common components that will allow us to continue the rapid growth of our portfolio; which underpins integration, certification, and monitoring the experience for Netflix integrations across 500+ partners and over 1800 different device types (most likely including the TV sitting in your living room right now!). 

  

A proven leader and a humble, personable self-starter with broad technical skills will be successful in this role.  You should be passionate about helping others and completely unsatisfied with the status quo.  In our organization, you will never run out of business opportunities or technical challenges.  Let’s entertain the world – together!

Delivery Core is a full-stack platform engineering team (we have frontend and backend engineers in one team) that enables continuous delivery of software and infrastructure changes across all Netflix services. We work cross-functionally with partners across engineering to make working inside the Netflix engineering ecosystem more efficient and enjoyable for all. We focus on increasing productivity, minimizing toil, and increasing the frequency and safety of software delivery.

What you could work on
Our team is primarily responsible for the developer platforms that roll out software and infrastructure changes to the entire Netflix fleet. We do this through our Continuous Delivery (CD) system Spinnaker, and our higher level declarative delivery-based platform, Managed Delivery. We are more closely unifying these products into one cohesive unified Delivery experience. Some example goals for projects include:
- Reduce friction and time to deploy software across our internal fleet
- Improve the safety of infrastructure changes 
- Improve ease of use for configuring application deployment specifications

What We’ll Expect From You
We are seeking a backend, distributed systems focused engineer who is comfortable writing, improving, maintaining, and sunsetting critical services at tremendous scale. Below are the specific behaviors and competencies important for this role.

Behaviors:

  • Cross-Functional – You enjoy collaborating with multiple teams on creating solutions and supporting solutions with a myriad of sometimes conflicting requirements.
  • Seeking Excellence – You enjoy the pursuit of engineering excellence by evangelizing, establishing and iterating on best practices.
  • Curiosity – You are curious and enjoy working on ambiguous problems where the solutions are not (yet) well defined.
  • Communication –  You are proficient in verbal and written mediums at explaining topics that the audience was not familiar with previously.

Core competencies:

  • You possess strong software skills in Java or other JVM languages.
  • You are experienced with operating complex distributed systems components (like databases, APIs (REST, gRPC, GraphQL), and controllers). You know how to debug them and how they can fail.
  • You are proficient in backend services and integration layers.
  • You are able to break down complexity, iterate, and communicate progress to a wide variety of partners and stakeholders

Helpful competencies:

  • You possess strong software skills in Java or Kotlin.
  • You have worked on a developer platform team where other engineers were your customers.
  • You have worked on schema changes in a federated GraphQL gateway.
  • You are familiar with the Spring Boot framework.
  • You are proficient with high volume data stores.

What to Expect From Us:

  • High Impact - your work will touch every engineer at the company and be crucial for the ongoing success of Netflix.
  • Stunning Colleagues - you will be working with other excellent people with diverse perspectives, who value collaboration, working to excel as the “dream team”. 
  • Energizing Challenges - there is a wealth of opportunity when working on complex technical projects and our culture both enables and encourages you to rise to the challenges.
  • Feedback – you will constantly have opportunities for growth because meaningful positive and constructive feedback is part of everyday life at Netflix.

info.title: Engineering Manager - Machine Learning for Content Personalization
info.jobDescription:
Netflix is one of the world’s leading entertainment services with 278 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

The Role

As Netflix continues to grow, we are venturing into exciting new frontiers of personalization to help our members find the content they will most enjoy. In particular, we’re seeking to expand the breadth of entertainment we can provide our members beyond movies and series to include games and live-streaming events. To do this, we need to enable our algorithms to recommend a broader range of content both by extending our existing approaches and taking on the unique challenges of different types of entertainment.



We are looking for a Manager to lead the Content Personalization Algorithms Engineering team. You will lead the way for a team of machine learning engineers and researchers to develop the next generation of algorithms that are capable of recommending from a wider selection of content. This includes being able to respond quickly to trending live events and using bootstrapping or transfer learning to personalize new entities within our system. It also involves enhancing our system’s understanding of the unique aspects of the content that we recommend.



In this role, you will be responsible for building and leading a team of world-class engineers and researchers doing cutting-edge applied machine learning. You will cultivate a vision and strategy for the team aligned with our mission and guide innovation projects from end-to-end: idea to production A/B tests. Your team will be responsible for improving our core recommendation algorithms as well as developing new ones, working in conjunction with many other teams spanning personalization, serving, product management, machine learning platforms, data engineering, data science, different content areas, and more. To be successful in this role, you need to have a strong machine learning and engineering background, be data-driven, have a passion for personalization, have an execution focus, a love of learning, and have the ability to partner well with multi-disciplinary, cross-functional teams and stakeholders. You also need to be great at giving and receiving feedback, championing new ideas, fostering an inclusive team culture, mentoring, empowering others, and balancing the needs of both engineering and research.


What we are looking for:

  • Experience building and leading a team of machine learning engineers and researchers.
  • A track record of leading successful real-world applications of machine learning.
  • Ability to lead in alignment with our unique culture.
  • Broad knowledge of machine learning with a strong mathematical foundation.
  • Strong understanding of software engineering and large-scale distributed systems.
  • Great interpersonal skills.
  • MS or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field.

You will ideally have experience with:

  • 10+ years of total experience including 5+ years of machine learning management.
  • Leading teams focused on Personalization, Search, or Recommender Systems.
  • Deep Learning, Ranking, LLMs, or Bandits/Reinforcement Learning.
  • Experience working on large-scale, consumer-facing machine-learning applications.

The Role

Fast-paced innovation in the theory and practice of large language models (LLMs) and other foundation models is greatly helping to advance state-of-the-art in personalization and discovery experiences. However, cost-effective and efficient training and serving of the models at Netflix’s scale is a technical challenge. Hence we are looking for an exceptional applied research engineer to help us develop the technology that would enable efficient training and serving of these models. 



In this role, you will aid applied research and product development by conceptualizing, designing, and implementing engineering improvements related to large-scale deep neural networks. You would have proven expertise in efficiency optimizations using techniques such as quantization, model pruning, distillation, compute-efficient finetuning, etc. You have to be deeply knowledgeable in ML hardware and software to be successful in this role. Additionally, you need solid software development skills, a love of learning, a passion for solving problems, a bias to action, and effective collaboration with scientists.

  • Deep understanding of TensorFlow and/or PyTorch.
  • Familiarity with hardware and software accelerators and GPU-based optimizations
  • Great interpersonal skills.

The Role

Netflix aspires to provide great entertainment for people everywhere from the world's best creators across movies, TV series, documentaries, comedy and more. Our members have control over what they watch, when and where.  It's an amazing time to join the Netflix team as we continue to transform entertainment. If you are a talented screenings executive with a passion for content and entertainment, keep reading! The Opportunity Netflix is driving new industry standards in the promotion of new technologies such as immersive sound, HDR, and groundbreaking display technologies. As the creative work on Netflix Originals evolves to engage with these new standards, the demand to review content in an immersive, technically accurate, and creatively engaging environment grows. The APAC Screenings Operations Team facilitates a variety of screenings in Netflix’s screening rooms, theaters, and other technical review spaces while providing exceptional service to Netflix’s teams and the filmmakers working on our shows. The growing slate and increasing number of screenings creates an opportunity for the Coordinator to be part of a highly impactful team. About the Role  We are looking for a Screenings Operations Coordinator who will play a key role in supporting a team of seasoned screenings and event professionals. The Coordinator will be at the center of operations that tie together screenings technicians, rooms/venues and assets for each request to ensure a successful event. As the face of the team, the Coordinator will be the first point of contact for internal client requests, leading all communications and project management. The scope of this role is broad and tasks are varied, extensive and timely. The role of a coordinator is one who can flex to support across a wide range of activities with different audiences. Primary focus: Creating tactical efficiencies for the screenings team. Lead project management of all screenings requests - from intake to delivery. Be the first point of contact for the team, from requests to escalations, working closely with the wider screenings and events teams across APAC. Lead meeting planning and preparation, work with other coordinators across the department to put in place a set of best practices that enable us to move quicker, bigger and better; coordinating with outside agencies, vendors, venues and internal teams; assisting with meeting schedules and facilitation, including help putting together documentations and coordinating screening assets and technical needs; updating documents; helping to coordinate and timelines. Manage  through team calendars, budget trackers, contracts and payments.  While this is a support role, there is a huge opportunity to make an impact on the team. Secondary focus: Support screenings which drive conversations around Netflix titles, talent and the brand. This can involve supporting the delivery of press, media or fan screenings. The Work

The Role

The Payments Administration & Contract Tracking (PACT) team supports the Scripted Series for the US/Canada (UCAN), UK, and Local Language Original (LLO) verticals and sits within the UCAN Business & Legal Affairs (BLA) team. The PACT team is responsible for ensuring all Above-The-Line (ATL) talent is paid timely and properly, and we calculate and track a variety of important dates and deadlines in connection with our Self-Managed Series. 



The Role:


This is a highly cross-functional role, and the successful candidate must be able to work effectively with the BLA team, Labor, Tax, Production, Creative, and Production Finance teams, in addition to our accounting teams. The candidate will also act as a strategic thought partner to those cross-functional teams as we innovate and experiment with new deal structures. ​


The Payments Administration & Contract Tracking Coordinator will have an extremely strong emphasis on organization and a high level of attention to detail as well as excellent verbal and written communication skills. The successful candidate will exemplify the core Netflix Values, be adaptable to change, be able to juggle multiple responsibilities at the same time, will be self-motivated, and must have the ability to work proactively, independently, and reliably under tight time frames in a fast-paced environment.  



In This Role You Will:

  • Proactively review, evaluate, and execute the contractual ​financial ​obligations of agreements and deal memos for ATL talent working domestically and internationally.  This includes payments for Rights Options/Purchases, Script Acquisitions, Development Materials, Early Writer's Rooms, Series Prep/Production/Post for Comedy Sitcoms and Multi-Cams, one-hour Dramatic Series, plus Limited and Event Series.  (ATL talent includes: Actors, Writers, Producers, Non-Writing Producers, Consultants, Directors, Line Producers, and Casting Directors) 
  • Prepare payment authorizations and payment schedules for ATL talent to facilitate timely and accurate payments through Netflix Studios, our Prep/Wrap Accounting Team, and​/or​ the individual show accounting teams.  Including but not limited to milestone payments, weekly salaries, bonuses, royalties, and the like.  We provide guidance for PH&W rates for the applicable guilds (if any). In addition, consultation with our tax team to flag potential issues with loan out corps, pay entities, work locations, production locations, etc.​
  • Track deadlines for ATL deals from the development phase through reversion, including subsequent seasons, talent and rights option deadlines, and hold periods. We draft and issue relevant notices, including extensions, option exercises, and report-to-work notices. We create and distribute option summaries to socialize subsequent season deadlines, tracking writers' room engagements, fees for SAG, WGA Article 67, and tracking orders to series deadlines.
  • Prepare DGA and DGC director deal memos for execution and ensure directors are paid accurately and timely (including additional days, reshoots, etc)
  • Create and maintain​ WGA tracking spreadsheets and liaise with script coordinators, internal creative, and our legal teams for episodic script reporting and step delivery notices to ensure timely payments  
  • Create and maintain development and series summaries for our assigned projects, upkeep of data-driven trackers for multiple cross-functional teams plus organization/filing and upkeep of all payment requests and back-up within a cloud-based document management system
  • Liaise with internal teams and outside productions regarding delivery of key documents to ensure our team is informed and payments are made in a timely fashion
  • Act as internal/external ​point-of-contact​ for payment and deadline-related questions
  • Periodically prepare cost analysis scenarios for various teams
  • Ensure ATL payroll start paperwork is received, complete​ , and accurate
  • Maintain flexibility and openness to take on additional projects as necessary, even outside of your area of expertise
  • Ability to respond positively to change and be receptive to new ideas, embrace and advocate for cultural diversity, and be solution-oriented

About You:

  • You have 3-5 years of experience in legal and/or business affairs at a television studio, production company or law firm, or experience in production payroll, production finance, or contracts and payments administration
  • You are well versed in the above-the-line union labor agreements (DGA, WGA, SAG-AFTRA, Local 399)
  • You have the ability to ​read, ​understand and summarize legal contracts with an emphasis on deadline triggers while having the ability to articulate issues using​ creative, production and financial context
  • You are proficient with Google Workspace (Drive, Docs, Sheets, Calendar and Mail) 
  • Additional knowledge of entertainment payroll practices outside of the US is a bonus, but not required. Netflix produces shows across the world, including but not limited to Vancouver, Toronto, Prague, New Zealand, Australia, South Africa, Germany, UK, etc.

info.jobDescription:

The Role

Netflix is a global internet video streaming service with over 235 million members worldwide. Our members enjoy more than one billion hours of streamed video per week, on thousands of different types of devices. Building, testing, deploying and validating changes across all these experiences is a large and complex process. Come join us in building rich observability into our platform to help us ship Netflix faster and more reliably. What sets us apart:We are building a platform that pushes confidence in a change closer and closer to the moment of development. This journey began with a deep investment in real-time metrics and analysis of production changes by leveraging A/B Canaries. We are now early in the early stages of building comprehensive observability into every aspect of the software development lifecycle. Our goal is to simplify the process of releasing high quality software at scale, allowing engineers to focus entirely on their features. What you will do:
  • Investigate, design and build a CI/CD Observability platform that allows our engineers to visualize, track, validate and interact with code changes at all stages of the software development lifecycle.
  • Effectively collaborate and communicate with internal partner teams on their developer experience opportunities and challenges.
  • Instrument and measure all aspects of the software development lifecycle to surface the highest impact opportunities for innovation.
What sets you apart:
  • 7+ years of relevant full-stack software development experience. 
  • Expertise developing data rich frontend user experiences.
  • Expertise developing restful, graphQL or gRPC services.
  • Experience developing internal, operational tooling.

About the Compute group:

Netflix’s Compute group owns our internet-scale cloud footprint. We constantly innovate to increase fleet-wide agility, efficiency, and reliability of this infrastructure. We build, operate, and maintain Compute services so that Netflix developers can rely on foundational building blocks that enable a “set it and forget it” approach to achieving scalability and cost efficiency. We are responsible for one of the largest Cloud Compute footprints built on AWS, and constantly seeking to push boundaries through innovation to delight hundreds of millions of Netflix users daily.


About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced staff engineer to drive the Compute Runtime team’s charter, guide the team's engineering work, and break new ground through hands-on innovation on the hardest technical challenges. You will be part of the team of engineers responsible for the runtime portion of our Cloud Compute group. The team is responsible for enabling containers to run on our compute nodes as efficiently and reliably as possible. The team owns the Kubernetes data plane software; the container runtime; the way we download and run containers; and the underlying compute node’s operating system. The team partners with many other teams within Netflix to ensure we stay ahead of the business's needs and enable other teams to innovate on top of our platform.


You will be amongst the stunning set of engineers who tackle some of the largest Cloud Compute challenges in the industry. We are moving quickly to support critical business initiatives. You will own key pieces of the Cloud Compute infrastructure and be able to directly trace your work to meaningful business impact, all while working on extremely high-scale systems only found at a handful of companies.


Some examples of the team’s work can be found in tech blogs on “noisy neighbor” detection and mount lock contention.


What you will do:

  • Deliver compute platform capabilities and drive adoption across Netflix with a focus on engineering excellence, decisive execution, a spirit of bold experimentation, and tight alignment with business context.
  • You are an expert in building scalable and extensible compute platforms, and even better at working with other experts. You form strong cross-functional partnerships driven by trust, embracing a highly aligned and loosely coupled approach with many engineering teams, ensuring our solutions meet their needs while maintaining our focus on agility, scalability, reliability, and efficiency.
  • Set the example for operational excellence on the team and across Compute, continuously improving incident response, on-call, and other operational practices.
  • Maintain currency on, if not create, industry trends for new architectures, features, and off-the-shelf services; guide the team’s decision-making on incorporating industry trends.
  • You recognize industry trends early and stay ahead by developing new architectures, features, and off-the-shelf services, while guiding the team's decisions on when and how to adopt them. Identifying trends matters, but you go further: driven by a passion to learn from and contribute to the open-source world, you keep a pulse on it to shape and forecast the direction of technology.

  • A proven track record of architecting and implementing large-scale distributed systems that define and modify infrastructure at 100M+ user scale.

info.title: Engineering Manager — Change Systems
info.jobDescription:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

About the Organization

Platform Modernization Engineering (PME) helps keep Netflix's engineering fleet healthy, secure, and current. We design and run the large-scale migration and modernization campaigns that move the fleet forward — from dependency upgrades to infrastructure-level changes — so that individual engineering teams don't have to absorb that toil on their own.



About the Team and the Role

The Change Systems team owns the platforms that make fleet-wide change possible at Netflix.  It gives engineering teams across the company a unified way to scope, launch, automate, and validate change at scale — from routine dependency updates to complex, multi-service migrations — with as little manual toil as possible.

The platform already operates at significant scale: over 100 engineering teams run change activities across thousands of repositories, and usage continues to grow year over year. The team's mandate is expanding to match — pushing automation further using AI-assisted code modification, rule-based transformations, and batch orchestration. The goal is to make the majority of change at Netflix low-to-no-effort for the engineers on the receiving end, while giving the teams driving that change the tooling, telemetry, and adoption data they need to move with confidence.


You will lead the engineers who build and operate this platform, based in Warsaw. This is a team with deep end-to-end ownership: they run their own on-call, design the automation and orchestration layers directly, and are pushing the platform toward AI-driven code transformation as a first-class capability rather than a one-off tool. 



End-to-end ownership translates into several responsibilities:

  • From a technical perspective, acting like a System Architect, driving technical architecture and component integration; 
  • From a product perspective, wearing the Product Manager hat for Campaigns and defining the vision and strategy for the Campaigns experience; 
  • From a partnership and stakeholders' perspective, identifying needs, incorporating feedback, aligning across the organization, creating partnerships to drive impact
  • From a leadership perspective, acting like a Change Agent and Advocate supporting the overall organization in shaping the mindset and approach around Campaigns (change at scale) in the agentic world; 



The platform is at an inflection point, which makes this role particularly important:

  • From tooling to platform. Change Systems has built strong point solutions for individual campaigns. The next step is composable, declarative abstractions that every part of the platform — and the teams building on top of it — share a common foundation rather than one-off automation.
  • From manual campaign design to AI-assisted execution. GenAI-driven code transformation, contract-based validation, and batch orchestration are becoming core to how campaigns get executed — across code transformation, CI, testing, and delivery to production.
  • From reactive to metrics-driven prioritization. Using historical campaign completion data to predict bottlenecks, target specific automation investments, and measure adoption and adherence rather than simply responding to inbound requests.
  • From isolated campaigns to a coherent customer experience. Close technical alignment is required with Source Management, Continuous Integration, Resilience Engineering and Delivery Engineering and Security so that campaign recipients experience one coherent platform, not a patchwork of tools.



What You Will Do

  • Be a thought partner to Organization Champions, Campaign Managers, Campaign Recipients, and engineering leadership in setting the vision, strategy, and adoption path for fleet-wide change management as a platform capability.
  • Own the technical architecture direction for a composable, declarative platform that generalizes beyond any single migration use case.
  • Serve as a credible technical advisor to your team, helping engineers navigate ambiguous, cross-domain technical decisions — and act as the team's escalation point for novel campaigns that span multiple technical domains.
  • Drive AI-first ways of working across the team: treat AI-assisted code modification as core infrastructure, and advance agent-assisted engineering practices with the code review, change-risk management, testing, and evaluation rigor required to run them safely at scale.
  • Raise the team's rigor around impact — define meaningful adoption and adherence metrics, use historical campaign data to predict and target automation investment, and prioritize based on evidence rather than only inbound requests.
  • Own the operational excellence of a platform relied on across the fleet, including on-call responsibilities, telemetry and dashboards for fleet health, and feedback loops that continuously improve campaign design and execution.
  • Communicate complex technical and product tradeoffs clearly, in writing and verbally, to influence decisions across a broad set of stakeholders — including technical executives, SREs, and security incident commanders.
  • Lead, hire, coach, and develop a team of engineers; challenge them to expand their ownership and grow their impact beyond their immediate scope.
  • Foster a strong culture of accountability, and build an inclusive team environment where every engineer feels empowered to contribute at their best.



What We Are Looking For

  • Experience building and operating platform systems that support large-scale, business-critical use cases, including on-call responsibilities and resilient, well-instrumented services.
  • Strong technical acumen in distributed systems and developer platforms, with the ability to move between architecture and implementation detail, and to represent technical decisions credibly to partner teams.
  • Experience building and leading inclusive engineering teams, attracting and retaining talent, and fostering a culture where individuals take ownership while contributing to shared outcomes.
  • Strong long-term strategic thinking and a platform mindset — able to define a technical vision for composable, extensible systems and connect it to broader organizational goals.
  • Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, influence without authority, and partner effectively with senior stakeholders across engineering, product, and security.
  • Rigor in decision-making: comfortable reducing ambiguity through a mix of data, stakeholder input, constructive dissent, and targeted experiments.
  • Fluency with AI-assisted engineering, with a clear point of view on how to adopt GenAI-driven code transformation and agentic tooling safely at scale.
  • Strong technical writing skills — design docs, tradeoff analyses, postmortems — and a track record of driving complex, cross-functional technical projects from design through completion.



Nice to Have

  • Experience with large-scale code migration or modernization campaigns.
  • Experience building or operating fleet-management, dependency graph, or service catalog systems.
  • Background in platform or infrastructure engineering organizations.
  • Familiarity with Java or Python in a backend services context.
  • Experience designing platforms where agents, not just humans, are first-class consumers — including provisioning and debugging through APIs rather than a UI.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred: EC2, S3, EKS/Kubernetes).

info.jobDescription:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. The Team

The New Content Exploration product team is leading the strategy to shape how Netflix members discover and engage with new content types. This includes 0 to 1 areas such as Live events, Podcasts, Creator content, Games discovery and more. Our team is responsible for building the end-to-end member experience for Live and delivering innovative Sports features to market. Our work spans all platforms (TV/living room, mobile, tablet, and web), and includes features and experiences across discovery/browse, player, profiles, and new surfaces. 


In the past two years, Netflix has been home to record-breaking NFL Games, Boxing Events, and the World Baseball Classic Tournament. Netflix is accelerating its ambitions to capture real-time, unscripted magic of Live events looking ahead to the Women's World Cup and beyond. As the ambitions for Live and Sports are growing bigger and bolder in the years to come, a truly innovative product experience plays a critical role in bringing the magic to our members.


The Role

As Product Manager for the Sports Experience, you will own the end-to-end execution of new features for our Sports content slate. You will work in close partnership with the Product Lead for Live and Sports to align on the overall roadmap and priorities. You will directly own portfolio features across the roadmap spanning the Discovery and Playback experience. As we look to onboard new content experiences, you will be at the forefront of scaling our Sports features to those partners. You’ll interface closely with a broad cross-functional team including Design, Engineering, Data Science, Marketing, Content and Product. 


You must be comfortable at the hub of a fast-paced environment where you interface daily with cross-functional experts across both the tech and entertainment sides of the business, with proven success in balancing requirements/tradeoffs effectively. You must be passionate about building alignment, while not being afraid to push ahead when there remain some critics, influencing and keeping momentum in the face of ambiguity.  


What You’ll Do

  • Launch new features by owning workstreams end-to-end, from framing the problem through launch, measurement, and the next iteration. You drive your areas independently with strong responsibility.
  • Influence a team of stunning colleagues across design, engineering, consumer insights, merchandising and data science to deliver outstanding products  
  • Proactively identify new investments by leveraging consumer insights, market trends, and platform data to uncover new product opportunities for Sports, actively shaping the broader strategic roadmap for our rapidly expanding live ecosystem. 
  • Working through open-ended problems and identifying opportunities for evolution of existing or conceptualizing new discovery, capability or feature requirements 
  • Build business cases and measure the impact of your product innovation, with your data science partners
  • Run A/B tests and set the success metrics before launch, run the tests with your data science partners, and interpret the results. 

What You’ll Bring

As Product Manager, Sports Experience, you’ll be passionate about the work, bringing:

  • 6+ years of experience developing consumer products and features and comfortable operating with complex tradeoffs
  • Experience working on Live Sports streaming products at scale, and a great understanding of the Sports lifecycle
  • Very high attention to detail, with an ability to connect the smallest experience elements to the big picture goals at the company and team level
  • Excellent bias to action, shipping and iterating on 0 to 1 projects quickly.
  • Ability to function as the E2E owner of the product development life cycle from inception through planning to launch
  • Working effectively across cross functional teams to drive alignment
  • Experience with A/B testing, and strong business acumen with proficiency in identifying, tracking and acting upon metrics, designing tests, and collaborating with data science partners
  • Excellent data-informed judgment, and ability to leverage data in service of telling the right story, not the other way around
  • Great balance of being collaborative and open to alternative views while being decisive and clearly communicating vision
  • An eagerness to seek feedback and improve

  • Responsibility & Autonomy: We believe in transparency and empower our employees with the autonomy to innovate. Our unique Netflix culture is a cornerstone of how we drive innovation.
  • Creative Freedom: Experience the freedom to tackle interesting challenges and influence outcomes in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. 
  • Collaborative Excellence: Work alongside intelligent, driven individuals who are passionate about solving complex problems together and fostering accountability of high performance.

Location of Work 

The Product Merchandising organization embraces flexibility w/r/t location of work, with most folks working remotely. This US-based role has flexibility from West to East coasts, with the understanding that key collaborators are primarily based in our California offices (Los Angeles and Los Gatos) therefore an expectation of availability during CA working hours is set. Department: Tax Operations

Reports To: Senior Manager, Tax Operations - US Indirect Tax 



The Role


Netflix's US Indirect Tax ("ITX") team manages transaction taxes collected from customers and remitted to state and local governments — including sales, use, amusement, communication services, and admissions taxes — as well as property tax, business license tax, and certain gross receipts taxes.

We're looking for an experienced, detail-oriented US Indirect Tax Senior Analyst to own compliance, audit, analytical, and research work across multiple tax types. The ideal candidate has extensive compliance and audit experience and is a self-starter with strong organizational, communication, and process improvement skills.  This is a hands-on role for someone who can successfully execute multiple priorities in parallel, is highly detail-oriented in calculations and writing, and identifies and implements process improvements. 

Responsibilities

  • Manage sales and use tax audits from notice through resolution, including data gathering, workpaper preparation, exposure analysis, and correspondence with state and local auditors.
  • Prepare and review sales/use, gross receipts, business license, and other transaction taxes compliance filings across multiple jurisdictions, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
  • Perform Month End accounting reviews, including preparing journal entries for tax reclassification and completing account reconciliations.
  • Gather and review information for Unclaimed Property Compliance, including coordinating data deliverables from AP, Payroll, and Production Finance.
  • Assist in personal and real property tax compliance, including valuation review and coordination with outside property tax consultants (e.g., appeal filings and support).
  • Support personal and real property tax audits, including responding to information requests and evaluating assessment notices.
  • Identify and implement process improvements across audit and compliance workflows — including automation opportunities — to reduce manual effort and improve accuracy.
  • Research and analyze technical indirect tax issues (e.g., nexus, taxability, sourcing) and summarize conclusions for the team and stakeholders.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Finance, Accounting, Legal, and outside advisors on process improvement projects, audit strategy, business support, and compliance matters.
  • Maintain clear, audit-ready documentation and workpapers to support internal review, SOX testing, and external audit requests.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field, is required.
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in state and local/indirect tax, including sales/use tax audit and compliance work.
  • Strong analytical skills and experience working with large transactional data sets.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to manage competing audit and compliance deadlines and an array of competing priorities.
  • A track record of identifying and driving process improvement in indirect tax operations.
  • Excellent communication and project management skills, with the ability to collaborate and manage a variety of competing priorities.

info.title: Data Scientist 5 - Media Science DSE
info.jobDescription:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.


Netflix Animation Studios (NAS) is Netflix's in-house feature animation studio, delivering the exceptional artistry behind big hits like Leo, KPop Demon Hunters, and The Sea Beast. 


Media Science DSE is hiring for an embedded role to stand up our data science capability within NAS. How well NAS plans for and manages its growing slate and workforce has a direct impact on the creative and financial success of its films. As a Data Scientist, you'll construct and execute the roadmap for analysis, models, and data products that connect finance, production, and people data into a single system empowering slate planning, operational forecasting, and strategic decision-making for the Studio. You'll work directly with NAS leadership across Studio Operations and Production to architect the robust data foundations NAS needs to scale its slate with confidence.


As a Senior Data Scientist in this space, you will…

  • Serve as NAS's founding data scientist, partnering with leadership to define and prioritize the studio's metrics & science agenda
  • Strategically thought partner to scope ambiguous, greenfield questions - proposing and delivering analysis and science that introduce and influence data-informed ways of thinking
  • Own the end-to-end measurement agenda in partnership with data engineering - spanning data model design; new metric development, analysis, and forecasting; and the interpretation and dissemination of results
  • Conduct slate analysis that surfaces drivers of show efficiency as a means to preserve creative optionality across shows
  • Develop scenario planning models that quantify how schedule changes ripple across the production slate - giving leadership the visibility they need to proactively manage production timelines and workforce allocation
  • Build dashboards and scorecards that allow leadership to continuously monitor show statuses and potential risks
  • Present your metrics, models, and analytical insights clearly to a leadership audience, translating complex analysis into decisions NAS can act on
  • Collaborate with data scientists, analytics engineers, and data engineers across Media Science DSE to apply existing metric and viz approaches to NAS, where appropriate

About you…

  • Advanced degree in Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Economics, Operations Research, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience)
  • 8+ years of experience as a data scientist, with a track record of developing and executing measurement frameworks, models, and visualization products that directly inform business decisions
  • Experience building scenario planning, forecasting, or optimization models in operationally complex, resource-constrained environments
  • Strong quantitative and statistical intuition, comfortable moving fluidly between exploratory analysis, new metric construction, model development, and applied problem solving
  • Proven ability to translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical workstreams
  • Skilled at building dashboards and visualizations that make complex data intuitive and actionable for a business leadership audience

info.title: Business Security Partner (L5)
info.jobDescription:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

The Team

Netflix’s Business Security Partner (BSP) team is a team of senior security advisors organized around business proximity rather than technical domains. Each BSP partner owns relationships with a defined portfolio of business units, builds long-term relationships with BU leadership, and serves as the security export who understands those businesses well enough to advise on decisions before they are made. We sit in business reviews, participate in architecture conversations, and build the kind of trust with stakeholders that makes security a resource rather than a requirement. 


Across all of our relationships, the goal is the same: every major business decision at Netflix should have access to clear, usable security risk context; not a compliance output buried in a document, but actionable guidance from a partner who understands both the risk and the business. 


About the Role

This role covers two distinct, fast-moving areas within Netflix: Marketing and Animation.  BSP aligns coverage based on need and often rotates business units. You may cover other areas during your time at Netflix. BSP right-sizes risk while enabling business outcomes. 


On the Marketing side, you will be the primary security partner for teams spanning Consumer Products, Brand, Events, Experiences, and Social Media, as well as the external agency and vendor ecosystems that touch pre-release campaign content. You will advise on the security risk of GenAI tools Marketing teams are actively building and adopting, assess vendors and Business Process Outsourcing partners handling sensitive creative assets, and govern the access controls that protect Netflix’s social media accounts. 


For Animation, you will partner with Netflix Animation as its dedicated security partner. Your work will span security risk assessment of the animation production pipeline, advancing the alignment of legacy systems with Netflix standards, and advising on architectural decisions that affect how pre-release animated content is protected. The pace of change is high, both in the business and in the legacy integration work. Your ability to engage credibly with engineering and leadership on complex, technically interdependent risk is essential.


This role also carries M&A responsibilities. BSPs at Netflix are expected to support technical security due diligence for acquisitions and subsidiaries. 


What You Will Work On:

  • Own the security partnership for Marketing and Animation, building stakeholder relationships, learning how these businesses operate, and translating that context into opinionated security guidance.
  • Lead security risk assessments and treatment strategies with cross-functional teams as they launch new capabilities and tools.
  • Evaluate and advise on the security risk of GenAI tool adoption across both business units. Set conditions of approval, assess training data provenance and data handling, and partner with Legal and Privacy on unified guidance. 
  • Maintain and evolve the Business Risk Profile for each business unit, prioritizing and driving remediation of the risks that matter most.
  • Advance pre-release content protection in partnership across both business units: campaign assets and creative content in Marketing, and animation production pipelines and studio workstation environments. Coordinate with Content Security and partner SPA teams to ensure controls match the sensitivity of what’s in scope. 
  • Support M&A technical security due diligence for acquisitions and subsidiaries. 
  • Develop reporting and metrics that communicate risk posture and business security initiatives to SPA leadership and business unit stakeholders.

Desired Background:

  • Experience operating as a security partner or advisor. You’ve built trust with business stakeholders, translated technical risk into business language, and driven decisions without direct authority. 
  • GenAI security depth. You have direct experience advising on or assessing security risks in GenAI systems. You can identify real risks and engage credibly with technical teams, legal, and privacy partners to mitigate them. 
  • Broad security domain knowledge across application security, cloud security, identity and access management, and data governance. You are comfortable operating across all of them and know when to go deep versus when to synthesize, practicing business awareness on how to communicate.  You pull in domain experts from across the wider security organization, where needed, to help assess and address risks. 
  • Strong stakeholder partnership instincts. You build trust with the business by demonstrating that you understand their context, not just their security posture. You know how to translate a technical finding into a business decision, and back to the Security department for support. 
  • Comfort with ambiguity and novel technology environments. You have a framework for reasoning under uncertainty and for making recommendations when the answer isn't fully known.
  • M&A or technical due diligence experience is a plus and not required.

info.title: Senior Software Engineer 5  — Validation & Safety Platform
info.jobDescription:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

About the team


The Validation & Safety Platform is one of three pillars inside the new System Health, Validation & Insights Platform group in Productivity Engineering. Our mandate: catch safety and correctness regressions in human-written or agent-generated code before they reach production.


Netflix's agent fleet now writes, tests, refactors, and deploys code continuously across every domain. As agent volume grows, the constraint shifts from producing changes to knowing which ones are safe. Quality assurance can no longer be a human-gated step at the end of a PR — it has to be embedded at every stage of the developer loop, proactive and automated.


Today the team runs the validation and safety gates for the fleet: automated test generation, coverage and safeguards show teams where they stand. We're extending to other safety signals built specifically for agent-generated code, so we can judge whether a change is genuinely correct as agents write and modify code at scale.


About the role


We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help build the next generation of this platform: tools and guardrails that keep pace with an engineering org where a growing share of code is agent-generated.


You will design systems that thousands of engineers and their agents depend on, make build-vs-extend calls on what the platform should own versus expose through an API, and bring a security-conscious view to how autonomous agents get sandboxed, scoped, and safely given access to test infrastructure.


Key responsibilities


  • Design and build validation and safety products used platform-wide: test generation, coverage and safeguards, deterministic and predictive test selection, and mutation testing at scale.
  • Build the polyglot static analysis layer that gives agent-generated code an automated, language-agnostic first quality gate.
  • Develop agent-specific safety signals: detect prompt flakiness (an agent producing inconsistent output across identical prompts or seeds), evaluate agent trajectories against execution traces, and score semantic correctness of agent-generated code against the original requirement, the agent's own stated intent, and observed behavior change.
  • Define clear platform capabilities and make deliberate build-vs-buy, build-vs-extend calls as the platform's scope grows.
  • Apply sound judgment on agent sandboxing, scoping, and data redaction wherever the platform gives agents access to test infrastructure or execution environments.

Who you are


  • Experienced building and operating a platform used by other engineering teams — you think about your product as a platform, not a one-off tool.
  • Comfortable making product calls: what capability the platform should own, what it should expose as an API, and when to extend versus build new.
  • An advanced user of agentic coding tools — you work daily with hooks, MCPs, and context management, even if you haven't built an agentic platform yourself.
  • Security-minded: you have a working understanding of agent sandboxing, scoping, and redaction, even if it isn't your primary background.
  • A strong communicator who can document technical tradeoffs clearly for both engineering and non-technical stakeholders.
  • An advocate for a strong testing culture: familiar with test frameworks, code coverage tooling, CI systems, and post-deployment verification.

Experience we'd be excited about


  • You have designed or operated developer-platform infrastructure: distribution, CI/CD, or versioning systems used by many teams.
  • You have built or integrated LLM-based evaluation systems (LLM-as-judge, agent trajectory scoring, or similar).
  • You have worked with mutation testing, static analysis, or test-selection systems at scale.
  • You have hands-on experience sandboxing or scoping agent access to sensitive systems or data.

info.jobDescription:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

It's an exciting time to join Netflix as we continue to expand our business globally. We are revolutionizing the way people watch their favorite shows & movies, and building our own library of original Netflix content for all to enjoy. You can read through our culture memo and long-term view to learn more about our unique Netflix culture as well as the milestones we will achieve in the future. 

The Opportunity:
We have a unique approach to compensation at Netflix. To help us attract and retain stunning colleagues, we pay employees at their personal top of market (PTOM). We don’t rely on traditional frameworks like salary grades or pay bands; PTOM is role and individual specific. This requires people managers and HR to combine the data they have available to them with judgment about the market. To do this effectively, we need a compensation team that can work without conventional compensation structures and enable HR and managers to determine PTOM with data, insights and resources. This requires a skill set that can balance both the art and science of compensation design. 

At Netflix, we take a unique approach to our benefits and mobility philosophy, creating and implementing programs that align with our unique culture. A big part of our focus on excellence is hiring people who are great at what they do and creating an environment where talent can thrive. This includes offering a comprehensive and flexible set of benefits and mobility programs that support employees in the key moments that matter in their lives.

 

We are hiring a compensation and Employee Programs leader for the EMEA region. This individual will play a critical role in driving Netflix’s rewards strategy for implementation in the region, ensuring alignment with our unique compensation and benefits philosophy. The individual will be responsible for partnering with our regional Talent teams and business leaders as well as the global Compensation and Benefits function to provide actionable insights and innovative solutions for hiring, retention and annual planning. The position requires leveraging data-driven insights while fostering creative, agile solutions tailored to regional nuances.

In this role you will: 

  • Lead a team, fostering an inclusive environment by providing clear direction, regular feedback, and growth opportunities, while empowering team members to take ownership and achieve their potential.

  • Oversee the Compensation, Benefits, and Mobility portfolio for the EMEA region, spanning across Netflix’s core streaming business and integrated business units such as Scanline, Animation, and other studios, ensuring consistent application of Netflix’s compensation philosophy while tailoring programs to local contexts.

  • Implement and adapt Netflix’s global compensation programs in the region, including market-driven pay structures, equity education, and manager capability-building initiatives to enable high-quality compensation decision-making.

  • Develop and maintain Market Reference Ranges for roles across Streaming and other regional businesses in partnership with global teams, ensuring clarity and alignment with market movements and internal expectations.

  • Provide subject matter expertise on sales incentive design and implementation across regional business units, ensuring competitiveness, simplicity, and alignment with performance goals.

  • Partner with business leaders, HR, Talent Acquisition, and global Compensation to advise on hiring, retention, promotions, market expansions, and to ensure alignment of compensation strategies with organizational goals.

  • Identify and evaluate external resources for high-quality market compensation data, conducting regular audits to address data gaps and analyze compensation trends for strategic insights.

  • Drive regional rollout of global initiatives, including pay equity analyses, compensation training, annual reviews, and designing educational resources to enhance managers' understanding of regional compensation practices.

  • Support the development and communication of global benefits and mobility strategies, ensuring alignment with regional needs and regulatory compliance across EMEA.

  • Collaborate with EMEA HR and Benefits teams to assess and improve current benefits offerings, ensuring they meet local regulations (e.g., tax laws, social security) and integrate into Netflix’s global benefits framework.

  • Monitor and evaluate the success of EMEA benefits and mobility programs, advising leadership on market trends, cost implications, and employee sentiment, and leading communication and education efforts to maximize employee engagement with benefits.

  • Support EMEA open enrollment periods, ensuring clear communication and guidance to help employees fully utilize benefits and ensuring regional adaptation of global benefits programs.

  • Partner with the global Benefits and Mobility teams to ensure global operational excellence for our programs

  • Proven ability to implement compensation strategies that align with organizational goals and market trends.

  • Demonstrated experience in designing and operationalizing compensation frameworks, including building manager capability, establishing market ranges, and supporting regional execution.

  • Creativity and adaptability in navigating non-traditional compensation models.

  • Confidence to make independent, informed decisions and take smart risks.

  • Experience working in a global, matrixed environment with a deep understanding of regional nuances.

  • Familiarity with EMEA compensation and benefits landscapes and regulatory frameworks, including familiarity with local benefits trends and compliance issues.

  • Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills to engage stakeholders across multiple levels and functions.
